title: Ottawa Event Facilitator
description:
About Puppy Sphere:

Welcome to Puppy Sphere, we are a high-growth startup redefining the wellness category through puppy therapy! We’re on a mission to bring people together in welcoming spaces where the gentle power of puppies helps them slow down, boost their mood, and return again and again.

As North America’s original puppy yoga company, we’ve built a community of over 400,000 people, making puppy therapy part of their everyday wellbeing ritual. We’ve partnered with global brands including the NBA, TikTok, and Google to bring the gentle power of puppies to even more workplaces, events, and communities!

If you’re excited by growth, impact and care deeply about people, animals, and raising the bar in everything you do - we’d love to hear from you!

Job Description:

This is a part-time, off-site role supporting Puppy Sphere’s private events. We’re looking for motivated, upbeat, and hard-working team members to join our Pack! 🐾

As a Private Event Facilitator, you’ll play a key role in delivering memorable Puppy Sphere experiences at a variety of venues. From setup through to breakdown, you’ll help ensure each event runs smoothly while creating a fun, positive experience for our guests and prioritising the safety and wellbeing of both people and puppies.

Weekday availability is essential, and flexibility is important as shifts will vary depending on private event bookings. Regular shifts are not guaranteed, so this role is ideal for someone looking for flexible, occasional work. Weekend availability is a plus!

The rate for this role is $18.00 CAD per hour.

Job Responsibilities:

Event Operations:

  • Support onsite and offsite private events, including event setup and teardown, transportation of equipment, and creating an engaging, positive experience for guests.
  • Set up the studio and puppy area at the start of each shift, ensuring everything is clean, organized, and ready for guests and pups.
  • Assist with setting up themed decor for events when required.
  • Welcome and check in guests, creating a warm, friendly, and well-organized arrival experience.
  • Confidently lead welcome and closing speeches in front of classes throughout the day.
  • Support the care of puppies throughout the day, including cleaning, providing water/food as needed, and ensuring their comfort and wellbeing.
  • Conduct welcome briefings throughout the shift, setting expectations and creating a positive, engaging start to each class.
  • Deliver a high-quality wellness experience by being present, attentive, and responsive to guest needs throughout the event.
  • Actively monitor puppy wellbeing and guide guests on appropriate handling to ensure a safe and positive experience for everyone.
  • Maintain a clean and safe environment by managing puppy clean-ups during and between classes.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization across all areas of the venue, including the puppy space, beverage station, and common areas.
  • Support smooth transitions, ensuring spaces are reset quickly and efficiently.
  • Help build a strong sense of community by creating moments that keep guests coming back.
  • Use sound judgment and take initiative to proactively address challenges and support a positive event experience.
  • Work closely with the wider team to ensure smooth event delivery, proactively identifying and resolving issues as they arise.
  • Embrace change and support the implementation of new processes and initiatives, helping ensure they land smoothly onsite.
  • Escalate any concerns relating to guest experience, team dynamics, or puppy wellbeing to supervisors or management in a timely manner.
  • Adhere to company policies, safety protocols, and animal welfare guidelines at all times.
  • Support with necessary report forms, such as Animal Welfare, Studio Inventory, and End-of-Day reports, and adapt to evolving priorities and operational needs as they arise.
  • Complete end-of-day sanitization procedures for the studio and puppy areas to maintain a clean, safe environment and prevent cross-contamination between litters.
  • Uphold a positive and respectful attitude, and demonstrate enthusiasm to ensure all team members and guests feel welcomed.
  • Consistently role model Puppy Sphere’s core values and mission, creating a positive, collaborative, inclusive, and supportive team culture and environment.
  • Act proactively and address tasks without waiting for direction (studio cleaning, puppy accidents, anticipating guest needs).

Job Requirements:

  • Availability to work weekdays (at least one day per week)
  • Availability for a minimum of 4 shifts per month
  • Additional weekend availability is a strong plus
  • Weekday shifts are scheduled based on confirmed events, and a regular or consistent schedule is not guaranteed.
  • Experience in the service or hospitality industry is preferred
  • A warm, engaging, and outgoing personality that helps create a welcoming and positive experience
  • Comfortable working in a fast-growing startup environment where things evolve quickly and adaptability is key.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull items weighing up to 30 lbs.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, including throughout the duration of events.
  • Ability to bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and perform repetitive motions as required during event setup, execution, and breakdown.
  • Comfortable working with standard cleaning supplies and solutions, following proper safety and handling guidelines.
  • Ability to work in environments with moderate noise levels, animals present, and high guest interaction.
  • Bonus if you have access to a car and ability to drive.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Goes above and beyond to create an exceptional experience
  • Is a true team player: proactive, supportive, and collaborative
  • Embodies our values in everything they do
  • Communicates clearly and confidently, with strong interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Stays organized and can multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Is kind, thoughtful, and genuinely cares about creating a positive experience for every guest
  • Feels comfortable and confident working around puppies, and understands the importance of creating a calm, safe, and positive environment for both guests and pups

Perks:

🚀 Join a fast-growing startup with upward mobility.
🦮 Experience the happiness of working around puppies.
🧘 4 complimentary puppy yoga classes for you, family and friends.
🔖 35% discount on individual puppy yoga classes.
✨ Opportunity to work with celebrity clients and industry giants.

Puppy Sphere Values:

  • We create happiness.
  • We care.
  • We adapt.
  • We show up.
  • We raise the bar.

We’re so grateful for your interest in joining the team here at Puppy Sphere! Due to the high number of applications we receive, we may not be able to personally reach out to everyone, but please know we truly appreciate the time and effort you’ve taken to apply 🤍

title: Copper Cable Assembly
description:
Lynn Electronics, part of the Network Infrastructure unit of of NSI Industries, has been an industry leader and a premier workplace for over 55 years. We are dedicated to quality and the customer experience. This is your opportunity to join a growing, dynamic team as a key contributor at our location in North Wales, PA division headquarters.

Lynn Electronics is actively recruiting an energetic, high-potential Copper Assembler Associate to join our growing team. We are seeking an organized, detail-oriented individual with the ability to work well independently and as part of a collaborative team. As an assembler Associate, you will be responsible for assemblies to specifications and quality requirements to prepare cables. This is a full time, first shift position. The hours are Monday-Friday 7:00am - 3:30pm.

Responsibilities of the Assembler Associate Include:
  • Prepare, assemble, and test copper cable including stripping, and terminating wires for standard and specialty products using a range of hand tools and other equipment.
  • Solder interconnections per IPC-620 standard as required.
  • Conduct work in compliance with OSHA and company safety procedures.
  • Ability to read and understand customer’s technical drawings.
  • Read, interpret, and follow detailed written work orders.
  • Maintain a clean work area.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Desired Experience:
  • 1-3+ years related assembling experience in fiber cable assembly preferred but willing to train
  • Hands on experience in assembly of electro -mechanical products, preferably connector or cable assemblies
Candidates must be able to read and interpret work instructions in English, possess effective communication skills, and a professional demeanor. You should be punctual and reliable as this is a very important support position.

The company is offering an excellent benefits package, sign on bonus, paid time off, paid holidays, quarterly bonus program and so much more! Please apply or forward your resume ASAP for immediate consideration. We look forward to connecting with you!

We comply with federal and state disability laws and make reasonable accommodation for applicants and employees with disabilities to ensure equal employment opportunities.

title: OTR CDL A Specialized Flatbed/ Step Deck
location: AL, DE, GA, IN, KY, MS, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, VA, WV, US
description:
CDL-A Flatbed and Step Deck Driver
Join our growing team at Adcock, a family-owned logistics leader committed to safety, stability, and long-term career growth. We are seeking experienced CDL-A drivers specializing in flatbed and step deck operations who prioritize safety and professionalism. If you are looking for a company that values your time, offers high-paying miles, and provides modern equipment, this is the opportunity for you.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Safely operate flatbed and step deck trucks across assigned routes, adhering to all federal and state transportation regulations
  • Secure and unload cargo efficiently, ensuring proper load securement and compliance with safety standards
  • Conduct pre-trip and post-trip inspections, reporting any mechanical issues promptly
  • Maintain accurate logs of driving hours, cargo documentation, and delivery records
  • Communicate effectively with dispatch and customers to coordinate delivery schedules
  • Follow company safety protocols and promote a safety-first culture on the road
Skills and Qualifications:
  • Valid CDL-A license with clean driving record
  • Proven experience operating flatbed and step deck trailers
  • Strong understanding of safety procedures and load securement standards
  • Excellent communication and time management skills
  • Ability to work independently and follow routes and schedules accurately
  • Physical ability to load, unload, and secure cargo as needed
At Adcock, we foster a supportive and respectful work environment that values your contributions. Enjoy stable, high-paying miles, modern equipment, and a culture that respects your time both on the road and at home. Join us and build a rewarding career in logistics with a company that cares about your success.
Requirements:
Your safety and comfort are our highest priorities. You will operate:
  • Late-Model Tractors: Exceptionally maintained, state-of-the-art trucks equipped with the latest safety technology and driver comfort features.
  • Premium Trailer Fleet: Robust, well-maintained flatbed and step deck trailers with top-of-the-line securing equipment.
  • Dedicated Maintenance Support: Our heavy-duty truck repair team ensures your rig is always road-ready, minimizing your downtime.
Key Responsibilities
  • Safely operate and maneuver commercial motor vehicles (Class A CDL) over regional or national routes.
  • Properly secure, strap, chain, and tarp diverse flatbed and step deck cargo (including heavy machinery, industrial equipment, and steel) in compliance with FMCSA regulations.
  • Perform thorough pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections to ensure maximum safety.
  • Maintain accurate electronic logging device (ELD) logs and transport documentation.
  • Deliver freight on schedule while maintaining professional, on-the-road customer service.
  • Otr
  • Valid Class A CDL
  • Minimum 2 years CDL-A tractor/trailer experience
  • At least 1 year of flatbed experience
  • No serious violations within the last 36 months
  • Must be 23 years of age or older.
Compensation:
  • Flatbed Rate: $0.73 per mile + $75.00 tarp pay
  • Step Deck Rate: $0.73 per mile + $75.00 tarp pay
Benefits:
  • Quarterly Incentives: Performance, safety, and fuel-efficiency bonuses paid out every quarter.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package:
    • Full medical, dental, and vision insurance.
    • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching.
    • Paid Time Off (PTO) and holiday pay.
  • Tarping & Extra Stop Pay: Fair compensation for all additional physical labor and stop-offs.

American Income Life / Globe Life is committed to providing equal opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: Manager, Business Insights & Analytics
description:
Position Summary

Bay FC is seeking a strategic, analytically driven Manager of Business Insights & Analytics to serve as a key thought partner to senior leadership and functional department heads. This role will own the club's fan analytics narrative, translating complex data into clear, compelling business recommendations that directly influence commercial strategy.

As a senior individual contributor and emerging leader within the insights & analytics function, you will shape how the organization uses data to make decisions.

This role reports directly to the Director, Business Insights & Analytics.

Responsibilities

Consumer Analytics & Growth Insights

  • Build and maintain a connected insights system that transforms business, market, and fan signals into clear, actionable choices
  • Analyze commercial performance across channels and product lines to identify revenue patterns, demand drivers, and high-impact windows for marketing influence
  • Conduct market and geographic analyses to size growth opportunities, assess penetration, and guide resource allocation across priority audiences and regions
  • Own brand health measurement to evaluate awareness, sentiment, and market positioning, surfacing insights that inform brand strategy and creative direction
  • Champion a test-and-learn culture by designing measurement frameworks and interpreting A/B tests

Fan Intelligence & Segmentation

  • Own audience intelligence by maintaining unified fan profiles, defining consumer segments and personas, and identifying growth opportunities to guide personalized marketing and commercial strategies
  • Analyze the fan lifecycle from first exposure through long-term fandom to surface retention drivers, friction points, and opportunities to increase lifetime value
  • Segment and deliver audiences for campaign targeting, promotional offers, and cross-departmental outreach

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Serve as the embedded analytics partner for senior stakeholders across Marketing, Ticketing, and Merchandise, proactively identifying opportunities and surfacing insights that influence organizational strategy
  • Design and execute end-to-end analytical projects: problem framing, data collection and unification, modeling, insight synthesis, and stakeholder communication
  • Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and executive-ready recommendations
  • Lead recurring business reviews, presenting data-backed narratives to department heads and C-suite with clarity and confidence

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5 to 7 years of experience in analytics, business insights, or consumer insights roles
  • Strong experience translating data into business impact, particularly in revenue-generating functions
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language such as Python or R
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders
  • Experience building audience segmentation, consumer profiles, or personas for marketing activation

Preferred:

  • Background in sports, media, entertainment, or marketing analytics
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Salesforce, KORE, Tixr, Iterable, Shopify, Google Analytics, or similar CRM, email, and digital marketing tools
  • Hands-on experience with fan or customer data, including marketing mix modeling, attribution, or media measurement
  • Exposure to brand health tracking, survey design, and market research methodologies
  • Comfort leveraging AI tools to automate workflows, enhance analysis, and improve business processes across analytics and operational use cases

Compensation

The starting salary range for this role is $120,000. Hired applicant will be eligible to receive an annual discretionary bonus. Actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope.

Bay FC is an equal opportunity employer to all, regardless of age, ancestry, color, disability (mental and physical), exercising the right to family care and medical leave, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, national origin, political affiliation, race, religious creed, sex (includes pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and related medical conditions), and sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

title: Research & Development (R&D) Technician
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an R&D Technician to join our R&D team. This role will play a key part in developing, testing, and refining new dietary supplement products. This position works closely with the R&D Manager, Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, and Production teams to ensure all formulations meet customer specifications, internal specifications, cGMP, and FDA standards. Responsibilities span ideation, lab-scale trials, documentation, regulatory review, and support through production scale-up. This role is a great fit for candidates with a background in food science or a related field, including recent graduates with relevant internship or entry-level experience.



Key Responsibilities

Formulation & Product Development

Assist in developing new formulas (powders, capsules, tablets, flavor systems) using approved raw materials.

Evaluate nutrient safety levels to appropriately select ingredients and their dosages while formulating.

Conduct lab-scale experiments, physical/chemical testing (e.g., pH, moisture, bulk density), and stability assessments.

Assist in raw material sourcing, qualification, and approval.


Documentation & Compliance:

Create and maintain detailed lab records, batch sheets, specifications, and technical documentation.

Review raw ingredient documentation (COAs, MSDS) and ensure regulatory compliance (cGMP, FDA, DSHEA).

Prepare and manage sample documentation for internal review and customer presentations.


Collaboration & Scale-Up Support:

Work closely with all members of the R&D team on all projects. Teamwork and shared knowledge are key aspects of the R&D Department culture.

Work cross-functionally with Production during pilot runs and first manufacturing batches.

Troubleshoot formulation and processing issues alongside Quality and Operations teams.


Client and Supplier Interactions

Interact with clients as required, often to brainstorm product ideas or lead a sampling session.

Interact with suppliers as required, often to learn of new sourcing opportunities and to obtain pricing quotes and documentation.

Interactions may include in-person meetings, virtual meetings, conferences, and email.


Continuous Improvement:

Stay current with industry trends, scientific literature, and regulatory updates.

Recommend process improvements, new technologies, and ingredient innovations.


Lab Maintenance:

Maintain cleanliness, organization, maintenance, and calibration of lab equipment and shared lab spaces.

Help maintain appropriate inventory of laboratory ingredients, packaging materials, and other R&D resources.

Ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal of materials.



Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Microbiology, or related field.
  • Experience in dietary supplement/food product R&D (an internship or at least 1 year preferred).
  • Working knowledge of cGMP and FDA regulations.
  • Ability to collaborate with personnel within and outside the R&D Department.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to lift up to 60 lbs. and stand for extended periods of time.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience in formulation, analytical testing, and product scale-up.
  • Familiarity with flavor systems and ingredient functionality.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish.
  • Experience in regulatory documentation and compliance.


Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with current and prospective clients.
  • Proficient in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, etc).
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a willingness to learn and adapt.

Benefits Package:

  • 401K with employer match.
  • Full medical coverage for employees
  • Dental and Vision coverage options.

title: Business Services Consultant
location: San Luis Obispo, California, United States
description:
Career Team is a leading workforce development organization on a mission to transform lives. We blend cutting-edge technology with compassionate, high-touch services to drive real, measurable outcomes in the lives of job seekers across the country. At Career Team, we’re solving today’s unemployment challenges with smart software, world-class trainers, dedicated case managers, dynamic job developers, and innovative partners. If you're passionate about making a difference and believe in the power of technology to transform lives, you’ll feel right at home here.

TITLE: Business Services Consultant
REPORTS TO: Project Director
LOCATION: San Luis Obispo County, CA
EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full-Time, Non-Exempt Employee

Career TEAM is looking to hire a Business Services Consultant who is responsible for cultivating strategic relationships with local businesses and community partners to proactively identify job opportunities and workforce needs, ultimately supporting the training, placement, and success of career seekers.

Your Impact on Career TEAM’s Success:

  • Serve as the primary liaison between employers, workforce partners, and the AJCC system for Rapid Response and Layoff Aversion activities
  • Coordinate and deliver Rapid Response orientations and information sessions for impacted workers
  • Engage employers proactively to identify potential layoffs and provide workforce solutions to prevent or minimize job loss
  • Collaborate with Career Advisors to ensure seamless enrollment of affected workers into WIOA services
  • Provide information on unemployment insurance, training opportunities, supportive services, and job placement assistance
  • Maintain strong relationships with local employers, industry groups, labor representatives, and economic development partners
  • Coordinate on-site and virtual Rapid Response events in partnership with SLO WDB and required partners
  • Participate in assigned American Job Center activities
  • Track and document all Rapid Response activities, employer contacts, and participant engagement in required systems
  • Support dislocated workers in transitioning to new employment opportunities through referrals, workshops, and direct services
  • Ensure all activities are compliant with WIOA, state, and local Rapid Response requirements
  • Organize and participate in hiring events
  • Assist with reporting, data collection, and documentation related to services
  • Work with program staff to align efforts with business services, training opportunities, and sector strategies
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of employer engagement and participant outcomes
  • Approach each day and task with a solutions-oriented and responsive mindset
  • Other duties and projects as needed

    This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at the listed location.

    To Qualify for This Role, You Must Have:

  • Associate’s degree or higher or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Ability to work in a dynamic team environment - must have excellent teamwork and interpersonal skills
  • Astounding ability to multitask and be proactive
  • Effective visual and verbal presentation skills
  • Ability to work with colleagues and partners showing courteousness and a high level of professionalism
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the local business community, in-demand occupations, and current workforce development programs, including WIOA
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills with the capacity to establish, maintain, and grow strategic partnerships with employers, community leaders, and industry groups
  • Proven ability to conduct effective business needs assessments and develop customized workforce solutions for employers, such as On-the-Job Training and Subsidized Employment
  • Approach each day and task with a solutions-oriented and responsive mindset
  • A Valid Diver’s License

    Additional Skills/Knowledge Career TEAM Would Love for This Role:
  • Strong computer skills in Google and MS Office Suites
  • Knowledge of San Luis Obispo Business Ecosystem
  • Keen Business Intelligence
  • Confidence to facilitate opportunities on behalf of career seekers
  • Experience and knowledge of WIOA workforce development contracts/programs

    Salary: $62,000 - 67,000
    Salary is commensurate with education and experience. Career Team offers a competitive benefits package including healthcare, dental, and personal/vacation time.

    Travel: Travel for this role is primarily limited to necessary trips within San Luis Obispo County to support community business engagement

Career Team is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Background Check Requirements. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check (including criminal, prior employment and education verification). Failure to satisfactorily complete the background check may affect the application status of applicants or continued employment of current employees who apply for the position.

California Consumer Privacy Act ("CCPA"). Career Team is committed to complying with the CCPA and all data privacy and laws in the jurisdictions in which it recruits and hires employees. Career Team collects and uses Personal Information for human resources, employment, benefits administration, health and safety, and business-related purposes and to be in legal compliance. title: Regional Director of Operations
description:

Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Agemark Senior Living is seeking an experienced Regional Director of Operations to lead a portfolio of senior living communities across our region. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for driving results in fiscal management, staffing, compliance, and overall property success. You'll partner closely with the Regional VP of Operations and property Executive Directors to build a success-oriented, accountable culture that puts residents, staff, and communities first.

Excellence | Personal Investment | Integrity | Compassion | Accountability | Celebration | Team Spirit

Ready to lead with purpose? Apply today to join a team dedicated to making a meaningful difference in the lives of residents and staff across our communities.

title: Agency Event Director
description:
Director of Events

About the Role

The Director of Events is the operational leader of Cloth & Flame’s events department, responsible for delivering exceptional events while building the systems, team, and processes that allow the agency to grow.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role. At our current size, this person will personally produce many of our events while overseeing the department, with the role evolving toward greater team leadership and operational management as we grow.

The Director works closely with sales, creative, design, production, culinary, and accounting to ensure what we sell is achievable, appropriately priced, and delivered to the highest standard.

Event Production & Client Management

  • Lead and participate in client calls, planning meetings, site visits, and final details calls
  • Oversee concurrent events as volume fluctuates, assigning event producers, internal support and freelance resources based on program needs

Team Leadership & Contractor Management

Proposals, Budgets & Scope Management

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in event production, experiential marketing, hospitality, live events, or a related field
  • Strong organizational and communication skills across robust, concurrent programs
  • Proven experience producing events of varying complexity from planning through execution
  • Experience managing, mentoring, or leading event professionals
  • Experience managing event budgets with an understanding of margin and profitability
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

The Ideal Candidate

You are an experienced event leader who still loves being in the weeds. You can lead a client call, build a budget, troubleshoot a production challenge, coach a producer, and walk into an event and immediately see what needs attention.

You take ownership, communicate proactively, and care equally about the guest experience, the client relationship, the quality of the work, and the profitability of the business.

title: Director, Workforce Management
description:
The Clover Care Services organization delivers proactive support and care to our members through our clinical Clover Home Care teams, and quality improvement services to our aligned providers through our practice engagement team. Clover has built one of the most proactive, data-driven health care services platforms and is excited about how technology impacts our ability to bring transformative results to both patients and providers.

Clover Care Services is entering a significant period of clinical growth. As we scale our Clover Care Visit (CCV) team, we need a dedicated leader who can turn an ambitious hiring plan into a reliable, repeatable workforce engine—from recruiting pipeline and onboarding capacity through clinician readiness, productivity, and performance.

As the Director, Workforce Management, you will connect workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, leadership capacity, and performance management into one operating system, giving the organization clear visibility into whether we are on pace and what needs to change when we are not.

As Director, Workforce Management, you will:

  • Own the CCV workforce plan end to end. Build and run the staffing strategy required to scale the clinician organization, translating long-range growth targets into weekly and monthly hiring, onboarding, and readiness goals.
  • Create visibility from candidate pipeline to “ready to visit.” Establish the operating metrics, forecasting, and reporting needed to understand recruiting conversion, onboarding lead times, attrition, training capacity, and clinician readiness—and surface risks early enough to act.
  • Build a scalable clinician onboarding model. Partner across Clinical, Talent, IT, Operations, and other teams to evolve today’s high-touch onboarding journey into a structured model that can support significantly larger hiring cohorts without sacrificing clinical quality.
  • Build the leadership capacity required to scale. Determine the right model for preceptors, clinical leads, onboarding cohorts, and frontline management so that rapid growth does not create an unsustainable burden on existing clinical leaders.
  • Own workforce performance management. Establish clear, actionable standards and operating rhythms across areas such as attendance, cancellation rates, Clover Assistant Touch, productivity, and normalized performance measures.
  • Make quality and productivity work together. Build performance expectations that reflect accurate, sustainable clinical performance—not simply higher activity—and partner with clinical leaders to ensure workforce decisions support both member experience and quality of care.
  • Turn workforce data into decisions. Build the dashboards, forecasts, and management routines leaders need to understand capacity, identify constraints, allocate resources, and stay ahead of hiring or performance gaps.
  • Create repeatable workforce-management capabilities for CCS. Use the CCV ramp as the first proving ground for processes, tools, and operating models that can later support In-Home Care and other Clover Care Services programs.
  • Operate as a cross-functional leader. Bring together Clinical Activation, clinical leadership, Talent, Operations, Finance, analytics, and other partners around one integrated workforce plan with clear owners, milestones, and escalation paths.

Success in this role looks like:

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Build a clear baseline of the CCV workforce funnel and translate the 2027 growth target into a measurable workforce plan spanning recruiting, onboarding, training capacity, clinician readiness, and attrition.
  • Identify the biggest risks and bottlenecks in the ramp and establish the metrics, operating cadence, and accountability needed to address them.

Within your first 6 months, you will:

  • Establish a predictable recruiting-to-readiness operating model, including scalable onboarding cohorts, preceptor capacity, and clinical leadership support.
  • Launch workforce dashboards and performance-management routines that enable leaders to anticipate capacity gaps, manage performance, and increase clinician onboarding volume without sacrificing quality.

Over time, you will:

  • Help CCV reach its clinician-capacity goals ahead of the 2027 AEP cycle through a sustainable, data-driven approach to hiring, onboarding, and performance.
  • Build repeatable workforce-management capabilities that can extend beyond CCV to support In-Home Care and other Clover Care Services programs.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have built or led workforce planning, capacity management, clinical operations, field operations, or another complex people-scaling function where success depended on turning ambitious growth targets into an executable operating plan.
  • You are comfortable owning the full workforce funnel—from recruiting demand and hiring pace through onboarding, readiness, productivity, performance, and attrition.
  • You know how to scale a high-touch operating model without sacrificing the quality, judgment, and human support that made it successful.
  • You are highly analytical and can turn workforce data into useful forecasts, metrics, dashboards, and decisions.
  • You know how to balance productivity with quality, accuracy, and member experience when defining and managing performance.
  • You are an effective cross-functional operator who can create alignment and accountability across clinical leaders, recruiters, operators, analysts, and executives.
  • You are comfortable moving between strategy and execution and thrive in environments where the operating model is still being built.
  • You bring experience scaling distributed clinicians, field teams, home-based care, or another operationally complex healthcare workforce.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.

$161,500—$210,000 USD

title: Web Platforms Engineer
description:
About us

Appnovation is the AI Product Company. Headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, with teams around the world, Appnovation builds AI products, delivers enterprise AI and digital solutions, and co-invests with clients to bring new AI products to market.

Open source has been the foundation of Appnovation's work since 2007, and it remains the foundation underneath every AI product the company builds today. Appnovation teams work with organizations in highly regulated industries, including global leaders such as Pfizer, Google and AstraZeneca, to help them adopt AI they can govern and own.

Senior Manager, Web Platform Engineering

Technology is foundational to all of Appnovation’s offerings, from consulting to digital innovation to digital product and service creation. The technology department is focused on delivering software solutions that enable rich consumer experiences, from mobile and web applications to advanced analytics and machine learning, to content and engagement management service enablement platforms.

Inherent throughout our tech capabilities is deep expertise in the Software Development Life Cycle, a drive for creativity, a passion for the craft, and collaboration with other disciplines - all foundational ingredients in successful digital experiences and client partnerships.

We are seeking a Web Platform Engineer to be the hands-on technical expert for the web and content management (CMS) platforms of a global life sciences client. This is an architect-engineer role: you will help set technical direction, and you will also dig into the code yourself. You will lead the technical side of a CMS evaluation and modernization effort, quickly prototype new platform capabilities, and shape the platform layer that teams use to build and run patient and healthcare professional (HCP) websites at scale. You will work closely with the client's infrastructure, engineering and product teams, turning website needs into clear platform and integration requirements. The role is focused on web and CMS platforms only.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • CMS Evaluation and Selection: Lead the technical side of evaluating modern CMS and digital experience platforms, including headless and AI-enabled options. Assess them against criteria such as AI-assisted authoring and site creation, integration fit, security, hosting on client-controlled infrastructure, and long-term cost, and make clear, evidence-based recommendations.
  • Rapid Prototyping and Technology Assessment: Build quick proofs of concept for new platform features and emerging tools (for example, new Adobe Edge Delivery Services capabilities such as Document Authoring) and come back with a clear recommendation on whether and how to adopt them.
  • Platform Capability Ownership: Shape, maintain and evolve the web platform layer that sits on top of the CMS, including tooling for creating new sites, reusable components and templates, automated testing, and managing content at scale.
  • Migration and Modernization: Define the target architecture and migration approach for moving websites from legacy platforms, such as Drupal and in-house site builders, onto the selected platform, including reusable patterns, risks, dependencies and quality gates.
  • Infrastructure and Integration Partnership: Act as the web team's technical liaison to central infrastructure and engineering teams. Turn website and CMS needs into clear requirements for hosting, integrations, APIs and AI/MCP layers, and represent the web platform in engineering office hours and guild forums.
  • AI-Enabled Content and Delivery: Help shape how AI is used across the platform, from prompt-based content updates and site creation to automated testing and validation, with the right governance and controls in place.
  • Quality, Security and Compliance: Make sure platform patterns support enterprise expectations for security, privacy and consent, accessibility, performance, SEO and regulatory compliance in a highly regulated environment.
  • Technical Guidance and Issue Resolution: Be the go-to technical expert for website teams, help resolve complex platform and integration issues, and use what you learn to drive lasting fixes and platform improvements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience, with 10+ years in web engineering and architecture, including 5+ years working hands-on with enterprise CMS or digital experience platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with more than one enterprise CMS, including Adobe Experience Manager (ideally Edge Delivery Services, formerly Franklin) and at least one of Drupal or a headless CMS such as Sanity or Contentful.
  • Proven experience leading, or playing a key technical role in, a CMS evaluation, selection or replatforming effort.
  • Strong development background, comfortable reading and writing code in GitHub repositories and building working prototypes quickly.
  • Solid knowledge of web architecture, front-end technologies, APIs, CI/CD, CDNs and third-party integrations such as analytics, consent, identity, forms and CRM.
  • Experience turning business and delivery needs into clear technical and platform requirements, and working with infrastructure, product and vendor teams to get them delivered.
  • Practical understanding of web security, privacy and consent, accessibility, performance and SEO.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with AI-assisted content authoring, LLM-based tooling, or building and consuming MCP servers.
  • Experience with Adobe Edge Delivery Services authoring options, including Document Authoring (DA.live).
  • Experience building multi-site platforms, site factories or internal developer tooling, including automated testing.
  • Experience in a regulated industry, ideally life sciences or pharma, including patient and HCP websites.
  • Experience working in a large, federated enterprise with multiple platform and delivery teams.

TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE

  • CMS and DXP: Adobe Experience Manager (Edge Delivery Services, DA.live), Drupal, headless CMS such as Sanity or Contentful.
  • Front end: JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS; modern frameworks such as React or Next.js.
  • Platform and delivery: Git and GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, CDNs, cloud hosting (AWS or Azure), automated testing.
  • Integrations: REST and GraphQL APIs, analytics, consent management, identity, forms and CRM.
  • AI: LLM-based content tooling, MCP (build and consume), AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You are an architect who still enjoys writing code, and you are happy to dig into a repo to prove a point
  • You can evaluate a new technology quickly and give a clear, honest recommendation backed by a working prototype
  • You can influence technology choices with engineers, infrastructure teams and senior leaders, often without formal authority
  • You think about how to scale, automate and operate a platform, not just how to build a single site
  • You set high standards for code quality, performance, accessibility and security, and seek continuous improvement
  • You can explain complex technical topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • You have solid analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • You have a customer-first mindset and build strong relationships with clients and partner teams
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • You actively seek out things outside your comfort zone and learn new concepts and technologies quickly
  • You have prior experience in consulting
  • Prior experience and connections in the Life Sciences industry is preferred
Thank you for your interest in a career with Appnovation Technologies! Please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
At Appnovation, we recognize that diverse teams are the strongest teams. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is not only something that we embrace - we celebrate it! We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage applicants from all backgrounds, lived experiences and industries to apply. Come join us at Appnovation, and learn more about how we stay true to our company values as we build better lives through better digital.

title: Intelligence Operations Assistant, Part-Time (Remote)
description:
Are you interested in joining an organization with a global reach? In a world of shifting threats, Concentric is your trusted ally. Powered by elite professionals from military, government, and intelligence backgrounds. If you are passionate about intelligence, risk analysis, threat management, executive protection, security operations, or business resiliency, Concentric may be the organization you’ve been searching for!

Concentric is a risk consultancy specializing in delivering strategic security and intelligence services. We provide holistic, intelligent security solutions for private clients and corporations globally. Concentric offers strategic advisory services, risk assessments, physical protection, threat intelligence, open-source monitoring, program audits, secure embedded staffing, and training for security teams and intelligence analysts.

Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:

Integrity – Collaboration - Relationships – Excellence – Creativity - Results

Join Us,

Concentric - "Your World Secured"

We are currently seeking to hire an Intelligence Operations Assistant to join our Corporate team! This is a remote position open to those based within the United States.

*This is a part-time, non-exempt position of 20 hours per week. The schedule is flexible, with a preference for consistent, scheduled hours during the US business day.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Positions on Concentric’s Global Intelligence Services team require excellent organizational and editorial skills, the ability to communicate clearly and effectively, the ability to work effectively as a member of a multi-disciplinary team, and a strong commitment to our guiding principles: integrity, collaboration, relationships, excellence, creativity, and results.

The Intelligence Operations Assistant frees analysts and Product Owners from mechanical editing and project tracking so they can focus on analysis. This position edits intelligence products after Product Owner quality control and before Director review, tracks deliverables across the division, and handles the operational coordination that keeps engagements on schedule. The role primarily supports Intelligence Analysis and also supports Intelligence Collections and Embedded Intelligence as needed.

The successful candidate is a problem solver who designs efficient workflows, works quickly and precisely, and stays highly organized amid competing deadlines. This is an internal-facing role with no direct client contact.

*This is a part-time, non-exempt position of 20 hours per week. The schedule is flexible, with a preference for consistent, scheduled hours during the US business day.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Editorial Review

  • Proofread final products for accuracy, consistency, and presentation.

ERA and Project Support

  • Follow up with analysts to collect outstanding inputs.
  • Assemble final deliverable packages for review.

Division Operations

  • Coordinate calendars and meetings for Global Intelligence Services.
  • Maintain division distribution lists.
  • Coordinate onboarding logistics for new team members.
  • Support vendor and subscription administration.
  • Support timecard and expense processing.

Workflow and Reporting

  • Pull capacity and task data from Monday.com to support staffing and leadership reporting.
  • Identify process bottlenecks and build efficient workflows across Monday.com, Google Docs, and other division tools.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in intelligence or a related field.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills, with strong attention to detail.
  • Extremely organized, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines across teams.
  • Proven problem solver who works efficiently and builds streamlined workflows.
  • Experience with Monday.com and Google Docs.
  • Reliable, conscientious teammate with strong communication skills and a proven ability to meet deadlines.
  • This position requires the ability to travel up to 5% of the time

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in the security, government, or military field.
  • Project coordination experience or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

title: Lead Night Sleep Technologist - RPSGT
description:
About the role

The Lead Nighttime Sleep Technologist plays a vital role by bridging the gap between daytime management and nighttime laboratory operations. This position is dedicated to mentoring, coaching, and developing night shift technologists, aligning night operations with company culture, values, and clinical standards.


In addition to acquiring high-quality nocturnal sleep studies, the Lead Nighttime Sleep Tech acts as the primary overnight contact for technical troubleshooting, ensures accurate execution of provider orders and specialized research/Nox-related testing projects, assists with staff evaluations, and maintains facility standards to support overall patient satisfaction and clinical excellence.


What you'll do

  • Perform polysomnographic testing and patient care in strict accordance with physician orders, clinical guidelines, special requests, and AASM standards.
  • Act as the first line of support overnight for technical troubleshooting, equipment issues, and operational questions from night staff.
  • Ensure assigned research studies (e.g. Nox-related testing initiatives, and special clinical projects) are executed accurately and completed according to protocols.
  • Maintain high attention to detail regarding the “tech shift report,” patient charts, provider orders, and study documentation. Perform sleep study scoring as needed, particularly to support titrations, split protocols or next-day MSLT testing decisions.
  • Maintain high standards of patient care, service and comfort, ensuring a positive onsite patient experience in the sleep lab.
  • Conduct regular facility assessments to ensure patient rooms, control room, staff common areas and equipment are clean, fully functional, and in good condition. Promptly report maintenance issues or equipment damage.
  • Oversee overnight inventory usage, including all testing related supplies, PAP titration mask availability and linen usage.
  • Assist lab management with maintaining compliance for AASM accreditation, quality assurance metrics, and preparation for site inspections.

Qualifications

  • Registered Polysomnographic Technologist (RPSGT)
  • Certified in Basic Cardiac Life Support
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., respiratory therapy, nursing, or health sciences) preferred.
  • Minimum of 2-3 years experience in sleep technology relating to polysomnography, multiple sleep latency tests, positive airway pressure titrations, oximetry and end tidal studies on pediatrics; a preference for leadership or supervisory roles.
  • Demonstrated potential or background in peer leadership, coaching, or clinical instruction.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, proficiency in sleep study equipment, and knowledge of sleep disorders and treatments; must also be computer literate with excellent knowledge of sleep testing software, EHR experience and communication tools (e.g. Gmail, Slack etc.)

title: Software Engineer, Supercomputer Network (Starlink)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, SUPERCOMPUTER NETWORK (STARLINK)

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

We design, build, and operate the largest AI supercomputers in the world, from the ground up. As a member of the Platform Core team, you will be responsible for the lowest layers of the software stack on the devices setting the pace for how fast we can push the frontier of AI. Our team’s software interfaces directly with the core hardware of the supercomputer and its network fabric.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build and maintain the lean, high-reliability Linux-based operating system that underpins our supercomputer network fabric and Starlink laser mesh of satellites.
  • Write (or rewrite) high-performance device drivers to extract the maximum physical capability from our network and compute hardware.
  • Manage deployment, operation, and debugging of our platform in production, including:
    • Rigorous resolution and root-causing of anomalies to ensure the system is constantly improving in reliability.
    • Developing and constantly improving our tools for observability and configuration management.
  • Collaborate with our hardware teams and external partners to design the next generation of supercomputer hardware and then bring up our OS and software stack on it.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, math, or science discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience in software development in lieu of a degree (internship experience is applicable).
  • Hands-on system programming experience in C or C++.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel and its networking stack or experience with another production-grade kernel.
  • Proficiency with debugging tools spanning kernel, network, and userspace (e.g., ftrace, perf, Wireshark/tcpdump, eBPF, gdb, and more).
  • Experience bringing up new hardware from scratch — you have flashed bare-metal software on a microcontroller with JTAG, or bootstrapped a Linux kernel and rootfs on new hardware.
  • Demonstrated track record of developing and optimizing device/peripheral drivers ideally for high-speed interfaces, or with advanced considerations like DMA and cache coherency.
  • Understanding of major peripheral hardware interface standards (Ethernet, PCIe, I2C, SPI, etc.) — you can critically review a schematic, and debug these interfaces if needed.
  • Experience with product security, OS/system hardening, and secure boot schemes.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $125,000.00 - $165,000.00
Level 2: $145,000.00 - $200,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

title: Junior Yellow Ball Tennis Director
description:
WEYMOUTH CLUB-Junior Yellow Ball Tennis Director Job Description


Position: Junior Yellow Ball Tennis Director

Supervisor: Director of Racquet Sports


Overview: The Yellow Ball Director is passionate about helping junior players grow in a family friendly environment. This role drives player development focusing on skill-building, competitive performance, and long-term success within the program. They work with players as a mentor and leader, guiding them through their competitive pathway and staying hands-on in their development to help each player reach their full potential. They lead and manage the yellow ball racquets staff, fostering a strong team environment built on collaboration and shared purpose. They build strong, trusted relationships with players and their parents to support a positive culture. The director will have an admin to support day-to-day program operations and relationships.


Court Responsibilities:

· Lead and instruct all Junior Yellow Ball Clinics: Junior Tournament Training, Tournament Training Academy, Varsity Clinic, Player Development and Fast Track Tennis.

· Create curriculum for all junior tennis programs that fall outside of the Red Orange Green program. Communicate this to the racquets staff and the parents. Implement clearly and consistently.

· Lead special events that pertain to all Junior Yellow Ball and any other group assigned by the Director of Tennis.

· Work with front desk to manage utility usage-lights and heat.

· Assist with facility and court maintenance responsibilities.

· Play in all pro-am events and exhibitions.

· Know all lesson cancellation policies so club or pro does not lose income.


Yellow Ball and High Performance Director Responsibilities:

· Develop a team that values relationships with juniors and parents.

· Increase the yearly net income of Yellow ball, Junior Tournament Training, Tournament Training Academy, Varsity Clinic, Player Development and Fast Track Tennis programs.

· Work with the Tennis Director to set short, medium, and long-term benchmarks for all Junior Yellow Ball clinics

· Oversee Junior Yellow Ball operations including recruitment, registration coordination with the administrative manager, attendance tracking, promotion, staff scheduling, drop-in charges, and refunds.

· Make final approval of placement for participants in Yellow ball with your 3-coach panel for Junior Tournament Training, Tournament Training Academy, Varsity Clinic, Player Development and Fast Track Tennis.

· Coordinate with your coaches and with the parents a tournament schedule for each participant of the program (all levels). Keep track of the schedules and make sure players are being trained with their tournament schedules in mind.

· Coordinate sending coaches to tournaments.

· Coordinate signups for all players in Yellow ball, Junior Tournament Training, Tournament Training Academy, Varsity Clinic, Player Development and Fast Track Tennis about match play and set up the matches to keep them coming on a regular basis.

· Communicate to all players in Yellow ball, Junior Tournament Training, Tournament Training Academy, Varsity Clinic, Player Development and Fast Track Tennis about special events, new sessions, make-ups, program cancellations and moving of courts.

· Be at least one month ahead of all promotion with pamphlets, flyers, and brochures for programming. Work with Racquets Director to have this completed on time.

· Assist in participation for all website updates, newsletters, and articles for high performance participants.

· Create, promote and carry out monthly junior events (team play, cardio, 105)

· Maintain photo bulletin board with tournament winners and social media posts with admin assistance

· Design and execute a robust offsite TTA Camp at Thayer Academy

· Goal setting and follow through with high performance students and their parents

· Evaluations for each player twice per year with parent follow up

· Hold parent welcome meeting at the start of the year that includes educating parents on USTA, UTR, etc.

· Host banquet at conclusion of the program

· Post program follow up calls to parents

· Work with TFA Director to make sure all camp license requirements are met for the off-site and on-site HP camps.


Additional Responsibilities:

· Adhere to the Pro Standard Agreement and embody Weymouth Club core values at all times

· Attend and be on time for regularly scheduled staff meetings and professional development days.

· Be consistent with the times you have given to the Tennis Director for being at your desk for administration and face time.

· Return all emails and phone calls within 24 hours.

· Write and submit weekly reports for General Manager, Director of Racquet Sports and Club Owner by 5 pm every Monday.

· Maintain accurate payroll hours.

· Accept and complete any special assignments from the Tennis Director.

· Attend yearly performance reviews.

· Work with the ROG director to identify future high performance players


Design and Operate From A Yellow Ball & Camp Playbook:

Content examples of a playbook would be annual calendar with important dates, parent meetings, special events, ranking standards, marketing/packaging, pro trainings for quality control, registration bags, pricing strategies, transitional plan indoor to outdoor, etc.


Requirements For Hours:

· 20 hours per week for Director/administrative work. This includes on-court observation/participation of the various programs the Director is responsible for.

There is not a limitation of teaching hours as long as the 20 hours a week of Director/administrative work is completed.

Whether your background is rooted in power & energy, utilities, or land development, we're looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems, and helping teams succeed.

If you're the type of professional who is always looking for the next challenge, enjoys mentoring others, and takes pride in delivering exceptional work, we'd love to connect.

What You'll Do

As a Survey Project Manager, you'll serve as a trusted leader for both clients and project teams, helping guide projects from initial planning through final delivery.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing multiple survey projects simultaneously while maintaining quality, schedule, and budget expectations
  • Leading survey efforts for utility, renewable energy, commercial, and land development projects
  • Collaborating with engineers, project managers, field crews, contractors, and external stakeholders to drive successful outcomes
  • Reviewing survey deliverables, project scope, schedules, and resource allocation
  • Managing project financials, including budgets, forecasting, and overall project performance
  • Serving as a key point of contact for clients and helping foster long-term partnerships
  • Providing mentorship and technical guidance to survey staff and emerging professionals
  • Supporting a collaborative, team-first culture where knowledge sharing and professional growth are encouraged
  • Identifying challenges early, developing solutions, and keeping projects moving forward

What We're Looking For

We're more interested in capability, leadership potential, and mindset than checking every box.

Ideal candidates will bring:

  • Experience managing survey projects and coordinating multidisciplinary teams
  • Strong understanding of surveying principles, project execution, and client management
  • Experience with utility, power & energy, renewable energy, land development, or infrastructure projects
  • Ability to independently manage multiple projects and competing priorities
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with clients and stakeholders
  • Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D, Trimble Business Center, or similar survey technologies
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a desire to continuously learn and grow

Bonus Points For

  • Experience supporting utility, energy, or infrastructure-related projects
  • Experience with solar, renewable energy, transmission, substation, or utility corridor projects
  • Professional Land Surveyor (PLS/RLS) licensure

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

This isn't a role where you'll simply inherit projects and maintain the status quo.

You'll have the opportunity to build relationships, influence project strategy, mentor talented team members, and contribute to some of the most exciting infrastructure and renewable energy projects in the region.

We're looking for someone who wants to do meaningful work, take on bigger challenges, and grow alongside an organization that's continuing to expand its presence in the power, energy, and renewable markets.

You'll Excel Here If You:

  • Take ownership and follow through
  • Enjoy solving problems that don't have obvious answers
  • Like balancing technical work with client interaction
  • Get energy from mentoring and supporting others
  • Are motivated by growth, responsibility, and continuous improvement
  • See change and complexity as opportunities, not obstacles

If you're ready to lead impactful projects, expand your expertise, and help shape the future of energy and infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Daytime Sleep Technologist - RPSGT
description:
About the role

The Daytime Sleep Technologist is responsible for performing daytime sleep studies (MSLT, MWT, Daytime PSG) and supporting the daily operations of the sleep lab. This role involves direct patient care, continuous monitoring, data scoring, and ensuring compliance with protocols. The Daytime Sleep Technologist will also assist with equipment calibration, patient education, and maintaining lab cleanliness and inventory.

The Daytime Sleep Technologist is also responsible for implementing sleep center-specific action plans of the Lab Manager, Medical Director or Chief Medical Officer.


What you'll do

  • Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients and patient needs, including pre-study preparation for polysomnography in the evening.
  • Oversee and ensure the accurate and efficient sleep study acquisition, including monitoring patients and troubleshooting equipment issues.
  • Review and analyze sleep study data, scoring and preparing detailed reports for physicians.
  • Provide education to patients and their families regarding sleep disorders and treatment options.
  • Work closely with physicians, referring specialists, and other healthcare professionals to develop and implement patient care plans.
  • Prepare and hook up patients for sleep studies, ensuring proper sensor placement and patient comfort.
  • Perform daytime sleep studies (i.e., MSLT, MWT, PSG) and maintain continuous patient monitoring throughout testing.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory standards and internal protocols, conduct regular quality checks on equipment and procedures; perform monthly calibration of PAP, end tidal equipment and ensure that the oxygen equipment is checked and documented monthly/quarterly as required; maintain biomedical equipment in accordance with manufacturers’ and AASM guidelines.
  • Perform weekly assessment and documentation of the facility to verify that all patient rooms (e.g. equipment, furniture, restrooms, floors, walls, TV’s etc.), control room (e.g. computers, computer peripherals, desks etc.), patient lobby and other staff areas are in good condition and functional.
  • Complete inventory and linen counts.
  • Scoring sleep studies when there are no sleep studies as needed.
  • Attend staff meetings.
  • Assist lab team with AASM re-accreditation process and site visits.
  • Assist lab team with Nox equipment, software and workflow testing as needed.

Qualifications

  • Registered Polysomnographic Technologist (RPSGT)
  • Certified in Basic Cardiac Life Support
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., respiratory therapy, nursing, or health sciences) preferred.
  • Minimum of 2-3 years experience in sleep technology relating to polysomnography, multiple sleep latency tests, positive airway pressure titrations, oximetry and end tidal studies on pediatrics.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, proficiency in sleep study equipment, and knowledge of sleep disorders and treatments; must also be computer literate with excellent knowledge of Google Workspace, MS Office or equivalent software.
