title: Government and Community Relations Manager
description:
Help Pacifico build lasting relationships with the communities where we develop and operate energy infrastructure. Reporting to Kevin Pratt, you will lead community engagement and good neighbor programs from early development through construction and ongoing operations. You will turn local concerns into practical solutions, represent Pacifico in public settings, and coordinate delivery of the commitments we make to our neighbors.


What you get to do:

  • Design and implement good neighbor programs tailored to each project, using community input to shape practical benefits, communication plans, and ways to address local impacts.
  • Build trusted relationships with neighbors, community organizations, local officials, and other stakeholders; maintain a clear understanding of their priorities and concerns.
  • Represent Pacifico at neighborhood meetings, community forums, and local government meetings. Prepare clear presentations and respond to difficult questions with accurate, accessible information.
  • Negotiate community commitments and agreements in partnership with Kevin, Legal, and project leaders, aligning proposed terms with project needs, budgets, and approval requirements.

  • Partner with Development and Permitting, Construction, and Operations to incorporate community feedback into project planning and maintain continuity as projects move between teams.
  • Manage community inquiries and complaints, coordinate timely responses with technical teams, and escalate unresolved issues or emerging risks with recommended actions.
  • Track local government activity and community sentiment affecting projects; brief leadership on risks, engagement progress, and decisions needed, and coordinate external advisers where appropriate.


What you bring to the role:

  • Experience owning community relations, government affairs, or stakeholder engagement for energy, infrastructure, industrial development, or similarly complex projects.
  • A track record of designing and delivering community or good neighbor programs that address local priorities and support workable project outcomes.
  • Confident public speaking and clear writing, with experience presenting at community or public meetings and explaining technical topics to nontechnical audiences.
  • Demonstrated negotiation and conflict resolution skills, including working through opposition and reaching practical agreements with communities or local stakeholders.
  • Strong follow-through in administering commitments, tracking budgets and obligations, and coordinating delivery across project, legal, and operating teams.
  • Knowledge of local government decision-making and public engagement processes, sound judgment about when to involve legal or technical specialists, and availability for project travel and occasional evening community meetings.

title: Manager / Senior Manager, Quality Assurance
description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with neffy®, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you’re motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

This is a hands-on role that will work an onsite hybrid schedule at our San Diego corporate office in the Carmel Valley area. The Manager / Senior Manager Quality Assurance owns batch disposition and product complaint management for products made at our contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs). You will review executed batch records, drive deviations and investigations to closure, and run the complaint process end to end so that every lot released meets cGMP and regulatory requirements. This is a hands-on role working daily with CMO quality teams, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Medical Affairs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Batch record review and disposition

  • Review executed batch records, packaging records, and certificates of analysis from CMOs for accuracy, completeness, and cGMP compliance.
  • Verify that deviations, OOS/OOT results, and change controls tied to each lot are closed or properly assessed before release.
  • Prepare lot disposition packages and recommend release, rejection, or quarantine; act as QA approver per delegation.
  • Review master batch records and specifications for new and revised products.
  • Track batch release timelines and partner with Supply Chain to meet commercial and clinical supply needs.

Product complaint management

  • Own the product complaint process: intake, triage, CMO investigation requests, trending, and closure within defined timelines.
  • Assess complaints for reportability (e.g., Field Alert Reports, MDRs for combination products) with Regulatory and Pharmacovigilance.
  • Lead or support root cause investigations and confirm CAPAs are effective.
  • Prepare complaint trend reports for management review and Annual Product Reviews.

CMO Quality Oversight

  • Serve as day-to-day QA contact for assigned CMOs and testing labs.
  • Review and approve CMO deviations, investigations, change controls, and CAPAs affecting our products.
  • Manage quality agreements and quality metrics; join business reviews and person-in-plant visits as needed.
  • Support CMO audits and regulatory inspections.

GMP compliance and quality systems

  • Maintain compliance with 21 CFR Parts 210/211, 21 CFR Part 4 (combination products), ICH Q7–Q10, and EU GMP as applicable.
  • Author and revise SOPs for batch disposition and complaint handling.
  • Contribute to Annual Product Reviews, recall readiness, and inspection readiness.
  • Lead process improvements, and represent QA on cross-functional project teams.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Quality judgment: makes sound, documented release and reportability decisions under time pressure.
  • Partner management: holds CMOs to standards while keeping relationships productive.
  • Communication: writes clear investigation summaries and explains risk to non-QA colleagues.
  • Ownership: tracks open items to closure without being chased.
  • Primarily office-based work with occasional travel to CMO sites, including time in GMP manufacturing areas with gowning. Occasional after-hours support for urgent complaints or release needs.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Required

  • Preferred Bachelor's degree in chemistry, biology, pharmacy, engineering, or related science. An acceptable combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered
  • Minimum of 6+ years of QA experience
  • Hands-on batch record review and lot disposition for commercial pharmaceutical or combination products.
  • Direct experience managing product complaints, deviations, and CAPAs.
  • Working knowledge of cGMP (21 CFR 210/211), ICH guidelines, and FDA expectations.
  • Experience overseeing CMOs or external testing labs in a virtual or outsourced model.
  • Strong technical writing and attention to detail.

Preferred

  • Drug-device combination product experience (21 CFR Part 4, 820 / QMSR).
  • Sterile, nasal, or inhalation dosage form experience.
  • Electronic QMS experience (e.g., Veeva Vault QualityDocs/QMS, MasterControl).
  • ASQ certification (CQA, CQE, or CPGP).

title: Web Developer, Artificial Intelligence Assisted Development
description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a growing technology company that helps businesses increase their visibility and revenue through modern websites, search engine optimization, and generative engine optimization. The company builds high-performance websites and develops tools that help businesses compete across traditional search engines and artificial intelligence platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and other emerging search experiences. They are a dynamic team focused on delivering top-notch technology and design.

About the Company

They're a growing technology company helping businesses increase their visibility and revenue through modern websites, search engine optimization, and generative engine optimization.

They build high-performance websites and develop tools that help businesses compete across traditional search engines and artificial intelligence platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and other emerging search experiences.

They're looking for a talented Web Developer with strong coding fundamentals who embraces artificial intelligence assisted development and can take ownership of website deployments, ongoing maintenance, and improvements across their growing portfolio of customer websites.

About the Role

This is a hands-on, part-time position for an experienced developer who knows how to write, understand, and troubleshoot code independently while using modern artificial intelligence tools to work more efficiently.

Cursor is a central part of their development workflow, and the developer will be encouraged to use it extensively to accelerate development. However, this is a coding position, not a prompt-only development role. Candidates must have a strong foundation in traditional web development and be capable of writing, reviewing, debugging, and modifying code without relying entirely on artificial intelligence.

The developer should understand how websites are structured, how the underlying code works, and how to identify and correct problems when artificial intelligence generated solutions are incomplete or incorrect.

The developer will work directly with the company's co-founders, with technical oversight from their Chief Technology Officer, who is also a co-founder. Primary responsibilities will focus on deploying new customer websites, maintaining existing websites, implementing updates, and resolving technical issues.

This role is focused on customer-facing website development and management rather than building or modifying the company's internal backend systems.

They're looking for someone who produces clean, professional code, communicates clearly, responds quickly, and can independently manage multiple website projects.

What You'll Do

  • Build, deploy, maintain, and improve customer websites using Cursor, GitHub, Netlify, and other modern development tools.
  • Write, review, debug, and maintain website code, using Cursor to accelerate development while ensuring all code meets professional standards.
  • Independently identify and resolve coding issues, including problems that cannot be solved through artificial intelligence generated suggestions alone.
  • Manage GitHub repositories, including creating and managing branches, committing changes, reviewing differences, resolving merge conflicts, and managing pull requests.
  • Handle website deployments through Netlify, including configuration, domain management, deployment troubleshooting, and hosting maintenance.
  • Implement website updates, new pages, design adjustments, integrations, and ongoing customer requests.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve website functionality issues, broken integrations, deployment errors, and performance problems.
  • Follow web security best practices, including secure configuration, dependency management, access controls, and protection of sensitive information.
  • Maintain clean, organized, well-structured, and professional code across customer projects.
  • Collaborate with the company's leadership to prioritize customer requests, meet deadlines, and maintain high standards of quality.
  • Ensure websites are responsive, fast, accessible, and compatible across modern browsers and devices.
  • Manage technical aspects of website launches, including domain configuration, redirects, forms, and third-party integrations.
  • Review and validate artificial intelligence generated code before deployment to ensure accuracy, security, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Respond promptly to technical requests, communicate project status clearly, and proactively identify potential issues.

What You'll Need

  • Strong professional experience in website development, including the ability to write and troubleshoot code independently.
  • Solid proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web development practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand website architecture, code structure, application logic, and development best practices.
  • Experience using Cursor or similar artificial intelligence assisted development environments to improve coding efficiency.
  • Strong proficiency with GitHub, including repository management, branching strategies, pull requests, merging, conflict resolution, and version control.
  • Hands-on experience with Netlify for website hosting, deployments, domain management, and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to independently review, debug, modify, and improve code generated through artificial intelligence tools.
  • Strong understanding of website security principles and best practices.
  • Experience integrating website forms, analytics platforms, tracking scripts, and third-party services.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently and implement reliable solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to writing clean, professional, maintainable code.
  • Excellent communication skills, fast response times, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Astro Static Site Generator and static website architecture.
  • Familiarity with search engine optimization best practices, including technical website performance, structured data, redirects, and metadata.
  • Experience working with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Google Search Console.
  • Experience with custom domains, domain name system configuration, secure connections, and website migrations.
  • Experience managing multiple customer websites simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with modern website performance optimization and Core Web Vitals.

Technology Stack

The company operates on a modern website development stack, including:

  • Cursor for artificial intelligence assisted development and code editing.
  • GitHub for version control, repository management, and collaboration.
  • Netlify for website hosting, deployment, and domain management.
  • Astro Static Site Generator for building fast, high-performance websites.
  • Internal tools for website management, reporting, and customer operations.

Experience with Cursor, GitHub, and Netlify is especially important. Familiarity with Astro is a strong advantage, although they're open to candidates with experience in similar modern frameworks who can learn their environment quickly.

What They're Looking For

They want a developer who combines strong coding skills with an artificial intelligence forward approach to development.

The ideal candidate is a capable web developer first and an effective user of artificial intelligence development tools second. The candidate should know how to code without Cursor, but recognize how tools like Cursor can make them significantly faster and more productive.

They're not looking for someone whose development experience is limited to prompting artificial intelligence tools and accepting the resulting code. The candidate must be able to understand what is being built, evaluate the quality of the code, identify potential problems, and make technical decisions independently.

The candidate should be comfortable taking a customer website request from initial requirements through development, testing, and production deployment with minimal oversight.

Responsiveness and reliability are particularly important. They work with a growing number of customers, and they need someone who communicates quickly, follows through on commitments, and takes pride in delivering clean, dependable work.

The developer will work closely with the company's co-founders, receive technical guidance from their Chief Technology Officer, and play an important role in delivering and maintaining the websites that power their customers' businesses.

Schedule

  • Hours: 20 to 30 hours per week
  • Location: Fully remote
  • Flexibility: Flexible scheduling, with an expectation of strong availability, prompt communication, and timely completion of customer requests

title: Entrepreneurship Program Lead
description:
About the role


Farm & Forge is seeking an exceptional entrepreneur, educator, and program builder to own our Entrepreneurship Program end-to-end, designing, launching, operating, and growing it. As the program's sole dedicated leader, this individual will oversee daily programming, coach each student, manage operations, develop partnerships, support recruitment, and communicate with families and leadership.

This is not a traditional business-teaching position or classroom job. Students will not study entrepreneurship through textbooks or hypothetical projects. They will identify real opportunities, create or acquire businesses, work with customers, manage finances, use emerging technology, and build companies that generate actual revenue. No additional hires are planned. The successful candidate will own both the vision and day-to-day execution.

Our ideal candidate has built a real business, something customers paid for. However, that is not the only path. Experience running a side business, selling freelance or consulting work, helping operate a family business, carrying revenue responsibility, or coaching students who successfully launched and sold something is also valuable. What is essential is real experience selling something, a belief that young people can build real businesses, and the ability to lead this program independently.

The goal of the program is straightforward: Graduates will have identified a problem worth solving, built or acquired a business around it, gained paying customers, and demonstrated measurable results. Revenue matters because it proves the business is real, but judgment, character, and financial literacy are equally important. A program where no student business makes a sale has not achieved its purpose.


What you'll do


Program Design and Leadership

  • Build and lead the program from the ground up, including curriculum, operating systems, project expectations, assessment methods, annual calendar, and a multi-year progression from opportunity identification through building, validation, growth, and scale.
  • Set measurable standards for participation, skills, customer activity, revenue, and profitability, and hold students accountable to them.
  • Manage the program budget, tools, subscriptions, and events, continuously refining the program based on student outcomes and feedback.

Student Coaching and Instruction

  • Lead daily programming for a small, selective cohort, coaching each student as they create, acquire, launch, and operate real businesses.
  • Teach practical skills as they are needed, including opportunity evaluation, market research, business models, sales, marketing, operations, accounting, negotiation, and professional communication.
  • Help students build pro formas, pricing models, sales plans, and pitch materials.
  • Hold students accountable for deadlines, commitments, ethical conduct, and measurable progress while fostering a culture of initiative, resilience, responsible risk-taking, and high standards.

Venture Development

  • Guide students from idea to a functioning business with real products or services and paying customers.
  • Help students determine when to create a new venture, acquire an existing business, or improve a family business, testing ideas quickly and making decisions based on evidence rather than assumptions.
  • Regularly review student financials, customer pipelines, and business performance.
  • Help students responsibly use AI and AI agents, coding, robotics, video, digital marketing, and Farm & Forge's maker and STEM resources to build businesses more efficiently.
  • Ensure students retain appropriate ownership of the businesses and intellectual property they create, subject to applicable agreements and legal requirements.

Mentorship and Community Partnerships

  • Recruit entrepreneurs, business owners, investors, attorneys, accountants, and marketers to support student ventures.
  • Coordinate guest speakers, mentors, judges, and partners without relying on them to operate the program.
  • Identify local businesses offering student projects, acquisition opportunities, customers, or real-world learning experiences.
  • Prepare students to communicate professionally with customers and partners while representing Farm & Forge in the regional business community.

Recruitment, Marketing, and Enrollment

  • Document what students are building, including launches, milestones, failures, and sales, providing families with authentic evidence of progress and supplying marketing with meaningful stories.
  • Partner with marketing on messaging and recruitment, help establish enrollment goals, and share responsibility for developing a strong pipeline of prospective students.
  • Support student selection to ensure each cohort is motivated, capable, and a strong fit for the program.
  • Participate in recruitment events, family meetings, and tours.

Program Operations and Accountability

  • Maintain organized records of student goals, milestones, revenue, expenses, customers, and progress.
  • Build and maintain a Founder Dashboard that provides students, families, and leadership with an honest view of each student's progress and venture performance.
  • Provide regular written updates to families and the Executive Director of Academics.
  • Establish and enforce appropriate safeguards for minors operating real businesses, including financial controls, contracts and signing authority, online activity, taxes, safety, privacy, and customer interactions. Students perform the work while adults maintain legal responsibility.

Measures of Success

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • Successful launch and consistent operation of a high-quality program with established calendars, systems, and standards.
  • Achievement of annual recruitment and enrollment goals, supported by a strong pipeline of qualified students.
  • Every student operating a live venture with real customer discovery and sales, with paying customers and accurate financial records by the end of year one.
  • Demonstrated mastery of entrepreneurial skills, including opportunity evaluation, selling, unit economics, and communication, along with growth in professionalism and independence.
  • Strong satisfaction and confidence among students, families, mentors, and leadership, with continued growth in program reputation, demand, and retention.

Revenue is an important measure of authentic progress, but not the only one. Judgment, character, communication, financial literacy, and resilience are equally important indicators of success.


Qualifications

  • Real experience with customers and revenue, including starting, acquiring, operating, or growing a business; running a side business; selling freelance or consulting services; helping operate a family business; holding revenue or P&L responsibility; or coaching students who successfully launched and sold something.
  • Practical understanding of sales, marketing, finance, operations, and strategy developed through hands-on experience.
  • Ability to coach young people with clear standards and accountability.
  • Experience independently managing a business, program, or team without a large support staff, with the ability to oversee multiple student ventures simultaneously.
  • Strong organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills, including experience speaking with prospective families and representing programs publicly.
  • Proficiency with modern business technology and AI tools, with an understanding of responsible use.
  • Sound judgment, high integrity, and a commitment to ethical business practices.
  • Ability to pass all required background checks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a founder, small-business owner, startup operator, executive, investor, or consultant.
  • Experience coaching, mentoring, or teaching middle- or high-school students, or working in an accelerator, incubator, or project-based learning environment.
  • Experience with business acquisition, recruitment, or program growth.
  • A public body of work, such as writing, video, an established following, or documented business launches.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. An advanced degree is welcome but not required. No teaching certificate is required.


Benefits


Farm and Forge offers comprehensive benefits that support our team's health and well-being. These include:

  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Company-sponsored Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match
  • Ongoing Training and Development
  • Team Outings

title: Embedded Software Engineer, Laser Mesh Routing (Starlink)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

EMBEDDED SOFTWARE ENGINEER, LASER MESH ROUTING (STARLINK)

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

We design, build, and operate the largest AI supercomputers in the world, from the ground up. As a member of the Platform Core team, you will be responsible for the lowest layers of the software stack on the devices setting the pace for how fast we can push the frontier of AI. Our team’s software interfaces directly with the core hardware of the supercomputer and its network fabric.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build and maintain the lean, high-reliability Linux-based operating system that underpins our supercomputer network fabric and Starlink laser mesh of satellites.
  • Write (or rewrite) high-performance device drivers to extract the maximum physical capability from our network and compute hardware.
  • Manage deployment, operation, and debugging of our platform in production, including:
    • Rigorous resolution and root-causing of anomalies to ensure the system is constantly improving in reliability.
    • Developing and constantly improving our tools for observability and configuration management.
  • Collaborate with our hardware teams and external partners to design the next generation of supercomputer hardware and then bring up our OS and software stack on it.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, math, or science discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience in software development in lieu of a degree (internship experience is applicable).
  • Hands-on system programming experience in C or C++.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel and its networking stack or experience with another production-grade kernel.
  • Proficiency with debugging tools spanning kernel, network, and userspace (e.g., ftrace, perf, Wireshark/tcpdump, eBPF, gdb, and more).
  • Experience bringing up new hardware from scratch — you have flashed bare-metal software on a microcontroller with JTAG, or bootstrapped a Linux kernel and rootfs on new hardware.
  • Demonstrated track record of developing and optimizing device/peripheral drivers ideally for high-speed interfaces, or with advanced considerations like DMA and cache coherency.

You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

title: Solutions Architect,  APAC
description:
What Do We Do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern commmerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it hurts your bottom line.

We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the only AI harness in commerce — Moby — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.

As a Solutions Architect at Triple Whale, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping how the most innovative ecommerce brands leverage our platform. We’re looking for a strategic problem-solver who can bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and real-world customer needs. You’ll be the go-to expert for architecting seamless integrations, optimizing data flows, and driving technical success across our most complex accounts. If you're passionate about solving hard problems, building scalable solutions, and making a tangible impact at a high-growth company, this is your opportunity to lead from the front.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the technical onboarding for our most complex customers, managing integration of Triple Whale’s APIs, JS pixel, and server-side data flows
  • Collaborate with the customer's dev teams to ensure successful and timely deployment — acting as their dedicated technical point of contact
  • Develop implementation plans, surface best practices, and assist with light scripting (e.g., Python, SQL, API) to support custom use cases
  • Serve as an embedded technical partner to our Customer Success Managers, helping unblock and guide top accounts on product adoption, tracking setup, and advanced configurations
  • Participate in escalations requiring deep technical investigation — using debugging tools (e.g., Postman, DevTools, logs) to identify and resolve issues
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to provide feedback on gaps, blockers, and feature requests surfaced during implementation
  • Help design repeatable onboarding flows and reusable solution patterns to scale future complex integrations
  • Contribute to internal documentation, tooling, and enablement that helps the CS org become more self-sufficient over time

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in solutions/implementation engineering with strong customer-facing experience
  • Hands-on expertise with RESTful APIs, SQL, JavaScript (tracking/pixels), and light backend scripting (Python/Node)
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot integrations end-to-end — webhooks, pixels, API auth, and data flows — using tools like Postman, cURL, and DevTools
  • Strong communicator who can translate complex technical topics for both dev and non-technical audiences
  • Familiarity with ecommerce platforms (Shopify, attribution, LTV/ROAS) and modern cloud/network fundamentals
  • Track record of partnering with CS teams, gathering customer feedback, and managing multiple implementations simultaneously

Join Us in Making Waves

If you’re looking for more than just a job and want to be part of a movement reshaping the future of Ecommerce, Triple Whale is the place for you. We’re on the lookout for driven, curious, and creative individuals ready to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Assistant Beauty Team Leader - Main St (Mandarin Required)
description:
Position Overview

The Assistant Beauty Team Leader supports the Beauty Team Leader in the day-to-day execution and operations of the store’s Beauty area. Key responsibilities include assisting with product merchandising, replenishment and recovery, expiration-date checks, tester management, price label accuracy, promotional display maintenance, stockroom organization, receiving support, area cleanliness, customer service, and product recommendations.


Under the direction of the Store Manager, Assistant Store Manager, and Beauty Team Leader, the Assistant Beauty Team Leader helps coordinate and support employees in completing daily tasks while maintaining organized merchandising, accurate pricing, timely replenishment, cleanliness, and strong customer service standards.


The Assistant Beauty Team Leader also supports the Beauty Team Leader in coaching team members, communicating priorities, monitoring task completion, and maintaining overall operational standards within the Beauty department.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Beauty Area Merchandising & Shelf Management
    1. Responsible for shelving products, front-facing and filling gaps, category merchandising, shelf organization, and maintaining full shelves in the Beauty area.
    2. Ensure merchandise is neatly displayed, price labels are accurate, and POP/promotional labels are clear and current.
    3. Promptly correct out-of-stocks, misplaced items, incorrect price labels, disorganized displays, and similar issues, and report them to the Assistant Store Manager or Store Manager.
  3. Product Replenishment, Recovery & Inventory Feedback
    1. Complete daily replenishment, recovery, FIFO rotation, and product put-away as required.
    2. Monitor fast-selling items, out-of-stocks, slow-moving products, insufficient inventory, and excess stock; provide timely feedback and assist with adjustments.
    3. Keep aisles clear during replenishment; merchandise may not be placed directly on the floor, dragged, or allowed to obstruct customer traffic.
  5. Price Labels, Promotions & Promotional Display Maintenance
    1. Check that price labels are complete, centered, and legible, and ensure prices correspond to the correct products.
    2. Promptly remove or replace expired promotional, sale, POP, or promotional-display materials and confirm restoration.
    3. Support display adjustments for new products, promotions, and priority merchandise to improve the customer browsing and shopping experience.
  7. Product Expiration & Tester Management
    1. Check expiration dates of Beauty products as required and monitor near-expiration, damaged, contaminated, spoiled, or otherwise unsellable products.
    2. Maintain Tester cleanliness, placement, barcode covering, records, and disposal to prevent incorrect scanning, accidental sale, or management errors.
    3. Any expired product or Tester exception must be immediately removed from the sales floor, documented, and reported.
  9. Promotion Execution & Merchandising Optimization
    1. Execute Beauty promotions, new-product displays, priority-product promotions, and promotional-display adjustments.
    2. Monitor Beauty sales performance, customer feedback, fast-selling and slow-moving products, and recommend merchandising adjustments.
    3. Help ensure timely updates to promotional displays, sale labels, POP materials, promotional displays, and shelf presentations.
  11. Customer Service & Product Recommendations
    1. Lead by example in proactively welcoming customers, greeting them with a smile, and providing friendly service.
    2. Be familiar with priority products, new products, best sellers, and basic selling points within the area and provide basic product recommendations.
    3. Promptly escalate customer complaints, returns/exchanges, negative feedback, or issues that cannot be resolved.
  13. Team Member Coaching & On-site Execution Oversight
    1. Coach new employees in the area and help them learn product locations, replenishment standards, service language, and work processes.
    2. Assign team member tasks appropriately and oversee replenishment, recovery, cleanliness, price labels, stockroom organization, and related work.
    3. Promptly address and report team member issues involving discipline, service, execution, or teamwork.
  15. Work Records & Issue Feedback
    1. Participate in opening and closing meetings and communicate area priorities, promotions, replenishment arrangements, and corrective actions.
    2. Complete or assist with work records, expiration records, receiving-exception records, and corrective-action feedback on time.
    3. Assist the Assistant Store Manager and Store Manager in analyzing recurring issues and driving corrective actions.


Qualifications

  • Education: High school diploma / vocational secondary school or above.
  • Professional Experience: Experience in retail, supermarkets, convenience stores, beauty, collectible/toy retail, lifestyle retail, or service industries is preferred; candidates without experience may be trained.
  • Knowledge & Skills: Familiar with or willing to learn product merchandising, replenishment and recovery, price labels, expiration management, customer service, cleanliness, receiving organization, and basic work records.
  • Core Competencies: Strong execution and sense of responsibility, good service and attention to detail, and effective communication and teamwork skills.


Compensation

  • $23 per hour
  • Quarterly Performance Bonus: This position is eligible for a quarterly performance-based bonus, subject to the eligibility requirements, performance criteria, and terms of the Company's bonus program.


Benefits

  • 401(k) & 401(k) matching - subject to the eligibility requirements
  • Paid Sick Leave
  • Employee discount
  • Health insurance
  • Paid Time Off

title: Senior Strategist, Enterprise
description:
About the Role

As a Senior Strategist, Enterprise, you will work with global organizations as they transform for the AI era. Our clients are leaders in their industries, operating across markets worldwide, and we work with their C-suites and business leaders as well as the executives who run their AI, Product, Marketing, Design, and Data teams. The role operates on two fronts. First, you will help these enterprises build durable, organization-wide AI capability: the skills, processes, tools, and digital operating models their people need to work differently. On the second, you will advise senior leaders on the digital and AI innovation opportunities emerging in their industries, including how AI will reshape the products they build and the customer experiences they deliver.

This is transformation work, and at this level you will own significant parts of it. You will lead discovery, form a view on where a client stands and where they need to be, and shape the roadmap that gets them there. You follow developments in AI and digital technology closely and you can translate them into implications an executive will act on. Working across our teams, you will lead workstreams, facilitate workshops, produce the recommendations and materials that carry an engagement from first conversation to a committed program, and take an active role in growing your client relationships. You are comfortable leading conversations with executives, you can turn an ambiguous business problem into a structured point of view on your own, and you hold a high standard for the quality of the work.

Responsibilities

  • Build and deepen relationships with C-suite executives, business leaders, and the leaders of AI, Product, Marketing, Design, and Data teams, and lead strategic conversations about how their organizations build enterprise-wide AI capability
  • Act as a trusted advisor to your clients, leading them through opportunity discovery and managing the day-to-day relationship across the life of an engagement
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client's business model, digital operating context, and competitive pressures, and identify where new capability would materially change how their teams perform

description:

title: (778) Correspondence Management Analyst
description:
Company Summary

Arlo Solutions (Arlo) is an information technology consulting services company that specializes in delivering technology solutions. Our reputation reflects the high quality of the talented Arlo Solutions team and the consultants working in partnership with our customers. Our mission is to understand and meet the needs of both our customers and consultants by delivering quality, value-added solutions. Our solutions are designed and managed to not only reduce costs, but to improve business processes, accelerate response time, improve services to end-users, and give our customers a competitive edge, now and into the future.

Position Description:

The Correspondence Management Analyst oversees the full lifecycle of incoming and outgoing correspondence, ensuring accurate intake, analysis, routing, tracking, quality control, and timely responses. This role supports efficient communication flow by utilizing dedicated correspondence and task management systems, ensuring compliance with Department of Defense (DoD) regulations, Agency policies, records management requirements, and security protocols. The Analyst proactively identifies risks, potential delays, and process improvement opportunities to streamline correspondence operations and reduce the administrative burden on government personnel.

Work Location: Crystal City, VA (onsite M-F, 0730 – 1600)

Clearance: Secret


Responsibilities and/or Success Factors:

Correspondence Management & Operations

  • Provide comprehensive correspondence management services supporting the intake, processing, tracking, coordination, and distribution of internal and external communications.
  • Execute, facilitate, manage, and analyze administrative and operational programs, policies, procedures, and platforms in compliance with Federal, Departmental, and Agency regulations.
  • Review the Agency’s correspondence and task management systems daily to maintain awareness of all requirements, suspense dates, and required actions.
  • Proactively provide regular status updates on all correspondence requirements, eliminating the need for government personnel to seek updates.
  • Demonstrate urgency for priority and time-sensitive correspondence, notifying OLDCC leadership of priority suspenses, potential delays, or obstacles that could impact deadlines. Correspondence Intake & Distribution
  • Receive, review, log, and process all incoming and outgoing correspondence, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to established guidelines.
  • Assign tracking numbers, categorize correspondence, and ensure timely routing and distribution to appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage classified and sensitive correspondence in strict accordance with security and classification protocols.
  • Log all incoming requirements and supporting documentation (e.g., references, templates, background materials) into the correspondence tracking system with accurate and timely data entry.
  • Assign tasks to appropriate Action Officers based on content, priority, and deadlines, ensuring notifications and task details are communicated within one business day of receipt.
  • Maintain version control and up-to-date records for all correspondence actions. Correspondence Tracking, Follow-Up & Reporting
  • Continuously monitor correspondence through review and approval workflows, sending reminders, tracking suspense dates, and escalating issues as necessary.
  • Identify delinquent or at-risk tasks and proactively notify appropriate Government personnel to allow timely corrective action. rack recurring assignments and provide advance notifications of upcoming requirements.
  • Monitor, report, and brief agency leadership on the status of pending, completed, and overdue correspondence using the Agency’s official tracking system.
  • Provide qualitative and quantitative inputs to monthly status reports, including correspondence metrics, trends, and performance risks.
  • Maintain a running log of correspondence items impacted by defaults, obstacles, or significant issues and notify the COR of potential performance or schedule impacts.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Conduct thorough quality reviews of all correspondence packages prior to release to ensure accuracy, completeness, coordination, and compliance with DoD and Agency formatting, style, grammar, spelling, and classification standards.
  • Demonstrate professional knowledge of applicable DoD correspondence and writing references.
  • Coordinate with Action Officers to return correspondence packages requiring substantial revisions and ensure all required updates are completed.
  • Perform proofreading and editorial corrections to deliver high-quality final products.
  • Ensure compliance with records management policies, Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requirements, and security classification guidelines. Records Management & Archiving
  • Support the Records Manager in maintaining organized, auditable correspondence files in accordance with DoD records management policies.
  • Ensure proper retention, retrieval, and disposition of correspondence records per regulatory requirements.
  • Provide documentation and support for audits, inspections, and reviews.

Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as the primary liaison coordinating correspondence actions with internal offices, agency leadership, and external partners. Ensure alignment with agency policies, messaging, and leadership intent.
  • Support OLDCC leadership with correspondence-related briefings, presentations, and responses to inquiries regarding correspondence policies and procedures. Technology & Process Improvement
  • Utilize DoD-approved correspondence and task management systems for document processing, tracking, and reporting.
  • Identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities within correspondence workflows and recommend or implement process enhancements.
  • Provide training, guidance, and quarterly process reviews for agency staff on correspondence handling procedures as required.

Minimum Qualifications Including Certificates:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Public Administration, Communications, Management, English, or a related field from an accredited institution.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of progressively responsible experience in correspondence management, administrative operations, or a related role within a Federal and/or Department of Defense (DoD) environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the full lifecycle of correspondence, including intake, analysis, tracking, suspense management, routing, quality control, and final release.
  • Strong working knowledge of DoD correspondence standards, formatting requirements, records management policies, and security classification protocols.
  • Experience utilizing correspondence and task management systems to track requirements, deadlines, and approvals.
  • Proven ability to proactively monitor suspense dates, identify risks or delays, and escalate issues to leadership in a timely manner.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with Action Officers, leadership, and external stakeholders.

AAP Statement

We are proud to be an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and as such, we evaluate qualified candidates in full consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, and any other protected status.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our team here at ClearScore in London. Analysts play a key role within ClearScore, driving strategy and key decision-making, which ultimately benefits our users, partners, and other teams within the business. We’re seeking an adaptable, curious, and challenge-loving individual to join our growing Global Targeting team.

ClearScore has an amazing analytical community which includes Data Analysts, Scientists and Engineers. The community works collaboratively to ensure a landscape in which team members can develop their full potential and deliver maximum business impact.

ClearScore is both a free credit score and report service and the UK’s leading consumer credit marketplace. As a part of the Global Targeting team, you will play a key role in monitoring and reporting on the effectiveness of our Targeting strategy for our users, playing a key part in the formulation, execution and analysis of our experiments, and providing recommendations to drive improvements that drive a better experience for our users.

What you will be doing:

  • Collaborate closely with your Targeting squad members, providing insights into the performance of our various user segments.
  • Deliver data informed and backed recommendations for improvements to our Targeting strategy.
  • Conduct detailed analysis of A/B tests to drive better outcomes for our users across user journeys.
  • Lead in-depth analytics projects, leveraging data to uncover opportunities and address complex business challenges.
  • Develop efficient and effective monitoring and reporting dashboards using SQL, Databricks, and Domo.
  • Leverage advanced AI to automate and scale existing and new analytics processes

Skills we'd love you to have

  • SQL, Excel skills and either R or Python. Knowledge of DBT and analytical tools such as Amplitude is a plus
  • A strong quantitative and numerical skills, as well as a good understanding of hypothesis testing and foundational statistical principles
  • Experience using Domo or other data visualisation tools
  • A desire to learn and enjoy working collaboratively, with a desire to contribute to our culture.
  • You do not need to fit into a stereotype: we are really committed to closing our gender gap and are actively trying to create an environment where you, as an individual, can thrive.
  • A self-starter mindset: curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning. A desire to deeply understand a problem and its importance to the business before attempting to solve it
  • A drive to understand our users, products, and how users interact with them, enhancing your ability to generate meaningful features and solutions relevant to the problem being addressed
  • The ability to explain to technical and non-technical audiences the key learnings/findings from complex analysis and modelling exercises

Why ClearScore?

ClearScore is the UK's #1 credit score and report app. We are also present in South Africa, Australia and Canada, with more than 20 million users globally and growing fast. Someone joins ClearScore every 20 seconds. We have established relationships with over 50 of the main lenders in the U.K., and have been a trusted tool for customers to manage their credit and make better financial decisions.

Since October 2016 we have helped 1.8 million users take out a new credit card or loan. We are user-centric at our core and we believe in leveraging technology to enable positive financial choices. We are design-led and data-driven and we embed these behaviours in everything we do.

Our company culture is a fundamental part of all we have achieved. We believe in hiring smart, driven, passionate and diverse people who are keen on having a real impact in our organisation. We trust you to manage your own time so we offer flexible work and no fixed desk hours. We don't micromanage and we believe in measuring outcomes rather than effort. We have an inclusive culture where all, regardless of seniority, are encouraged to contribute with their ideas, look after their wellbeing and actively seek opportunities for career growth.

If you feel like this could be the place for you, apply and our Talent team will be happy to share more.

Benefits:

  • 25 paid holidays and a “duvet day” on your birthday
  • Hybrid Work Environment
  • Private health and dental cover - including mental health support through Bupa
  • GP office visits
  • Life assurance scheme
  • Up to 6% matched pension
  • Regular Lunch and Learns with guest speakers
  • Dog-friendly office
  • Daily breakfast and free snacks
  • Access to discounts via Cobens Extras
  • Free sports and social clubs
  • Continued investment into learning and development
  • Leadership-led training
  • In-house psychotherapist
  • Financial coach to help you plan and achieve your goals
  • No clock-watching culture
  • Generous maternity and paternity plans
  • Culture and inclusion representatives
  • Transparent pay structure and a career growth plan

Equal Opportunities

ClearScore is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. As an equal opportunity employer, we are able to make reasonable adjustments to accommodate individuals with disabilities during the recruitment and selection process. If you require accommodation, please inform us in advance, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Our Hybrid Model
We embrace a dynamic hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with collaborative in-person experiences. Our approach is designed to foster innovation, team connection, and individual productivity.
  • Levels 1-5: Minimum 3 days per week in-office
  • Level 6 and above: Minimum 3 days per week in-office
We believe this structure offers the best of both worlds - the flexibility of remote work and the synergy of face-to-face collaboration. Our office days are carefully coordinated to maximise team interactions and learning/ mentorship opportunities.

What This Means for You:
  • Flexibility to manage your work and life
  • Dedicated in-office days for team building and collaborative projects
  • Office facilities (with plants!) designed for productive interactions
  • Clear expectations and support for maintaining our hybrid schedule
We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment that accommodates diverse needs while maintaining our collaborative culture. Join us in shaping the future of work!

Note: While we offer flexibility, commitment to our hybrid schedule is an important aspect of our team culture and performance expectations.

Inclusion Policy

We are always looking for talented individuals to join ClearScore. We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our people. Please see our People Policy Notice at .

title: Data Engineering Manager
description:
CitySwift is looking for a Data Engineering Manager to join our rapidly growing team.

Desired Qualifications

We value, recognise and reward our people

title: Environmental Health System QA Analyst | Public Health
description:
Environmental Health QA Analyst

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH GOVERNMENTAL PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE (LOCAL / TRIBAL / STATE / FEDERAL). IF YOU HAVE THAT EXPERIENCE, PLEASE ENSURE IT IS CLEAR ON YOUR RESUME.

What do we mean by governmental public health? We're looking for people who have worked directly for a public health agency: a local health department, tribal health organization, state health department, or federal public health agency like CDC. We require this because there's no substitute for the lived experience of navigating government systems, understanding the constraints public health staff face, and developing genuine empathy for the people doing this work. That empathy shapes how we build solutions.

Compensation Note: If a salary range is listed for this position, please note that we will be offering at the starting point of the band. We cover 100% of your health insurance!

Role Overview

We're seeking an Environmental Health QA Analyst who finds satisfaction in making sure things work exactly as they should. You're the person who notices when something is slightly off, who thinks through edge cases others miss, and who won't sign off until you're confident the solution will hold up in the real world.

This role focuses on environmental health workflows. You'll be testing systems that support restaurant inspections, permit applications, complaint tracking, and other environmental health functions. Your understanding of how these programs actually operate will help you spot issues that someone without that background would miss. You'll know that an inspector in the field needs the mobile app to work offline, or that a permit workflow has to account for multiple review stages.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in catching problems before users do. You'll dig into applications, document what you find, and work with developers to get it fixed. You're not just checking boxes on a test script. You're thinking critically about whether the solution will actually work for the health department staff who depend on it.

You'll be part of a collaborative team working on our PH360 platform and client implementations. Your public health experience will make you an advocate for the end user, ensuring that what we deliver is reliable, intuitive, and built for how public health actually works.

How You'll Work

You'll be part of an Agile Release Train (ART) that follows SAFe principles. This means:

  • Program Increment (PI) Planning: You'll participate in quarterly planning sessions, helping identify testing needs and contributing your environmental health perspective
  • Sprint Collaboration: You'll work in two-week sprints with daily standups, regular backlog refinement, and sprint retrospectives
  • Continuous Testing: You'll test features as they're developed, providing rapid feedback to the development team
  • Cross-functional Partnership: You'll work closely with developers, solutions analysts, and architects to ensure quality throughout the development process

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute test plans and test cases for environmental health applications
  • Identify, document, and track defects with clear steps to reproduce
  • Verify that solutions work correctly across different scenarios and edge cases
  • Test environmental health workflows including inspections, permits, complaints, and reporting
  • Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot issues and verify fixes
  • Bring your public health perspective to testing, anticipating how real users will interact with the system
  • Participate in requirements reviews to identify potential issues early
  • Contribute to improving QA processes and testing standards
  • Perform regression testing to ensure new changes don't break existing functionality

Experience Required

  • 1+ years working for a governmental public health agency (local, state, federal, or tribal)
  • Experience with environmental health programs (inspections, permitting, complaints, or similar)
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking
  • Ability to clearly document issues and communicate findings
  • Self-motivated with strong initiative
  • Comfort working with AI tools and technology platforms

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with software testing or QA (formal or informal)
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or similar platforms
  • Understanding of test management tools (Jira, TestRail, or similar)
  • Experience with Agile or SAFe methodology
  • Background in environmental health data systems or reporting requirements
  • Knowledge of API testing or automated testing concepts

What We Offer for Your Growth

  • Training: We'll help you develop formal QA skills and methodologies
  • Mentorship: You'll work alongside experienced team members who are invested in your success
  • Learning Time: Our natural consulting rhythm includes quieter periods that create space for professional development
  • Meaningful Work: You'll help ensure that public health technology actually works for the people who use it

Notice

Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. Willingness to adhere to our no-drug workplace policy. You must agree to undergo eVerify for employment status at hiring.

No 3rd Party Recruiters. No Phone Calls. We are unable to do informational interviews at this moment. Candidates who call or schedule a "coffee chat" will be considered disqualified.

At Flourish and Thrive Labs, we believe in the unique value each candidate brings. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and experiences, even if you don't meet all listed qualifications.

title: Director of Quality
description:
DIRECTOR OF QUALITY

About Prometheus Energetics

Prometheus Energetics is an independent U.S.-based merchant supplier of solid rocket motors and warheads. A joint venture between Kratos Defense & Security Solutions and Rafael Advanced Defense Systems, Prometheus combines U.S. industrial speed and credibility with decades of combat-proven designs, manufacturing know-how, and technical training to deliver field-ready products at scale.

Position Summary

The Director of Quality is the senior quality leader for Prometheus Energetics and is responsible for building, certifying, and sustaining the company’s Quality Management System (QMS) as the business moves from facility startup and product industrialization into production. This leader establishes an independent quality function with the authority, systems, people, and discipline required to ensure that products and processes meet contractual, technical, regulatory, safety, and customer requirements.

Working across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Programs, Safety, Security, and the parent-company knowledge-transfer teams, the Director converts product and process requirements into practical controls throughout the product lifecycle. The role owns enterprise quality strategy, AS9100 certification readiness, customer and regulatory quality interfaces, supplier quality, inspection and metrology, nonconformance and corrective action, and the use of performance data to prevent defects and improve cost, schedule, and mission assurance.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy, Governance & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the quality strategy, certification roadmap, annual objectives, budget, staffing plan, and operating rhythm aligned with company growth and production ramp plans.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization that may include quality engineering, supplier quality, inspection, metrology, document control, and quality systems personnel.
  • Serve as the company’s independent quality authority; stop work, withhold product acceptance or shipment, and escalate risks when requirements are not met or product integrity could be compromised.
  • Establish a culture grounded in quality, accountability, prevention, ethical decision-making, and the expectation that every employee owns product quality.
  • Advise the COO and leadership team on quality risk, customer performance, resource needs, certification status, and systemic improvement priorities.

Quality Management System & Certification

  • Design, implement, document, and maintain an AS9100D/ISO 9001-compliant QMS suitable for a greenfield aerospace and defense manufacturing operation; lead initial certification, surveillance, and recertification activities.
  • Own QMS processes including document and record control, internal audit, management review, risk and opportunity management, change control, training effectiveness, calibration, nonconformance, corrective action, and continual improvement.
  • Ensure requirements from customer contracts, drawings, specifications, statements of work, FAR/DFARS clauses, Defense Contract Management Agency oversight, and applicable military or industry standards are identified, flowed down, implemented, and objectively verified.
  • Establish audit schedules, train internal auditors, manage external and customer audits, and ensure findings are contained, corrected, and closed with effective systemic action.
  • Evaluate and implement applicable standards and special-process controls, including AS9102 first article inspection, AS9145/APQP and production part approval, AS9103 key characteristics, and Nadcap requirements where contractually or operationally applicable.

Product, Process, & Manufacturing Quality

  • Embed quality planning in product development, technology transfer, design reviews, process development, qualification, first article, production readiness, and rate ramp activities.
  • Approve manufacturing plans, travelers, work instructions, inspection plans, acceptance criteria, control plans, sampling plans, and quality gates to ensure complete and unambiguous verification of requirements.
  • Provide quality oversight for energetic-material receipt, mixing, casting, curing, assembly, machining, nondestructive evaluation, test, storage, and final acceptance processes, as applicable to the product and facility.
  • Establish disciplined configuration, traceability, lot control, material status identification, product preservation, foreign-object prevention, counterfeit-parts prevention, and record-retention practices.
  • Lead prevention and resolution of defects using PFMEA, control plans, measurement system analysis, statistical process control, layered process audits, root-cause analysis, and mistake-proofing.
  • Reduce scrap, rework, escapes, and variation while ensuring production pressure never overrides safety, technical compliance, or product integrity.

Inspection, Metrology & Acceptance

  • Establish receiving, in-process, first article, source, and final inspection capabilities appropriate to precision aerospace and energetics manufacturing.
  • Select and qualify inspection and test methods; ensure personnel competency and the appropriate use of dimensional, attribute, laboratory, and nondestructive inspection equipment.
  • Own the calibration and measurement-management system, including equipment control, traceability to recognized standards, out-of-tolerance evaluation, and gauge repeatability and reproducibility.
  • Ensure objective evidence—including inspection records, test results, certificates, material pedigree, and acceptance documentation—is accurate, complete, controlled, and shipment-ready.

Nonconformance, Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain robust controls for identification, segregation, review, disposition, and verification of nonconforming material; administer the Material Review Board process within delegated authorities.
  • Lead timely containment, failure analysis, root-cause investigation, corrective and preventive action, and effectiveness verification for internal defects, supplier issues, customer complaints, and quality escapes.
  • Use data and structured problem-solving to identify systemic risk and prioritize improvements; prevent recurrence rather than relying on inspection alone.
  • Partner with Operations and Engineering on Lean and Six Sigma initiatives that improve first-pass yield, capability, flow, reliability, and cost of quality.

Customer, Government & Supplier Quality

  • Serve as the principal quality representative to customers, government quality representatives, registrars, and other external authorities; build trust through candor, responsiveness, and reliable closure of commitments.
  • Review proposals and contracts for quality requirements, develop compliance plans, and ensure requirements are flowed into design, purchasing, manufacturing, inspection, test, and delivery documentation.
  • Build a risk-based supplier quality program covering selection, qualification, quality clauses, source surveillance, first article approval, performance monitoring, supplier corrective action, and development.
  • Partner with Supply Chain and Engineering to qualify critical materials and special-process suppliers, address obsolescence or alternate-source needs, and strengthen supply-base resilience without compromising product conformity.

Performance Management

Establish actionable dashboards, review performance with functional leaders, and hold owners accountable for recovery and improvement plans. Measures may include:
  • First-pass yield and process capability
  • Cost of poor quality, scrap, and rework
  • Internal defects, customer escapes, and returns
  • Supplier defect rate and corrective-action performance
  • Audit findings and on-time closure
  • Corrective-action aging, recurrence, and effectiveness
  • Calibration and inspection-plan compliance
  • Customer satisfaction and quality rating
  • Certification milestones and QMS maturity
  • Quality team capability, engagement, and retention

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
  • At least 10 years of progressive quality experience in an aerospace and defense manufacturing environment, including at least five years leading quality teams
  • Demonstrated experience implementing, certifying, and sustaining an AS9100-based QMS and leading registrar, customer, and government audits
  • Strong working knowledge of quality engineering and manufacturing controls, including AS9102 first article inspection, configuration and document control, nonconformance/MRB, corrective action, PFMEA, control plans, SPC, MSA, calibration, and supplier quality
  • Experience translating drawings, specifications, customer quality clauses, and contractual requirements into executable manufacturing and inspection controls
  • Proven ability to build teams, develop talent, influence across functions, and make sound independent decisions in a fast-paced startup and production environment
  • Excellent written, verbal, analytical, and executive communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with shop-floor employees, customers, auditors, government representatives, and senior leadership
  • U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and/or maintain a security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in engineering, business, quality, or a related discipline.
  • Experience with solid rocket motors, propulsion, energetic materials, explosives, warheads, ammunition, or complex cast-cure manufacturing.
  • Experience standing up quality systems, laboratories, inspection capabilities, or certification programs in a greenfield facility or startup.
  • ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or comparable credential.
  • Experience with Lean philosophies, methodology, and tools
  • Experience with Nadcap special processes, nondestructive evaluation, laboratory quality systems, and government source inspection.
  • Experience deploying ERP/QMS software and digital quality records in an aerospace manufacturing environment.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • Work is performed in office, construction, laboratory, and manufacturing environments, including areas subject to enhanced safety and security controls.

description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

Wirecutter is seeking a temporary editor to join our discovery team, a group of writers and editors dedicated to applying Wirecutter's best-in-class approach to service journalism in formats outside of our classic product guide.

As a temporary editor, you'll edit stories from staff writers on the discovery team and collaborate with cross-team partners on publishing.

We're looking for an editor who can storytell powerfully, coach writers thoughtfully, hop on trends discerningly, and delight our readers each and every day. You should have experience working hands on with writers as both an editor and people manager.

This is a part-time role (15-20 hours per week). You will have the potential to work remotely.

title: Inventory Specialist
description:
Job Title: Inventory Specialist – Paid Daily Travel & Predictable Weekends Off!

Location: Bloomington, IL 61701 (Bloomington Division)

Pay: $19.00 / hour (Paid Bi-Weekly) + Fully Paid Route Travel

Job Type: Full-Time (Mon–Fri | Averages 36–42 hrs/wk)

Why Quantum Services?

Looking for an active, hands-on role where your weekends are actually yours? Join our regional field auditing team at Quantum Services! Whether you’re stepping out from behind a desk or leaving unpredictable retail shifts behind, we offer reliable hours, full corporate benefits, and 100% paid, hands-on training—no prior inventory experience required.

The Perks

  • $19.00/hr + Fully Paid Travel: You’re paid for time auditing in-store and time on the road between audit sites.

  • Predictable Schedule: Monday – Friday, 6:00 AM kickoff. Early afternoon finishes mean your evenings and weekends stay free.

  • Full Benefits Package: Medical, Dental, Vision, PTO, 401(k) with company match, and Tuition Reimbursement.

  • Team Environment: Travel and work alongside a supportive, close-knit field team daily.

What You’ll Do

You’ll travel as a team along designated regional routes (within a ~2-hour radius) to conduct physical inventory counts and asset audits inside convenience stores and retail locations.

  • Audit stock across sales floors, backroom storage, and walk-in coolers/freezers using handheld digital counting devices.

  • Reconcile inventory counts and deliver clear summary reports to store managers.

  • Carpool daily with team members along regional routes.

Schedule & Travel Realities

  • 6:00 AM Kickoff / Free Afternoons: On-site audit work starts at 6:00 AM. Departure times vary based on route distance, with shifts typically wrapping up early to mid-afternoon.

  • Weekly Hours: Averages 36–42 hours per week (auditing + travel time combined).

Requirements

  • Vehicle & License: Valid Driver’s License, active personal auto insurance, and a dependable personal vehicle suitable for team carpooling (rideshare services like Uber/Lyft are not permitted).

  • Screenings: Ability to pass standard Background (BGC) and Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) checks.

  • Physical Readiness: Comfort standing, bending, stooping, climbing short step-ladders, lifting up to 25 lbs, and working briefly in cool/cold storage environments (walk-in coolers).

  • Reliability: Punctuality for early morning start times and a dependable team mindset.

Great match for: Inventory Associate | Retail Merchandising | Warehouse Stocking | Route Delivery | Field Auditing | Asset Protection | Customer Service | General Labor | Hospitality

  • Drive Client Progress – Support your team in making data-driven decisions by reviewing treatment plans, monitoring outcomes, and ensuring every child receives individualized, evidence-based care.

title: Senior Designer, Airports
description:

Orange Barrel Media / Departure Media is seeking a Senior Designer to help shape advertising environments at airports across the country. As part of the OBM Architecture Studio, you’ll assess airport spaces, evaluate existing media assets, and develop interior and exterior signage concepts that complement the surrounding architecture and create new advertising opportunities.


This role combines hands-on fieldwork with collaborative design. You’ll travel weekly to conduct site visits and surveys, then translate your findings into conceptual drawings and compelling design proposals. We’re looking for a proactive designer with strong spatial judgment, attention to detail, and enthusiasm for working across a growing national portfolio.

  • Identify opportunities for new and expanded advertising placements within interior and exterior airport environments
  • Develop signage concepts that consider architectural context, visibility, circulation, and advertising objectives
  • Presentation drawings to communicate existing conditions, proposed signage locations, and design concepts
  • Collaborate with the OBM Architecture Studio peers on persuasive proposals that bring together siting, design, and narrative
  • Partner with real estate development, construction, and advertising sales teams to develop cohesive, feasible advertising proposals
  • Organize site documentation and manage design deliverables across multiple projects

Qualifications

  • A four-year degree in architecture or a related field
  • At least four years of experience in a professional design office
  • Ability to produce presentation drawings using CAD software.
  • Strong spatial planning skills and the ability to translate site observations into thoughtful design recommendations
  • Ability and willingness to travel weekly for site visits and project needs
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain design ideas clearly across departments
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • A proactive, adaptable approach to problem-solving and managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

Preferred

  • Two or more years of experience with airport or mall advertising and signage projects
  • Experience conducting site surveys and documenting existing conditions
  • Expertise in Rhinoceros 3D and Adobe Creative Cloud programs
