title: Family Residential Program Case Manager
description:
The Family Residential Program (FRP) Case Manager provides direct case management services to families participating in Cumberland Youth & Family Services' Family Residential Program. Using a trauma-informed, strengths-based approach, the Case Manager assists families in identifying goals, accessing resources, overcoming barriers, and developing the skills necessary to achieve long-term stability and self-sufficiency.

The FRP Case Manager serves as the primary point of contact for participating families and works collaboratively with residents, agency staff, and community partners to coordinate services, monitor progress, and support successful program completion.


Key Expectations/Responsibilities:

Case Management and Resident Support

  • Conduct resident intake assessments and participate in admissions and orientation processes.
  • Complete comprehensive needs assessments and develop individualized service plans in partnership with residents.
  • Maintain regular contact with residents through scheduled case management meetings and follow-up.
  • Monitor resident progress and update service plans as needed to reflect changing needs and goals.
  • Assist residents in addressing barriers related to employment, education, housing stability, transportation, childcare, financial management, health care, and other identified needs.
  • Provide support, encouragement, advocacy, and accountability to help residents achieve program goals.
  • Assist residents with transition planning and successful program completion.

Resource Coordination and Community Partnerships

  • Connect residents with community resources and supportive services.
  • Maintain knowledge of community resources, public benefits, and referral opportunities.
  • Coordinate services with schools, healthcare providers, behavioral health providers, workforce programs, childcare providers, and other community agencies.
  • Advocate for residents when appropriate to help secure necessary services and support.
  • Develop and maintain positive working relationships with community partners.

Program Coordination

  • Assist with referral review, admissions, orientation, and discharge processes.
  • Maintain accurate resident files and monitor documentation for compliance with agency requirements.
  • Track resident participation, outcomes, and program progress.
  • Prepare reports and program information as requested by agency leadership.
  • Identify service gaps and communicate resident needs and program recommendations to the Chief Program Officer.

Group Facilitation and Resident Engagement

  • Facilitate or assist with resident groups, workshops, and educational activities.
  • Support programming related to parenting skills, life skills, financial literacy, employment readiness, health and wellness, and other topics relevant to family stability.
  • Encourage resident participation in program activities and events.
  • Assist with family engagement activities and special events.

Crisis Intervention and Resident Safety

  • Provide crisis intervention and support during resident emergencies and challenging situations.
  • Respond appropriately to resident concerns and behavioral issues using trauma-informed practices.
  • Follow agency protocols regarding incident reporting, mandatory reporting, safety concerns, and emergency situations.
  • Communicate significant resident concerns, incidents, and barriers to agency leadership in a timely manner.

Documentation and Compliance

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely case records.
  • Complete case notes, assessments, service plans, referrals, discharge summaries, and all required documentation.
  • Ensure documentation complies with agency, licensing, funding, and accreditation requirements.
  • Maintain confidentiality of resident information in accordance with applicable laws and agency policies.

Team Participation

  • Participate in staff meetings, case staffing meetings, training opportunities, and agency activities.
  • Collaborate effectively with agency staff to ensure quality services and positive resident outcomes.
  • Support Cumberland Youth & Family Services' mission, values, and commitment to providing trauma-informed care.

Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Part Time Program Manager
description:
This is a flexible, on-demand role focused on quality assurance. You will visit local school sites to ensure our programs run smoothly and adhere to HOKALI’s standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Program Qualifications & Compliance: Leverage prior experience with ASES (After School Education and Safety) and ELOP (Expanded Learning Opportunities Program) guidelines to ensure full regulatory and operational compliance across all sites.
  • Class & On-Site Supervision: Visit partner schools within designated hours to oversee program execution, introduce yourself to school staff and instructors, and support live classroom operations.
  • Instructional Coordination: Manage the end-to-end creation, tracking, and review of lesson plans to maintain program quality and educational standards.
  • Schedule & Agenda Management: Attend weekly alignment meetings with the Operations Coordinator to review priorities and independently build your site visitation schedule.
  • Documentation & Records: Oversee site administrative tasks, including accurate record-keeping, tracking sign-out sheets, and managing required session documentation.
  • Information & Data Handling: Maintain and handle confidential program information, school directories, location details, and student data securely.

Schedule & Compensation

  • Schedule: Dynamic hourly schedule within a 1:00 PM – 6:00 PM window (flexible, based on weekly operational demand).
  • Rate: $40/hr
  • Location: San Francisco, CA (with potential visits to nearby partner schools).

Requirements

  • Legal authorization to work in the US.
  • Proven experience in Field Operations or a similar coordinator role.
  • Direct experience working in a school or after-school environment (Required).
  • Solid understanding of ASES and ELOP program frameworks.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Flexible scheduling aligned with your availability and operational needs.
  • Access to the HOKALI Academy—a community space designed for educators to learn, connect, and collaborate.
  • Structured lesson plans provided, with room to bring your own creative ideas to class.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and expanded responsibilities within HOKALI.
  • Employee Referral Program with bonus incentives.

title: Deputy Project Manager - Disaster Case Management Program
description:
Deputy Project Manager – Disaster Case Management Program

Location: Anchorage, AK
Work Schedule: Full-Time Temporary Position
Travel: Travel may be required to remote parts of Alaska

Job Summary

The Deputy Project Manager supports the Project Manager in the management and delivery of a Disaster Case Management Program. This position is responsible for supporting day-to-day program operations with an emphasis on case management delivery, staff oversight, teaming partner coordination, quality assurance, performance reporting, and program timelines and deliverables.

The Deputy Project Manager helps ensure the program operates in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local requirements and meets contractual obligations, stakeholder expectations, and established performance goals. This role also supports the delivery of high-quality, timely, confidential, and survivor-centered services that advance disaster recovery outcomes.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Support the Project Manager in the overall management and administration of the Disaster Case Management Program.

  • Provide advisory and consulting support to state, local, and federal partners related to program startup, implementation, and ongoing operations.

  • Provide technical guidance on Disaster Case Management policies, procedures, and standard operating practices.

  • Manage and support program staff, which may include Disaster Case Managers, supervisors, resource coordinators, analysts, eligibility specialists, QA/QC staff, and other assigned personnel.

  • Oversee teaming partners and subcontractors supporting program delivery.

  • Monitor case management operations, including productivity, caseload distribution, case progression, and service delivery.

  • Develop and maintain tools to track caseloads, referrals, survivor outcomes, unmet needs, performance measures, and recovery milestones.

  • Monitor compliance with applicable regulations, guidance, contractual requirements, and internal program policies.

  • Ensure confidentiality, data integrity, and appropriate handling of survivor information.

  • Identify, escalate, and support resolution of service delivery and procedural issues in a timely manner.

  • Promote high-quality service delivery through trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and survivor-centered practices.

  • Establish performance expectations and provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and operational support to staff.

  • Evaluate program processes and recommend or implement improvements based on operational needs, emerging issues, and lessons learned.

  • Coordinate with internal leadership, government partners, community organizations, and other stakeholders to identify and leverage recovery resources.

  • Prepare reports, dashboards, briefings, and other deliverables communicating program status, accomplishments, risks, and issues requiring attention.

  • Present recommendations, operational updates, and performance information to leadership and stakeholders.

  • Support program planning, staffing, and resource allocation to meet short- and long-term program goals.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Provide oversight and direction to assigned program staff and operational teams.

  • May supervise or provide functional oversight to case management and support personnel.

  • Support oversight of subcontractors and teaming partners to ensure alignment with program objectives and contract requirements.

Required Education, Experience, & Skills

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

  • 2+ years of experience in disaster case management, disaster recovery, case management, program management, government programs, grant-funded programs, human services, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting project or program management activities.

  • Experience overseeing disaster recovery, case management, human services, government, or grant-funded programs.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with staff, clients, government partners, stakeholders, and leadership.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to use data and performance metrics to support decision-making and program improvement.

  • Knowledge of disaster recovery principles, survivor assistance, resource coordination, and case management practices.

  • Ability to manage client expectations, subcontractor relationships, teaming partners, and contract requirements.

  • Commitment to survivor-centered, trauma-informed, and equitable service delivery.

  • Ability and willingness to travel to remote parts of Alaska.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

  • Experience managing or supervising professional staff.

  • Experience with federally funded disaster recovery or human services programs.

  • Experience with FEMA, state disaster recovery programs, Disaster Case Management, or similar survivor assistance programs.

Work Environment & Conditions

  • Work may be performed remotely or on-site, depending on program needs.

  • Travel may be required to support field operations, client meetings, stakeholder coordination, and program implementation.

  • May require flexibility in work hours based on operational demands.

Additional Information

  • This position supports disaster recovery operations and may involve work in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.

  • The successful candidate must exercise sound judgment and maintain a high level of professionalism, confidentiality, and integrity in handling sensitive information.


Job Description Disclaimer
This position description incorporates the job's core responsibilities. It recognizes that other related duties not specifically mentioned might also be performed and that not all responsibilities may be carried out depending on operational needs.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. Upon hire, secondary employment and other employment restrictions must be disclosed and approved.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About the role

As a Senior Data Engineer at Reach, you’ll work alongside our existing Data Engineering team on our data platform modernization effort. You’ll be a key contributor to our broader data practice, building and maintaining pipelines, data models, and transformations as we modernize Reach’s data stack. You’ll help establish scalable, reliable, and consistent data engineering practices across the organization, ushering in a new era of cohesive data design and management within the broader Engineering organization.


What you'll do

  • Develop and manage data pipelines, data models, schemas, and data artifacts as a core contributor to our data squad.
  • Champion data engineering best practices, including data quality, version control, testing, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with Data, Software, and Platform Engineers to evolve and improve existing engineering practices, tools, and infrastructure.
  • Partner with data scientists, analysts, stakeholders, and cross-functional data teams across the organization to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Stay up to date on emerging data engineering tools and technologies, and help evaluate new solutions to optimize our data ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with Platform Engineers to ensure seamless integration and deployment of data pipelines using shared CI/CD tools and Infrastructure as Code solutions, such as GitHub Actions and Terraform.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, proactively identifying and resolving issues to ensure data quality, reliability, and availability.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for data pipelines, data models, and engineering processes.


What you should have

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, working with dbt (Core or Cloud), Snowflake, Fivetran, Amazon RDS, PostgreSQL, etc
  • Strong proficiency in dbt development best practices and coding conventions, with hands-on experience designing and implementing Medallion data architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers) in a production environment.
  • Extensive knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores
  • Experience with data pipeline orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or similar platforms
  • Experience implementing automated data quality checks, dbt testing, and data validation frameworks
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based version control, and automated deployment processes for data engineering workflows
  • Demonstrated experience optimizing Snowflake performance, dbt models, SQL queries, and data warehouse costs
  • Production experience working with and managing a Snowflake deployment
  • Experience extracting information from SaaS systems like Salesforce using ETL tools like FiveTran
  • Production experience using dbt Cloud or other source-driven transformation management tools
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and Database Change Management tooling
  • Experience with operational database management, including backup, recovery, tuning, data modeling, scaling
  • Demonstrated experience with Python, Java, Scala, or similar languages
  • Must be self-motivated, focused, and highly committed to delivering value
  • Must be a collaborative team player with strong communication skills, a willingness to share knowledge, and the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.


Nice to haves

  • Experience preparing data for analysis in Tableau or other BI tools
  • Experience with Tableau CRM Analytics Data Pipelines
  • Experience with Sigma Computing
  • Experience with Fivetran Activations
  • Experience working in the Financial Services industry and familiarity with working in a SOC2 and PCI-DSS environment.


What is it like working at Reach Financial?

Our culture is built around advancing our teams, and we are dedicated to the success and growth of every team member. We believe in retaining a high-performing workforce and we prioritize diversity, intellectual curiosity, and continued learning. Our generous benefits packages reflect that.


We’ve been hard at work perfecting our product for years, and now we’re growing faster than ever before. Our strong foundation and company culture is readily equipped for this growth, and we believe that with the right people, our products will continue to help customers make real changes in their financial lives.

What benefits will you receive?

  • Healthcare, Life Insurance, 401k Match
  • Paid Time Off, Paid 12-week Parental Leave
  • Disability (short-term, long-term), Employee Assistance Program
  • Spending Accounts (Transit/Parking, Medical, Dependent Care)
  • Insurance Discounts (home, auto, pet)

title: NetSuite ERP Consultant
description:
About M&S Consulting

M&S Consulting is an enterprise technology and business systems integrator that has delivered ERP, cloud and custom platform programs since 2002. With 250+ consultants and headquarters in Morgantown, WV, we pair small-business agility with large-business capability. Our Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V) practice gives clients an objective read on quality and risk across multi-vendor programs, and we roll up our sleeves to help fix what we find.

Role Overview

We are hiring an experienced NetSuite ERP Consultant, an ERP configuration and development specialist with strong financial systems expertise, to lead the implementation, configuration and enhancement of enterprise ERP platforms. You will split your time between IV&V engagements, where you verify that complex ERP implementations are built right and do the right thing, and delivery work, where you design, configure, integrate and develop in NetSuite yourself. The role blends functional finance knowledge with technical configuration and development skill, so a strong finance background is essential: you will be trusted to judge whether a design actually supports the close, the controls and the reporting a finance team depends on.

Key Responsibilities

IV&V and Advisory

  • Plan and prepare for project kickoff: help clients define the IV&V approach, scope, success criteria, and quality and risk expectations before work begins.
  • Review vendor SOWs and proposals for clear scope, testable requirements, acceptance criteria, deliverables, assumptions and gaps.
  • Advise clients on NetSuite architecture, implementation approach, vendor selection and program governance, and flag risks early.
  • Verify and validate each stage of a NetSuite program: requirements, architecture and design, configuration and build, integration and testing, and go-live readiness.
  • Review data migration, integrations and the hand-offs between vendors and systems.
  • Give clients objective, evidence-based findings, then help resolve them. Work constructively alongside the prime, integrator and software vendors, and be ready to reinforce a vendor if needed.

Hands-on NetSuite Delivery

  • Lead full-lifecycle implementation of ERP systems (NetSuite, Certinia or similar platforms).
  • Configure ERP modules across finance, accounting, billing, revenue recognition, procure-to-pay and order-to-cash, including related workflows, roles and permissions.
  • Translate financial and business requirements into scalable ERP system designs.
  • Design and build custom solutions using platform tools, scripting and extensions, such as NetSuite SuiteScript and SuiteFlow workflows, custom records, saved searches and configuration tools.
  • Develop and support integrations with CRM, banking, billing, payroll and other third-party systems.
  • Perform data migration, cleansing, mapping and validation from legacy systems.
  • Build reports, dashboards and financial analytics to support FP&A and operational reporting.
  • Support testing, deployment, cutover planning and post-go-live stabilization, and keep improving ERP performance and scalability.
  • Apply financial controls and compliance requirements (GAAP, SOX) in system design.

Team and Client

  • Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, Operations and IT stakeholders to optimize ERP workflows, and translate between finance and technical teams.
  • Provide technical leadership on ERP architecture, configuration standards and best practices.
  • Document designs, test results and findings clearly for client leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, information systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in ERP systems configuration, development or implementation.
  • Strong finance and accounting domain knowledge (GL, AP, AR, revenue recognition, billing), plus internal controls such as GAAP and SOX.
  • Hands-on NetSuite experience across financial and transactional modules, including configuration, workflows, scripting and customization.
  • Strong integration experience using APIs, middleware or iPaaS tools.
  • Experience with data migration and financial data mapping.
  • Experience with the full implementation lifecycle: requirements, design, build, testing and UAT, cutover and go-live.
  • Solution architecture experience, and the ability to translate business and finance requirements into technical solutions.
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and finance stakeholders, including the ability to deliver candid, objective findings to client executives with tact.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments, and comfort in multi-vendor programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • NetSuite SuiteScript, SuiteFlow and SuiteTalk experience, and NetSuite certifications such as ERP Consultant or SuiteCloud Developer.
  • Salesforce ecosystem integration experience (Salesforce to ERP).
  • Experience with revenue recognition and project accounting models, NetSuite OneWorld or SuiteBilling.
  • Multi-entity or global ERP implementations.
  • Experience with financial reporting tools or data warehouses.
  • CPA, MBA, finance degree or accounting background (a strong plus).
  • Experience with comparable platforms, such as Certinia, Oracle, SAP, Workday Financials or Acumatica.
  • Experience in consulting or systems integrator environments, including solution architect or workstream lead roles.
  • Exposure to IV&V, QA or test engineering practices, such as IEEE 1012.
  • Experience supporting public-sector or federal clients, and leading or mentoring consulting teams.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hybrid ERP functional and technical specialist who:

  • Understands finance deeply, not just systems.
  • Can configure and extend ERP platforms hands-on.
  • Bridges business stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Has implemented or supported NetSuite, Certinia or similar ERP systems end to end.
  • Is comfortable owning solutions, not just executing tasks.
  • Can give clients objective IV&V findings and then help resolve them.

*M&S Consulting proactively fulfills its role as an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, marital status, physical or mental disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Youth Development Specialist - The Hub
description:
Family Connections is seeking a FY Youth Development Specialist to foster social development through facilitation of recreation and psycho-educational groups.

Core Values:

  • CULTURAL PROFICIENCY: Articulates and applies historical context of racism and understands the current reality of consumers and communities of color in order to support racial equity. Actively demonstrates a commitment to supporting equity and inclusion, and serves as an advocate with colleagues, partners, and communities to meet the Agency's goal of becoming an Antiracist Culturally Inclusive Organization.
  • RACIAL EQUITY ADVOCATE: Recognizes, supports, and engages in dismantling institutional racism. Partners with, and is accountable to stakeholders, including children, families, and communities of color.
  • RACIAL EQUITY MINDSET: Demonstrates awareness of biases, internalized racial superiority and oppression. Leads with a racial equity lens and actively uses the racial equity tool in meaningful ways.
  • TRANSFORMATIONAL VALUES: Contributes to valuable and positive, antiracist transformation in individuals, organizations, and social systems in an effort to actively progress across the antiracist multicultural institution continuum. Is able to foster a sense of community and shared purpose via collaboration and cooperation with others inside and outside Family Connections. Embodies the principles and practices that form the Agency's culture. Operates from an abundance mentality that recognizes opportunities and is optimistic and realistic about the future.
  • Demonstrates cultural competence through an awareness of and sensitivity towards Agency's clients' and coworkers' cultural and socioeconomic characteristics.
  • Committed to the value of a nurturing family as the ideal environment for a child and believes in the capacity of people to grow and change.
  • Works from a strengths-based perspective.
  • Recognizes that consumers come first and responds to consumers appropriately.
  • Knows and adheres to all FC Policies and Procedures.

PROFESSIONALISM:
1. Values and participates in the Team as a proactive member.
2. Respects others’ professional opinions and tolerates a range of feelings.
3. Able to give and receive constructive criticism.
4. Willing to take on extra work when needed (i.e. when there is a vacancy).

6. Is courteous, approachable, and cooperative towards others and conducts self in a mature, competent, confident, and respectful manner.
7. Understands and adheres to confidentiality rights of clients, co-workers and agency, consistent with HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act), and protects personal health information in written, verbal and electronic forms.
8. Practices self- care, has a sense of humor, and possess a healthy work/ life balance important to providing great customer service.

10. In times of crisis is willing to help others, and communicates urgent information quickly to supervisor / Team.
11. Maintains good attendance (i.e. Maintains FT or PT schedule as contracted, and attendance does not impair or negatively affect the team.)
12. Is punctual for client appointments, meetings, etc.
13. Meets program productivity requirements.
14. Uses good judgment, practices ethical decision-making, and explores all options in problem solving.

SUPERVISION:
1. Attends supervision consistently and comes prepared.
2. Documents supervision.
3. Able to receive feedback and to learn from it.
4. Has insight about self (i.e.strengths and weaknesses) and utilizes that knowledge toward growth and change.

Youth Development Specialist responsibilities include:
1. Supervise and coordinate recreational programming and field trips.
2. Build and maintain rapport; interacting with students during appropriate times to facilitate social skill development, and advocating for students, as needed.
3. Facilitate prevention and psycho-educational groups.
4. Insure documentation and data input into Management Information System is completed in timely fashion.
5. Provide case management to students as necessary.
6. Monitor students’ academic and behavioral progress.
7. Assist in the development and marketing of programs in the school environment and community.
8. Discuss all suspected cases of abuse and neglect with Manager/Coordinator and report to DCP&P.
9. Perform other duties as deemed necessary by the Manager/Coordinator of SBYSP.

SPECIFICATIONS:

Education/Certification:
Minimum High School diploma, 3 years experience as a youth service worker; Bachelor’s Degree in human services field preferred.

Experience:
Proven ability to work with adolescents in an urban setting.

Knowledge:
Knowledge of adolescent development, knowledge of community resources, knowledge of group process.

Skills and Abilities:
Ability to create a warm, non-threatening therapeutic atmosphere, ability to provide non-judgmental responses, ability to counsel adolescents, ability to work as a member of a team, ability to advocate for students with school personnel, ability to work with individuals from diverse backgrounds.

Professional Characteristics: Open, warm, empathic, attentive listener, self-aware, ethical, creative, organized, flexible, open to criticism, patient, responsible, able to work independently, mature, self-motivated, dedicated, enthusiastic, will to take on additional tasks and responsibilities, interested in seeking additional training and skills.

Benefits include medical, dental, life insurance, long term disability, retirement plans, and additional supplementary benefits. Yes, you can elect to not enroll into these benefits. You will also be eligible to accrue vacation, personal, and sick days in addition to 12 paid holidays, and summer wellness Fridays.

title: Investigative Producer
description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

10 Tampa Bay News is looking for an Investigative Producer to dig deep, hold the powerful accountable, and deliver impactful stories for viewers across all our platforms: broadcast, CTV streaming, and digital.
You'll partner with reporters and newsroom leadership to find, develop, and produce investigative and enterprise stories

Responsibilities:
• Generate original, unique investigative story ideas through source development, public records, data, and community tips
• Research and verify information using public records, court filings, FOIA/Florida Sunshine Law requests, and databases
• Analyze data and documents to uncover trends, wrongdoing, and stories others miss
• Build and maintain a strong network of sources across government, law enforcement, business, and the community
• Plan and produce long-form investigations, multi-part series, and quick-turn accountability stories
• Write compelling scripts and story structures that make complex topics clear and engaging
• Line up and conduct pre-interviews; prepare reporters for interviews, including confrontational or accountability interviews
• Work with legal and newsroom leadership to make sure stories are accurate, fair, and legally sound
• Maintain detailed documentation and fact-check every element of a story before air
• Track story impact and pursue follow-up reporting
• Meet deadlines in a fast-paced, competitive environment and contribute during breaking news when needed


Requirements:
• 3+ years of experience in investigative journalism, producing, or reporting (TV news preferred)
• Proven track record of original investigative or enterprise work
• Strong research skills, including public records requests and document analysis
• Excellent writing and storytelling skills
• Sound news judgment and a strong commitment to accuracy, fairness, and journalistic ethics
• Persistence, curiosity, and the ability to manage multiple long-term projects at once
• Comfortable working with data
• Ability to work under pressure and handle sensitive information with discretion
• Flexibility to work varied hours, including nights, weekends, and breaking news
• Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Preferred Skills:
• Ability to shoot and edit video is a strong plus
• Experience with data journalism tools
• Familiarity with Florida public records law
• Experience with advanced visual storytelling
• Knowledge of the Tampa Bay area and its communities
• Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus

Benefits:

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. title: Intake Operations Supervisor
description:
Position Summary

The Supervisor, Sales Support & Patient Intake leads and unites the teams responsible for guiding patients and providers through every step of the Dayspring order journey — from first referral through document collection and order fulfillment. This role brings together the Sales Support and Intake Operations functions under one team-first leader who builds a culture of collaboration, accountability, and shared ownership of the patient and sales experience.

This role is focused primarily on people leadership between the two departments. The Supervisor coaches, develops, and motivates team members across both functions, removes obstacles that stand between the team and its goals, and ensures the two groups operate as a single, well-coordinated unit rather than two disconnected teams handing work back and forth. The ideal candidate is an engaged, hands-on leader who genuinely enjoys developing people, building trust, and creating an environment where the team feels supported, recognized, and set up to succeed — while also ensuring orders are processed accurately, compliantly, and on time.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, coach, and support a combined team of Sales Support and Intake Operations Representatives, fostering one connected team culture across both functions.

• Hold regular one-on-ones, team huddles, and performance check-ins to keep team members engaged, supported, and growing in their roles.

• Recruit, onboard, and train new team members; build structured ramp plans so new hires reach full productivity quickly and confidently.

• Identify skill and development opportunities for each team member, and create pathways for cross-training between the Sales Support and Intake Operations functions to build a more versatile, resilient team.

• Recognize and celebrate individual and team wins; actively contribute to a positive, high-trust team environment where people want to do their best work.

• Conduct performance evaluations, set goals collaboratively with team members, and address performance concerns with fairness and consistency.

• Manage team scheduling, workload balancing, and PTO coverage to ensure consistent service levels for sales, referral sources, and patients.


Operational Oversight

• Ensure the team collects, verifies, and processes all documentation required to support order fulfillment, including patient demographics, physician orders, and supporting clinical documentation, and provides basic benefit investigation support as needed.

• Serve as the escalation point for complex order, intake, or documentation issues that the team cannot resolve independently.

• Monitor team-wide KPIs — order accuracy, turnaround time, referral conversion, and documentation completeness — and partner with the team to problem-solve when targets are at risk.

• Partner closely with Sales, Reimbursement Operations, Billing, and Fulfillment teams to eliminate friction and hand-off delays between sales support and patient intake.

• Champion and build shared, standardized processes across both functions. Lead both teams to improve consistency, efficiency, and the experience for patients, providers, and the sales team.

• Maintain a working knowledge of third-party payer guidelines, as outlined in the Company's Payer Library, to support the Reimbursement Operations team.

• Ensure the team's practices reflect current knowledge of HIPAA, TJC, and other federal/state regulatory requirements, and maintain awareness of compliance requirements for federally funded healthcare programs (e.g., Medicare and Medicaid) regarding fraud, waste, and abuse. Elevate compliance questions or concerns promptly and take appropriate action on issues reported by the team.

• Maintain accurate records, including patient protected health information, in the CRM (Salesforce.com) and other internal systems.

• Contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives that enhance team efficiency and the overall patient and referral experience.


Minimum Qualifications

Education, Experience & Training

• Bachelor's degree preferred

• At least 5 years of experience in sales support, patient intake, customer service, healthcare administration, or the DME industry

• At least 2 years of experience leading, supervising, or mentoring a team preferred

• Experience with benefit verification, medical documentation, or order processing preferred


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Demonstrated passion for developing people and building strong, cohesive teams

• Strong coaching, motivational, and conflict-resolution skills

• Excellent organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities

• Effective oral and written communication and relationship-building skills across all levels of the organization

• Ability to lead confidently and resourcefully in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, and growing company

• Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with sound judgment under pressure

• Proficiency in CRM systems (Salesforce.com preferred) and Microsoft Office

• High ethical standards and sound judgment handling sensitive patient information


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Team engagement, retention, and satisfaction

• Combined order accuracy and completeness rate across Sales Support and Intake

• Turnaround time from referral/order receipt to closure

• Reduction in delays caused by hand-offs between Sales Support and Intake

• Sales team and referral source satisfaction

• Compliance with payer and regulatory requirements

• New hire ramp time and cross-training completion


Work Environment

• Home-based work environment

• Frequent communication with team members, sales, internal partners, healthcare providers, and patients

• Requires handling sensitive patient information in compliance with HIPAA regulations


Physical Functions and Work Environment

The physical functions described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers; handle or feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.


Note

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any Koya manager authorized to provide instruction or assign work. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. To perform this job successfully, the incumbents will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an "at will" relationship.

Koya Medical, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, drug free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.

title: Head of Growth - GTM / Revenue Ops
description:
Head of Growth - GTM / Revenue Ops
Build Markets. Build Revenue Engines. Build What Comes Next.
Intervene K-12 is seeking a Head of Growth - GTM / Revenue Ops to build and lead our enterprise Growth organization. We are not looking for a traditional sales executive who simply manages an existing playbook. We are looking for a market builder who has created the playbook: identifying opportunities, entering new markets, commercializing products, building partnerships, developing teams, and turning opportunity into repeatable revenue.

About Intervene K-12

Intervene K-12 provides education technology, instructional support, and data-informed solutions designed to help schools, educators, students, and families improve academic outcomes. We are building the leadership team and commercial infrastructure required for our next stage of growth.

The Operating Environment

Intervene K-12 is a founder-led education technology and services company entering its next stage of growth. We operate across multiple products, customer segments, and geographic markets. Our commercial portfolio includes direct K-12 district sales, English Learner solutions, B2C/state-funded tutoring growth, strategic partnerships, and emerging domestic and international education opportunities.
This role will work directly with the Founder & CEO and will lead the commercial functions required to scale that portfolio. It is a Houston-based executive role with meaningful domestic travel and periodic international travel.

Your Mission

Build a repeatable, measurable, and capital-efficient growth engine that identifies attractive markets, creates demand, develops channels and partnerships, scales commercial execution, and converts opportunity into sustainable revenue.

What You Will Own

  • Enterprise growth strategy and consolidated commercial performance
  • Direct sales and product-line revenue teams
  • Marketing and Product Marketing
  • Market Development and new-market validation
  • Strategic Partnerships & Channels
  • Revenue Operations & Sales Enablement
  • Proposal / RFP commercial strategy
  • Commercial talent, operating cadence, pipeline discipline, and forecasting

What You Will Do

  • Determine where Intervene K-12 should invest, test, scale, partner, pause, or exit.
  • Build differentiated GTM strategies across products, markets, buyers, and channels.
  • Lead AEs and revenue leaders while building the future commercial leadership bench.
  • Create disciplined pipeline management, forecasting, account ownership, and commercial reporting.
  • Build marketing and product-marketing capabilities tied to measurable pipeline and revenue.
  • Develop partnerships and channels that create market access and revenue leverage.
  • Evaluate new domestic and international opportunities alongside the Founder & CEO.
  • Turn promising opportunities into structured validation plans and repeatable commercial motions.
  • Partner closely with Client Success, Delivery & Operations, Product/Technology, Finance, and other executive functions without absorbing their operating responsibilities.

What We Are Looking For

  • A proven market builder with specific examples of markets personally created or scaled
  • Experience creating GTM strategies from scratch
  • Demonstrated revenue accountability
  • Experience commercializing multiple products, buyer types, or channels
  • Evidence of building teams, leaders, systems, partnerships, or revenue infrastructure
  • Strong analytical and financial judgment
  • Ability to balance growth opportunity with margin, speed, delivery capacity, and capital requirements
  • Comfort operating hands-on in a founder-led, growth-stage company
  • Executive presence with the curiosity and energy to explore unfamiliar markets
  • Ability to build organizational capability rather than becoming the permanent closer

Strongly Preferred Backgrounds

  • Growth-stage or founder-led companies
  • Enterprise SaaS, EdTech, GovTech/public sector, workforce technology, healthcare technology, or technology-enabled services
  • Complex B2B or public-sector buying environments
  • Experience with long sales cycles, strategic accounts, partnerships, and/or RFP-driven business
  • Experience helping a smaller company build the commercial infrastructure required for significant scale

What This Role Is Not

  • This is not a traditional VP of Sales role.
  • This is not the President/Integrator or COO role.
  • This is not a role for someone who only wants to manage a mature organization.
  • This is not a strategy-only role; the Head of Growth (GTM / Revenue Ops) is accountable for revenue execution and commercial outcomes.

Success in the First Year

  • Enterprise Growth strategy established and operating
  • Clear product-market priorities and differentiated GTM plans
  • Stronger sales accountability, pipeline discipline, and forecasting
  • Marketing and RevOps capabilities operating against measurable outcomes
  • Market-validation process governing new opportunities
  • Strategic partnership/channel strategy producing commercial activity
  • Reduced Founder dependency for routine commercial execution
  • Growth organization positioned to scale alongside the company’s future executive operating structure

Location & Travel

Houston, Texas is required. Candidates outside Houston must be willing to relocate or travel. Meaningful domestic travel and periodic international travel are expected.

title: Oracle ERP Technical Developer

description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

What we do:

The Finance Systems team supports the technology needs of the Finance organization by managing and maintaining key applications, including Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM, Incorta BI, Coupa P2P, Kyriba, GetPaid, Boomi Middleware, Anaplan and multiple other applications.

The Oracle ERP Technical developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting integrated data and analytics solutions, middleware integrations and Oracle ERP Extensions. This role manages data ingestion and transformation, developing data models, dashboards, and BI Publisher reports.

What you'll do:

  • Configure and support Oracle BI Cloud Connector (BICC) extracts from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.
  • Design and support downstream ingestion processes that load BICC extract files into data warehouses and BI semantic models.
  • Extract, ingest, and transform data from non-Oracle and external systems.
  • Develop batch and real-time data extraction processes using Boomi, Jitterbit, OIC (or equivalent middleware), REST APIs, SOAP web services, database connections, FTP/SFTP etc
  • Design data models, star schemas, fact tables, dimension tables, calculated measures, and KPIs that support accurate cross-system reporting.
  • Develop enterprise reporting datasets that combine Oracle Fusion ERP extracts with data from external systems.
  • Design and develop interactive BI dashboards, scorecards, executive reports, and self-service analytics solutions using Power BI and/or Tableau.
  • Design, develop, enhance, and support BI Publisher reports for Oracle Fusion ERP.
  • Build Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP extensions using Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS).
  • Develop and support inbound, outbound, real-time, and scheduled integrations between Oracle Fusion ERP and third-party systems.
  • Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into technical design documents.
  • Leverage Generative AI tools to improve analytics productivity and insight generation.
  • Work with Large Language Models (LLMs) to enable natural language querying and automated report generation
  • Follow organizational standards for security, data privacy, change management, and production support.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software development, Oracle Fusion Cloud technical development, business intelligence development, or enterprise reporting.
  • Strong experience developing BI Publisher reports, including data models, SQL queries, templates, report bursting, and scheduled delivery.
  • Hands-on experience developing integrations using a middleware tool such as Boomi, Jitter bit or OIC.
  • Experience integrating Oracle Fusion ERP with external systems using REST APIs, SOAP web services, Oracle adapters, FTP/SFTP, and file-based interfaces.
  • Experience with Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service, Oracle APEX, Oracle Process Automation, or Oracle SaaS extension technologies.
  • Experience designing or supporting ETL/ELT pipelines that combine Oracle Fusion BICC extracts with third-party or internal system data.
  • Knowledge of dimensional modeling, star schemas, fact and dimension tables, semantic models, data marts, and data warehouse concepts.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau (or equivalent tool) for dashboard and analytics development.
  • Experience creating data models, KPI definitions, calculated measures, visualizations, dashboard filters, drill-through reporting, and scheduled refresh processes.
  • Strong SQL, PL/SQL and Python experience preferred.
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion financial ERP modules.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Experience with AI-based automation or agentic AI in a finance or ERP setting.

title: Software Developer
description:
Software Developer

Location: Spain (Remote)

About Us

Broadsign is a growing software company with a mission to make buying, selling, and delivering out-of-home media easier than ever. Our software is operated by some of the most successful out-of-home businesses and powers impactful, compelling campaigns seen across the world. Come join us as a Software Developer!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Software Developer, you will play a pivotal role in driving the evolution of our industry-leading out-of-home media platforms by bridging the gap between robust backend architectures and sleek, responsive user interfaces. This role is designed for a developer who thrives on clean code and innovation, values strong engineering practices, and wants to see their work impact millions of viewers globally.

What to expect

The R&D department is at the center of the action at Broadsign. Your main focus will be to design and develop new features on both the front and back ends of our software suite. And because you’re a technology enthusiast, you’ll probably want to tweak and maintain our existing feature set as well! You’ll get to participate in sprints where you’ll be encouraged to share your ideas and knowledge with your team. You’ll be working in a dynamic and peer-driven environment where you’ll play with all the latest and greatest hardware and software!

What you need to perform in this job

  • 1-3 years of experience in software development
  • Interest in working with object-oriented languages, particularly C# (.NET Core)
  • Fluency in English is necessary for this position to communicate with our global team!
  • If you have some F# knowledge on top of that, that's an asset!
  • You understand and use the SOLID principles!
  • Computer science or Software Engineering Bachelor's degree

What we bring to the table

  • Wellness Allowance: 500 euros annual wellness fund to support your physical/mental health or home office expenses
  • Unlimited online mental health support via BetterHelp for you and your family.
  • Paid Time Off: vacation package + 5 flexible floater days, plus 3 paid training days and 2 paid volunteer days annually.
  • Remote work options, 60 days from another location+ pre-delivered home office setup equipment.
  • Family Support: Parental leave salary top-up/supplement if needed
  • Professional Development: Annual training & development budget to support your ongoing learning and professional growth.
  • Healthcare Allowance

At Broadsign, we value the varied social identities that make up our community.
We recognize talent comes in different forms and encourage applications that reflect different backgrounds and experiences.
Our promise is to be an inclusive employer and partner, open to learning, with thoughtful strategies and practices that amplify the different voices of our industry.

Knowledge of French is required for positions permanently located in Quebec, so incumbents can communicate with their colleagues and partners in Quebec as necessary. French-language training is offered to all incumbents in permanent positions in Quebec who do not have a good knowledge of French.
Fluent English is required for this position to communicate with colleagues, clients, and partners (or suppliers) located outside Quebec and to understand the technical and scientific documentation used in our industry

title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
CBEM brings lasting, positive changes to the individuals with developmental disabilities we serve, some of whom experience mental illness. Our process begins with observations from which we design a comprehensive plan. It continues on as we teach our clients and their circle of support how to obtain positive, sustainable outcomes.

Job Title: Quality Assurance Specialist

Location: Lafayette, CA (hybrid, 3 days in office)

FLSA Status: Exempt

Compensation: $95,000 annually + opportunities for performance bonuses

Reports to: QA & Compliance Director

At CBEM, we create lasting, positive change for individuals with developmental disabilities and some who experience co-occurring mental illness. Our innovative approach empowers clients and their support networks to achieve sustainable outcomes.

Ready to turn data into real-world impact? As our Quality Assurance Specialist, you will harness the power of healthcare analytics and root-cause problem solving to champion care quality. You will partner side-by-side with our operational teams to streamline workflows, elevate standards, and ensure every client gets the exceptional support they deserve.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Extract, analyze, and visualize data from our EHR system and Tableau/Power BI platforms to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational trends
  • Lead Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and PDCA cycles to solve systemic challenges and implement sustainable Corrective Action Plans.
  • Translate audit findings into engaging, targeted training sessions that help our clinical staff thrive and remain fully compliant.
  • Ensure alignment with state and federal regulations, including Title 17, DDS standards, and HIPAA guidelines.
  • Work side-by-side with Program Directors and operational leaders to foster a culture of quality, transparency, and accountability.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Data Analytics, Behavioral Health, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 3+ years in healthcare or human services QA, auditing, or compliance.
  • Hands-on experience with EHR platforms, Excel, and data visualization tools (Tableau or Power BI).
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement tools (Lean, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis, PDCA).
  • Understanding of Title 17, DDS, and HIPAA (experience in I/DD or behavioral health is a huge plus).

Physical Demands:

This role may require occasional lifting (up to 25 pounds)

What We Offer:

  • Nurturing learning environment with clear growth and career advancement opportunities.
  • Competitive salary with opportunities for quarterly bonuses.
  • Comprehensive health coverage (Medical, Dental, and Vision) starting from day one.
  • Company-provided computer and mobile device with a monthly internet stipend.
  • Generous paid time off including vacation, wellness, and sick days to support work-life balance.
  • Monthly Health & Wellness allowance to promote physical and mental well-being.
  • Professional Development programs to enhance skills and foster career growth.

To learn more about our mission and values, visit us at.

title: Supply Officer
description:
Company Overview
Action Against Hunger is an international humanitarian organization committed to ending world hunger. For almost 45 years, across countries, we have been working to fight undernutrition and support communities affected by crisis across the globe.

We carry out innovative, lifesaving programs in Health, Nutrition, Water, Sanitation and Hygiene, Mental Health and Psychosocial Support, Food Security and Livelihoods, and Social Protection.

Action Against Hunger began operations in Nigeria in 2010 in response to the high rate of chronic malnutrition in Northern Nigeria, focusing on integrated programming. Action Against Hunger currently implements multi-sectoral humanitarian and development interventions in Northeast and Northwest Nigeria, funded by AFD, EU/ECHO, French Government, GAC, GFFO, SIDA, US Government, and WAM Foundation.

Action Against Hunger Nigeria (ACF Nigeria) Ltd/Gte is currently recruiting a Supply Officer based in Nguru. The position will oversee the purchasing, supplier relationships, payments, and inventory in line with ACF procedures. This includes processing procurement requests, obtaining quotations, managing orders and deliveries, maintaining procurement records, and updating supplier information in LINK. The role also ensures timely supplier payments, accurate stock management, monthly inventories, and proper shipment documentation.


Position Details

Reporting to: Deputy Field Coordinator

Proposed start date: November 2026

Work location: Nguru, Yobe State


Key Responsibilities:

Manage orders & supplies

  • Process procurement according to ACF procedures (e.g. direct, tender process, etc);
  • Carry out requests for quotations;
  • Prepare the necessary documents for direct procurement and delivery;
  • Purchase ordered items in accordance with ACF logistics procedures;
  • Organise and monitor delivery;
  • Ensure proper receipt with the Stock Officer or requisitioners;
  • Solicit requisitioners prior to order and on delivery for all technical requests, to ensure conformity of ordered items;
  • Maintain information in LINK;
  • Prepare and maintain procurement records in accordance with ACF procedures (e.g. tender process).

Manage supplier data
  • Ensure constructive business relations with suppliers;
  • Prospect for / search for potential new suppliers;
  • Update the price list;
  • Update the supplier list on a monthly basis;
  • Updating the follow-up of contracts for each order (FO) under Framework Agreement.

Follow up on the payment of suppliers
  • Check and validate invoices in accordance with documentation, physical receipt and ACF procedures;
  • Make payments to suppliers for direct procurement after requesting an advance from the finance department;
  • Follow up the payment of suppliers with the finance department for larger expenses (transfer, cheque);
  • Ensure that ACF policies (Gender and Safeguarding, etc.) are well understood by suppliers.

Manage stock
  • Identify incoming and outgoing material and check quality and quantities;
  • Carry out a monthly inventory and complete an inventory report;
  • Maintain stock records;
  • Write up the various shipping documents.


Additional Responsibilities
  • This job description is not intended to be all inclusive and the employee will also perform other related tasks as required and responsible for reporting and communication of progress and achievement of the specific assigned task.
  • Maintenance of high technical standards.
  • Conduct all duties in a professional manner following ACF Nigeria mission staff regulations, ACF mandate and charter including promotion of gender equality.

Position Requirements:
  • Bachelor's Degree or Higher National Diploma in Logistics, Business Administration, Purchasing & Supply, or a related field.
  • At least 2 years of relevant work experience in supply chain/procurement
  • Good knowledge of procurement, supply, and supply chain management.
  • Familiarity with the LINK procurement tool
  • Experience supervising staff is an advantage
  • Strong MS Office skills, especially Excel.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.
  • Professional proficiency in English and knowledge of local language.
  • Ability to work effectively in a demanding and complex/insecure environment.


At Action Against Hunger, we foster a work culture that champions diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to creating an environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive

Application Deadline:
Tuesday, 27th October, 2026 at 05:00 pm (Nigerian Time)

Important Notice:
Action Against Hunger does not charge any fee at any stage of the recruitment process – this includes application, interview, or processing fees.

Our Commitment:
We are dedicated to preventing all forms of unwanted behaviour in the workplace, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity, and financial misconduct. We are equally committed to safeguarding the welfare of children, young people and adults. We prioritize hiring individuals who embody and uphold our core values.

We help Fortune 500 companies harness the power of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Data Science, Data Engineering and Advanced Analytics to solve their most complex challenges, unlock new growth opportunities, and create lasting business impact.

We are at the forefront of the AI revolution, helping enterprises move beyond traditional analytics to embrace Generative AI, agentic AI, intelligent automation, and cloud-native data platforms. A global presence across North America, Latin America, Europe, and India.

Grow alongside a team that invests in developing future-ready skills and encourages innovation.

Benefits

title: Outreach & Engagement Supervisor
description:
About Colla Health

We help people with cancer improve their quality of life by providing behavioral healthcare to the 17 million cancer patients in the US as an extension of their medical treatment.

One out of every three cancer patients has a diagnosed mental health condition but only 25% of them receive treatment for their mental health challenges, exacerbating quality of life, worsening health outcomes, and increasing their total cost of care to the system. We are on a mission to provide relevant, accessible behavioral health at the point of care that is embedded within a patient’s oncology practice. We are backed by a premier venture capital firm and are building a world-class team of clinicians, technologists, and healthcare operations builders passionate about helping cancer patients improve their quality of life.

We have built a behavioral health services and technology company to support patients' mental health alongside their physical health treatment plans. Our first offering deploys virtual mental health services using Collaborative Care, an evidence-based behavioral health care model. We will scale this virtual care model using technology, and build the foundations to drive outcomes focused on value-based care.

Role Overview

The Patient Access Supervisor provides leadership and operational oversight for the Outreach & Engagement team, who connect oncology patients with Colla Health’s behavioral health services. This role supervises day-to-day operations, ensures high-quality patient engagement, implements the team’s technology, and coordinates closely with Clinical Services, Partner Success, and partner oncology clinics to drive enrollment outcomes in alignment with organizational and regulatory standards.


Core Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Supervision

  • Hire, train, and supervise Outreach and Engagement Specialists, providing ongoing performance feedback, call reviews, and coaching
  • Support Specialists with complex or sensitive patient conversations and handle escalated calls
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable team culture, and oversee onboarding and professional development of new hires
  • Maintain a limited, active outreach volume to model best practices in patient conversations and documentation standards

Outreach Operations & Technology

  • Own daily outreach operations, including prioritization, outreach cadence, voicemail triage, and timely follow-up
  • Drive enrollment and engagement performance against company KPIs (e.g., reach rate, intake kept rate, time to first contact), using performance data to make informed operational decisions
  • Implement and manage day-to-day use of the team’s tools (CRM, telephony platform, EHR access), including user access, workflow setup, and team training, in partnership with the Head of Patient Access and Care Operations, who owns technology strategy and platform decisions.

Quality & Compliance

  • Audit calls and documentation to ensure quality and accurate records of patient outreach, and to support eligibility verification and billing requirements
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies, HIPAA, and TCPA and consent requirements

Collaboration & Program Development

  • Serve as the liaison between Outreach & Engagement, Clinical Services, Partner Success, and partner oncology clinics to support care coordination
  • Codify outreach playbooks and best practices, and lead continuous improvement and special projects
  • Provide input on staffing and resource allocation, and participate in data collection and program evaluation to demonstrate program impact

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, social science, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 2–5 years of experience in patient outreach, patient access, enrollment, care coordination, or healthcare business development
  • 1+ year of experience supervising, leading, or training a team
  • Demonstrated track record of meeting outcome-based KPIs such as enrollment, conversion, or engagement goals
  • Strong communication skills, high emotional intelligence, and comfort guiding sensitive patient conversations
  • Working proficiency with CRM, telephony, and other operational systems (e.g., Salesforce, spreadsheets, EMRs), including configuring workflows and using data to manage team performance.

Preferred

  • Experience in oncology, behavioral health, or chronic disease settings
  • Familiarity with the Collaborative Care Model, eligibility verification, and healthcare compliance (Ex: HIPAA, TCPA)
  • Experience working with underserved populations and a passion for expanding access to behavioral health services

Compensation And Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision benefits
  • Flexible PTO
  • 401(k)
  • Access to and mentorship from leading clinicians and experts in psycho-oncology and integrated behavioral health
  • Fully remote work

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Description

In FC Quality Verification Engineering, our mission is to build the test automation and AI-powered developer tools that help our EA SPORTS FC teams understand game quality. We partner with development, quality, production, and live operations teams across Vancouver and Bucharest.

Role summary

As an Engineering Manager in Vancouver, you will work with us to lead a team of software engineers building and running these systems. You will combine people leadership with delivery ownership, reporting to our Technical Director.

Responsibilities

  • Build and elevate an engineering team. Hire, onboard and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, useful feedback, performance management and career planning.

  • You will lead technical execution with clear ownership, achievable plans and a sustainable workload across locations and time zones.

  • Turn our partner priorities into delivery commitments, adapting plans as needs evolve, following through on milestones, and communicating risks, dependencies, and obstacles early to technical and non-technical partners.

  • You will partner with our Technical Director and engineers to review designs, explain decisions and trade-offs, and resolve technical roadblocks.

  • You will take initiative to improve our engineering practices across design, testing, continuous integration, and operational support using quality, reliability, and adoption metrics.

  • You will track relevant technology trends and developments, guiding our team in evaluating and adopting AI-assisted workflows and engineering tools.

Required qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, including hands-on engineering and technical team leadership.

  • 2+ years of direct people management of software engineers, including coaching, performance management and career development.

  • Proven success spearheading the delivery of automation, developer tooling, or comparable platforms, owning prioritization, capacity planning, and complex cross-team dependencies.

  • Experience in C#, C++, or Python, software design, testing, and Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) workflows.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Description and requirements

In FC Quality Verification Engineering, our mission is to build the technology, large-scale test automation, and AI-powered developer tools that help our EA SPORTS FC teams understand game quality and decide when we are ready to ship. We work closely with development, quality verification, production, content, and live operations teams.

Role summary

As a Senior Software Developer in Vancouver you will manage these systems from proposal to adoption. You will shape our technical direction, write code, define success metrics, and mentor engineers on our team. You will report to our Technical Director, FC Quality Verification Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of closed-loop, multi-agent state machines, human-in-the-loop execution flows, and Generative AI testing frameworks for hyper-personalization systems.

  • Develop distributed agent execution environment that autonomously run and self-heal end-to-end tests across complex environments.

  • Develop statistical validation solutions, probabilistic rubrics, and calibration frameworks to measure feature quality, model drift, and non-deterministic agent behaviour at scale.

  • Own technical designs, build reusable components, and improve our Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) workflows and distributed execution services.

  • Diagnose failures across code, data, and infrastructure, fix root causes, and mentor our engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing.

  • Act as product owner for the systems you lead: work with stakeholders to define and prioritize requirements, agree scope and success criteria, turn them into delivery plans, and keep partners informed of estimates, progress, risks and dependencies.

  • Learn and evaluate new engineering approaches, including AI-assisted workflows where useful, and measure improvements in reliability, feedback speed and adoption.

Required qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software development experience.

  • A Batchelor or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field that includes coursework or academic exposure to Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning concepts.

  • Proficiency in C# or C++ and Python, alongside experience designing complex software systems, automated testing, and version control.
