title: Test Specialist, Avionics (Starshield)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

TEST SPECIALIST, AVIONICS (STARSHIELD)

Starshield leverages SpaceX's Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on three areas: Earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. Designed to meet diverse mission requirements, Starshield satellites are capable of integrating a wide variety of payloads, offering unique versatility to users. With the proven ability to iterate rapidly, SpaceX's unique full-stack approach in developing end-to-end systems, from launch vehicles to user terminals, enables the deployment of capabilities at scale with unprecedented speed. Starshield's proliferated low-Earth orbit architecture provides inherent resiliency and constant connectivity to on-orbit assets, while SpaceX's proven rapid launch capability provides expedient and economical access to space.

The Test Specialist, Avionics role is responsible for supporting the production of Starshield satellites. This includes designing tooling (electrical checkout racks, vehicle harnessing, DAQ setups, etc.) and processes (vehicle checkout software, harness/component integration, troubleshooting procedures, etc.) to build Starshield vehicles at a continually increasing and rapid cadence. Test Specialists are expected to contribute to daily production activities, including dispositioning and troubleshooting issues, providing feedback, and running basic Python-based test software improvements to reduce false failures and improve test coverage. They also design first-article flight and GSE hardware, work with engineers to execute subsystem development testing, aid technicians with satellite production, and provide support with setting up and executing vehicle-level qualification tests, such as thermal vacuum chamber (TVAC), electromagnetic interference (EMI), and other design validation tests.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborate with engineers to develop and document test procedures on both development and flight hardware
  • Perform tests with engineers according to test procedures and automated test scripts, providing data and preliminary test results used to derive pass/fail criteria for each test
  • Assist in the design and fabrication of hardware, including harnessing, test fixtures, and server racks
  • Troubleshoot and write rework instructions for failing hardware in both hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) and factory environments
  • Bring up and configure Linux-based servers for use in HITL and factory environments, following standardized procedures
  • Support satellite qualification testing by performing satellite operations using work instructions developed alongside engineers
  • Fabricate and repair cable harnesses, including soldering, crimping, and assembling connectors
  • Support development of test automation software using Python with guidance from engineering

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 2+ years of experience working in a hands-on technical position, or a bachelor's degree in an engineering field
  • 1+ years of experience performing electronic testing and inspection using portable measuring devices

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in an engineering field
  • 5+ years of experience reading electrical schematics to rework boards or perform tests
  • Experience with test operations procedures, including thermal, vibration, thermal vacuum, shock, and EMI (electromagnetic interference), and safe handling of flight parts
  • Ability to read electromechanical schematics to interpret test results and understand system functionality
  • Ability to troubleshoot interconnected systems, determine root causes, and implement fixes
  • Experience installing and using test instrumentation sensors, such as strain gauges, deflection gauges, pressure transducers, load cells, thermocouples, RTDs, accelerometers, and analog circuitry
  • Strong computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Visio) and the ability to navigate and manipulate files
  • Experience with, or interest in, software development in Python and working with Linux-based systems
  • Ability to rapidly change roles and responsibilities while working in a fast-paced, challenging environment
  • Ability to solve complex problems with minimal supervision on tight schedules
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to work all shifts, overtime, and/or weekends as needed. Certain recurring testing events require a 4 a.m. start; a later start at 8 a.m. is possible on days without testing events
  • Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching are generally required to perform the functions of this position
  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted
  • This role is onsite in Hawthorne, CA. Remote work is not considered
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $33.00 - $39.00
Level 2: $37.00 - $44.00
Level 3: $41.00 - $50.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: QA Manager
description:
Quality Assurance Manager

About Bold Coast Seafood

Bold Coast Seafood operates a 100,000 square foot facility on the working waterfront of Prospect Harbor, Maine, built around a deepwater dock, a buying station, refrigerated tanks capable of holding over 200,000 pounds of lobster and crab, a state of the art processing floor, office space, and a research lab. We supply customers with high quality seafood harvested from the cold, clean waters of Maine, and we are currently expanding into a new business line: crab processing.

We built this company on the belief that people do their best work when they feel good about where they work. We address problems directly, we expect people to bring solutions rather than just complaints, and we support each other, even on hard days. As we grow, we are looking for people who want to grow with us.

About the Role

Bold Coast Seafood is hiring a QA Manager to own food safety and quality across our growing processing operation, from receiving through butchering, frozen, and shipping. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will build the quality program and the team behind it, and you will be on the floor every day, not just behind a desk.

We are looking for a leader who is comfortable speaking up in the moment, coaching people on the line, and holding the standard with clear, respectful communication. Documentation matters, but quality is protected by what happens on the floor.

What You Will Do

  • Own the food safety and quality program for the facility, including HACCP, FSMA compliance, and any customer or third-party audit requirements.

  • Build and lead the QA team: four QA staff covering receiving, butchering, frozen, and shipping, plus a QA lead.

  • Hire, train, schedule, and coach QA team members, and set clear expectations and standards for each area.

  • Spend time on the production floor daily, speaking up in real time when something is out of spec and coaching people toward the right fix.

  • Inspect and verify incoming product at receiving, and make quality holds and release decisions.

  • Develop, maintain, and audit written procedures, specifications, sanitation standards, and quality records.

  • Lead corrective and preventive actions, root cause investigations, and follow-up on quality issues or customer complaints.

  • Host and prepare for regulatory inspections and customer audits, and keep the facility audit-ready.

  • Partner with the Production Manager, Maintenance, Dock, and Shipping and Receiving on a shared approach to safety and quality.

  • Serve on the safety committee and support a culture where front-line staff are encouraged to solve problems and report back.

  • Track and report quality metrics to the General Manager, and recommend improvements as the operation scales.

What We're Looking For

  • USDC certification (required).

  • FSMA or BRC certification (required, one of the two).

  • 3 to 4 years of management experience preferred, ideally in food or seafood quality assurance.

  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to speak up on the floor, not just document problems.

  • Experience building or leading a team, including hiring, training, and coaching.

  • Working knowledge of HACCP, sanitation, traceability, and food safety documentation.

  • Comfortable working in cold, wet environments and around live and processed seafood.

  • A positive, solution-oriented attitude that fits our culture of bringing ideas forward instead of just flagging problems.

  • Ability to work Monday through Saturday, with flexibility during peak seasons.

  • Seafood industry experience is a strong plus.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods on a production floor.

  • Comfortable working in cold, wet, and fast-paced conditions, including around refrigerated and frozen areas.

  • Ability to lift and move product samples, totes, and equipment as needed.

  • Ability to wear required PPE, including boots, gloves, hairnets, and outerwear, for the full shift.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Paid time off.

  • Performance-based bonus program tied to defined milestones.

  • A growing company where you can build a department from the ground up and see the direct impact of your work.

Bold Coast Seafood is an equal opportunity employer.

This is a role with direct ownership of customer satisfaction, retention, loyalty, memberships, and repeat revenue across our North American locations.

You'll lead our Customer Retention and Experience team while building the strategies, systems, and programs that keep customers coming back. From exceptional customer service to membership growth, revenue-generating customer interactions, and innovative loyalty initiatives, you'll play a meaningful role in how we scale.

We're looking for someone who thinks like a business owner, loves both people and numbers, and knows how to turn great customer experiences into measurable growth.

Customer Experience & Team Leadership

Analytics, Reporting & Performance

Bonus Qualifications

Our Puppy Sphere Values:

description:
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

Caylent's Anthropic Business Unit is a dedicated AI services practice built in partnership with Anthropic — Anthropic's first pure-play delivery partner. Engagements are production-grade: agents, data products, AI-augmented operations, workforce transformation.

Senior FDEs run their own accounts — full relationship, from discovery through close, without anyone above managing the engagement. You scope, architect, build, and close. You are the account.

We hire into two specializations: Technology-Workforce FDEs run solo technical engagements in engineering and IT organizations, owning architecture decisions and LLM-native delivery end-to-end; Operational FDEs lead single-function AI adoption programs across business workforces — persona discovery, role-specific enablement, and workflow automations deployed and owned by you.

Your Assignment

  • Identify and surface expansion opportunities
  • Transfer capability that lasts: documented, runnable, maintainable software or automations that work after you leave

You carry an account without daily check-ins, read tension in a client org before it surfaces, and bring expansion signals forward without being asked. This role is structured around full account ownership — people who do well here are energized by that autonomy and accountability.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
About us

Moneyhub empowers leading financial services organisations to understand their clients’ needs better. We provide the data services and embedded technologies required to deliver highly personalised, lifelong financial relationships.

We are a data and payments company building ISO 27001-certified software for Open Banking, Open Finance, and Open Data. Our FCA-regulated platform lets organisations turn financial data into personalised digital experiences and initiate payments and hundreds of organisations across finance, media and retail rely on it.

The role

We are seeking an experienced engineer who has built things people actually use and still wants to write the code.

You will have taken products from nothing to real users, more than once and seen what happens to them afterwards. We will ask what you shipped, who used it and what you did yourself. We mean end users, not just other engineers.

Scale and performance matter here - clients notice when things are slow. You know how to find the bottleneck rather than guess at it. You are comfortable reading a flame chart and you will follow a problem down as far as it goes, whether that is a React component re-rendering because of a misused useEffect or cache locality in the hot path of an algorithm.

You will have seen approaches fail in different companies and codebases and you know why. People will want your view before they start something and you will have influenced what a team builds without being their manager.

You also need to be using agentic engineering already and treating it as a multiplier. One good engineer can now take on work that used to need a team. We want to hear your opinions and your approach.

What you would work on

In your first 6–12 months, you might:

  • Ship a committed piece of work to production in your first three months, and come out of it with two or three platform improvements you think we should take on next.
  • Take a project of your own from prototype to production, such as redesigning part of an event processing or data pipeline so it handles more load, more reliably.
  • Set the standard for agentic engineering: show the team the workflows that work for you, and turn them into patterns other teams adopt.

Success in this role looks like a steady record of shipped work, with at least two of your architectural patterns or AI standards in use across engineering.



How you would work

You would join our experienced engineering team - we are about 40 software/platform/data engineers and data scientists. We use Shape Up, and you would work within it: shaping bets, delivering committed work, and getting things over the line with the teams.

Our culture is based on trust, and we empower people to deliver in the way that suits them best. For this role, that means real say over how you solve problems and some latitude over what you pick up, alongside the expectation that your work is visible, shared with your colleagues and pointed at what the business needs. In practice, you might have a committed bet, something you are improving because it needs it, and something you are exploring for a future cycle. Judging which deserves your time, and being open about it, is a big part of the job.

This is an individual contributor role. No line management, and no moving away from the code.

Our stack

Most of our platform is TypeScript on Node. Python is used across data science and machine learning. We use Kafka for events, Postgres for most of our data, and Kubernetes on AWS to run it all.

We want someone comfortable across data science, Python, Node, React and Rust. You do not need to be an expert in each, but none of them should put you off. If you have not used a language before, we expect you to pick it up.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

  • Experience at several startups and on systems at real scale, shipping software that people actually used
  • A track record of building and running software in production across different companies and codebases, including the unglamorous years after launch
  • The person others turn to when something is hard or has gone wrong, with experience setting technical direction without authority over the people doing the work
  • A habit of finding where a system slows down under real load, working out why and fixing it, using profilers and flame charts rather than guesswork. Equally at home with a front-end rendering problem or the memory behaviour of a tight loop
  • Comfort across Python, Node, React, Rust and data science. Not an expert in each, but none of them a worry
  • The ability to work properly with data scientists. No need to be one, but an understanding of how to judge a model (precision, recall and F1 score) and what the numbers mean for the product and for clients
  • Still hands-on, with every intention of staying that way
  • Already using agentic tools day to day and getting more done because of them
  • An eye for work worth doing and the drive to make the case for it rather than wait for a brief
  • Sound judgement on security, privacy and client trust. This is regulated financial software
  • Clear communication, whether with engineers, senior stakeholders or clients

Nice to have: experience with open banking, connections or identity systems.

Probably not a fit if

  • You cannot point to software that end users used, or to technical decisions of yours that people followed.
  • You want to stay in one language, or only the front end or the back end.
  • You are unsure about agentic engineering, or see it as a shortcut.
  • You only want a defined set of tickets.
  • You would rather work outside a team process than within one.
  • You want a management role, or architecture at a distance from the codebase.

How to apply

Apply via the link below.

Questions about the role? Please contact Dilshan Rukunayake, Principal TA Partner, dilshan.rukunayake@moneyhub.com

Right to work and screening

You must have the right to work in the UK. As an FCA-regulated firm, offers are subject to pre-employment screening, including reference, credit and criminal record checks.

Benefits

  • 5% employer pension contribution from your first day, with a 3% employee contribution
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, rising to 30 days after two years
  • Option to take UK bank holidays at other times, on days of significance to you
  • Holiday purchase scheme
  • Private medical insurance, including cover for pre-existing conditions, plus dental and optical benefit
  • Three months’ Moneyhubber Family Pay when you become a new parent
  • Permanent health insurance and life cover well above the industry standard
  • Employee assistance programme
  • Life event leave
  • Professional development support, with a dedicated allowance of time and money
  • £750 towards professional memberships
  • Remote working support, including access to co-working spaces and help setting up your home office
  • High-spec laptop
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • EV car scheme

title: Junior Software Developer
description:
Junior Software Developer (Android & TypeScript)

Reports To: Director of Engineering

Location: Montreal, QC (Hybrid: work remotely or from the office, your choice!)

About us

Broadsign is a growing software company with a mission to make buying, selling, and delivering out-of-home media easier than ever. Our software is operated by some of the most successful out-of-home businesses and powers impactful, compelling campaigns seen across the world.

Come join us as a Cross-Platform Software Developer (Android & TypeScript) in Montreal.

About the role

As a Software Developer in Android and TypeScript applications, you will play a key role in building scalable applications that power our global OOH network. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and high-performance technical solutions, ensuring our codebase remains maintainable and robust as we continue to innovate.

What to expect

  • Feature Development & Enhancement: In this role, you will develop and maintain a Media Player Application (Android and TypeScript). This is not your typical application, as it is not one for human users but is designed to run with minimal human interaction and is built for robustness and high availability.
  • You will work on a fairly new project with an evolving infrastructure stack using Kotlin, TypeScript, and WebView/Chromium. You will be part of our DevOps culture, focusing on writing clean, reusable, and secure code that supports a diverse range of devices. Furthermore, we dedicate quarterly time to Innovation Days, allowing you to explore and develop new ideas.
  • Collaboration & Agile Practices: You will join an Agile team including a Product Manager, a QA analyst, and a group of driven developers. Success is built on collaboration, which is why you will actively participate in code reviews, offering constructive feedback to uphold high standards of code quality. You will contribute to technical design discussions and help shape the future architecture of our applications.
  • Quality & Performance Optimization: Quality is at the core of what we do. You will therefore identify, debug, and fix defects reported internally or by customers and implement unit and integration tests using JUnit and Jest to ensure complete feature coverage. Because our software runs in diverse environments, you will optimize applications for best performance and stability on low-spec hardware.

What you need to perform in this job

  • Experience: 1-3 years of professional software development experience.
  • Technical Proficiency: Knowledge of Android development or TypeScript

What we bring to the table

  • Financial Perks: Transportation reimbursement for travel to a Broadsign office.

title: Shipping Receiving Supervisor
description:

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a highly motivated and experienced individual to join our team

Position Overview

The ideal candidate demonstrates strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills, with a proven ability to maintain productivity and safety in a fast-paced environment

Job Description (Function and Responsibilities):

  • Supervise and coordinate daily warehouse activities including receiving, shipping, inventory control, and material handling.
  • Ensure accurate and timely movement of materials to support production and customer orders.
  • Monitor inventory levels and conduct regular cycle counts to maintain accuracy.
  • Schedule and assign tasks to warehouse staff, ensuring workload balance and efficient workflow.
  • Train, coach, and evaluate warehouse employees to ensure adherence to company policies and performance standards.
  • Oversee proper handling, labeling, and storage of all materials and finished goods.

title: Sr Strategic Alliances Manager

  • Orchestrate execution across Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Technical Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations.
  • Monitor customer, market, and competitive trends and recommend adjustments to partnership strategy and investment.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, and Operations to manage contractual commitments, renewals, key milestones, and other time-sensitive requirements.
  • Maintain clear partnership documentation and governance to ensure accountability, visibility, and consistent execution.
  • Bring a strong, fact-based point of view and help senior stakeholders make timely decisions.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in strategic alliances, business development, partner management, product strategy, go-to-market, general management, or a related area.
  • Experience managing strategic relationships and complex cross-functional initiatives within a B2B software or technology environment.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to approach a strategic partnership as a business, balancing growth, customer value, investment, and profitability.
  • Experience turning strategy into coordinated execution across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of B2B software go-to-market models, technology alliances, partner/channel ecosystems, and recurring revenue businesses.
  • Ability to define and analyze KPIs, interpret business and financial performance, identify root causes, and recommend action.
  • Executive presence with the ability to influence and align senior internal and external stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, program management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Working knowledge of commercial agreements and an ability to partner effectively with Legal and other subject-matter experts on contractual requirements.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent relevant business experience.

Nice to Have

Experience working within MSP, cybersecurity, IT management, or channel-led technology businesses is strongly preferred.

title: Electro Mechanical Intern
description:
At Fosber America, your career is Outside the Box!


Our machines produce corrugated board to create boxes, but the career potential within our company cannot be contained! Fosber is an organization that promotes from within and believes in developing our people - come grow with us!


Trust and transparency are cornerstones of Fosber's culture. Our President personally meets each employee invited to join our team, and remains in touch with the entire workforce. Regular company meetings keep the team informed about Fosber's current state of business. With Fosber, you will be a trusted member of the organization, taking ownership of your own career growth. We provide support in your professional development via internal training opportunities and tuition reimbursement.


Our workplace is a community, and we believe in giving back! Fosber employees come together to help those in need through the efforts of our voluntary charity committee. Our people are known for excellent customer service - and we believe they are the best co-workers too! At Fosber, you'll develop a professional network to help you succeed.


Fosber offers a competitive benefit package with a choice of several different Medical plans, Dental, Vision, 401K with employer match, Flex Spending, wellness incentives, and more! We know that healthy and happy employees bring their best selves to work each day!


We can't wait to talk to you more about the exciting career paths available at Fosber! Please apply online, and if qualified we will contact you to discuss the opportunities we have within our growing company!


Due to continued growth, we are currently looking for an electro-mechanical intern to join our team in Green Bay, WI.


Some of the benefits of this exceptional opportunity are:


Stability and Reputation– Established in 1998, Fosber America grew to become a leading supplier of corrugated machinery in North America. We provide customers with superior technology at a competitive price, fully supported by the Fosber team’s commitment to after sales service. Fosber has grown rapidly over the past several years and we anticipate continued strength in the marketplace.

Compensation and Benefits – Fosber America, Inc. offers paid internship opportunities. title: Vehicle Delivery Specalist
description:
Come join the Milton Martin Honda Family! We are currently looking for a Vehicle Delivery Specialist to join our team!


Our Vehicle Delivery Specialist is responsible for coordinating and managing new and used vehicle deliveries, ensuring a smooth, organized, and exceptional customer experience. While also maintaining accurate delivery records, educating our customers on their vehicle's features and technology, encourage customer reviews, and follow up after purchase to support long-term customer satisfaction and Milton Martin Honda loyalty.


Milton Martin Honda Offers:

  • Paid training and certifications
  • Paid Time off and holidays
  • Competitive Compensation
  • 5-day work week
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life benefits
  • 401(k) with matching contribution
  • 401(k) Roth
  • HSA matching contribution
  • Work-life balance

Key Job Responsibilities:

  • Vehicle Delivery Coordination as a liaison between the Sales, Finance, and Detail departments to ensure every vehicle is ready for delivery and every customer receives a personalized vehicle orientation.
  • Coordinate all new and used vehicle deliveries between the Sales, Finance, and Detailing departments.
  • Confirm vehicles are properly cleaned, prepared, and ready for delivery before the scheduled appointment.
  • Communicate with the appropriate departments to address delays, missing items, or customer concerns.
  • Ensure each customer receives a smooth, professional, and timely delivery experience.
  • Maintain an organized Excel tracking sheet documenting completed deliveries, customer assistance, and review requests to ensure no customer is overlooked
  • Customer Vehicle Orientation
  • Conduct a comprehensive, personalized vehicle orientation for every customer taking delivery of a new or used vehicle.
  • Explain the vehicle's features, controls, safety systems, convenience features, and available technology.
  • Tailor each orientation to the customer's familiarity with vehicles and individual needs.
  • Answer customer questions and address concerns during the delivery process.
  • Ensure customers feel comfortable and confident operating their new vehicle before leaving the dealership.


  • Technology Setup and Customer Education
  • Assist customers with pairing their smartphones to the vehicle through Bluetooth.
  • Help customers set up and understand the vehicle's navigation system, when equipped.
  • Assist with HondaLink enrollment, setup, and configuration, as applicable.
  • Educate customers on HondaLink features, connected services, and available functionality.
  • Explain how to use key vehicle technologies, including audio, hands-free calling, driver-assistance features, and other applicable systems.
  • Verify that customers understand the basic operation of their vehicle's technology before delivery is completed.


  • Customer Satisfaction Surveys and Online Reviews
  • Explain the importance of Honda Customer Satisfaction Experience (CSE) surveys and how customer feedback contributes to evaluating the dealership and salesperson's performance.
  • Encourage customers to complete their surveys and provide honest feedback about their experience.
  • Identify and communicate unresolved customer concerns to management promptly.
  • Request Google reviews from customers following a positive purchase and delivery experience.
  • Track review requests and completed reviews in the designated Excel spreadsheet.
  • Maintain a professional approach when discussing surveys and reviews, without pressuring customers or directing them to provide a particular rating.


  • Post-Sale Customer Follow-Up
  • Contact customers approximately three days after their vehicle purchase to ensure they are satisfied and comfortable with their vehicle.
  • Confirm that customers understand their vehicle's features and technology and offer assistance with any questions.
  • Address concerns or coordinate with the appropriate department or manager when additional support is needed.
  • Conduct customer anniversary follow-ups to recognize purchase milestones, strengthen customer relationships, and encourage continued loyalty to Milton Martin Honda.
  • Document all follow-up attempts, customer responses, concerns, and resolutions in the designated tracking system or Excel spreadsheet.


  • Recordkeeping and Accountability
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date delivery and follow-up records.
  • Record customer names, vehicle information, delivery dates, orientation completion, review requests, and follow-up status.
  • Ensure every delivered vehicle is accounted for and every customer receives the required follow-up.
  • Communicate outstanding tasks and unresolved issues to management.
  • Protect customer information and follow dealership policies regarding customer data and documentation.

title: Dog Groomer
description:
About the role

The Groomer role is part of a dedicated grooming team focused on delivering high-quality care and styling services for dogs and cats of all breeds and sizes. The position involves hands-on grooming work including bathing, trimming, styling, and general wellness checks, carried out in a professional salon environment where animal comfort and safety are the top priority. Day-to-day work includes direct interaction with pet owners, coordination with teammates, and upkeep of a clean and organized grooming space. This is a role for someone who takes pride in their craft and is committed to providing a consistent, stress-free experience for every pet that comes through the door.

Must have experience grooming professionally to be considered for this role.


Responsibilities

  • Grooming Services
    • Grooms a minimum of 4 dogs per day (not including baths)
    • Perform breed-appropriate bathing, brushing, drying, trimming, and styling for dogs and cats
    • Execute cuts based on client specifications, breed standards, or owner preferences
    • Provide nail trimming, ear cleaning, teeth brushing, and anal gland expression as requested
    • Identify and communicate any skin conditions, parasites, lumps, or health concerns observed during grooming to owners
  • Client & Pet Interaction
    • Greet clients professionally and gather detailed grooming instructions prior to each appointment
    • Handle pets of varying temperaments, sizes, and needs with patience and care
    • Communicate updates to pet owners during and after appointments, including any behavioral or health observations
    • Build and maintain positive relationships with returning clients and their pets
  • Facility & Safety Standards
    • Maintain a clean, organized, and sanitary grooming station between each appointment
    • Follow proper sanitation protocols for tools, equipment, and grooming surfaces
    • Adhere to safe animal handling procedures to minimize stress, prevent injury, and keep all teammates safe
    • Ensure all equipment (dryers, clippers, scissors) is properly maintained and in safe working condition
  • Operations & Administration
    • Manage appointment scheduling and maintain accurate client records and grooming histories
    • Communicate supply needs and assist with inventory management
    • Collaborate with team members to ensure efficient workflow and a positive salon environment

Qualifications

Required

  • 1–3 years of professional pet grooming experience in a salon, veterinary, or mobile grooming environment
  • Demonstrated proficiency in grooming a variety of breeds and coat types
  • Strong knowledge of safe animal handling practices
  • Ability to stand for extended periods and safely lift pets up to 50 lbs if needed
  • Reliable, punctual, and professional demeanor

Preferred

  • Certification from a recognized grooming program (e.g., National Dog Groomers Association of America, International Professional Groomers)
  • Experience with cats or exotic small animals
  • First aid and CPR certification for animals
  • Familiarity with grooming salon management software

Growth Path: Lead Groomer

Lead Groomers have ~5+ years of experience and are responsible for training new Groomers and assisting with scheduling. Readiness for advancement includes:

  • Consistent record of strong attendance and team engagement.
  • Proven leadership and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Deep understanding of Grooming operations at Digs as well as front-of-house operations
  • Demonstrated ability to train and mentor others effectively.
  • Strong alignment with Digs’ values and commitment to continuous improvement.

What We Offer

  • Commission: 50%
  • Flexible hours and schedule
  • PTO & medical benefits available after 6 months to full time teammates
  • 401k company match up to 4% starting at 90 days
  • Equity package after 1 year of service

title: Machine Learning Scientist
description:
Note: We are currently collecting resumes for this role; active hiring will begin in December. Details of the role may be revised when hiring begins.

Blue Rose Research develops cutting-edge products used by the most important progressive organizations in the country. Our research informs short- and long-term strategy for advancing progressive causes and has a trusted track record among key decision makers.

We're a fast, dynamic team shipping innovative work that evolves week by week. We're looking for someone who brings passion for machine learning, sharp attention to detail, and a drive to make an impact – sometimes under tight timelines.

Public examples of our work

  • David Shor's conversation with Ezra Klein in the New York Times analyzing the 2024 election is the best public window into how we think.
  • How Democrats Will Run on the GOP's Tax Bill: the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee’s and Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee’s shared memo on how Blue Rose’s research is informing their campaign communications.
  • Bernie Sanders on AI job loss: Senator Sanders cites Blue Rose polling while talking about voters’ fears of AI causing job loss.

What You'll Do

We're hiring a Machine Learning Scientist to join our Scaled Polling & Forecasting Team, the group responsible for Blue Rose's flagship electoral work. Our team builds and maintains models that help progressive organizations understand the electoral landscape and make informed decisions. We track public opinion, forecast races across the ballot, develop resource allocation tools, and deliver analysis that campaigns and allied organizations rely on to set strategy.

Our problems are not well suited to off-the-shelf ML solutions: we work with messy, evolving political data and constantly pressure-test our accuracy against real election outcomes. The role spans the full modeling lifecycle from raw survey data to predictive scores and requires both rigorous statistical thinking and the judgment to know when a number is real versus an artifact.

Specifically, you'll:

  • Build and maintain end-to-end modeling pipelines, improving reliability, data quality checks, and model diagnostics to increase confidence in our outputs.
  • Develop models and perform feature engineering, contributing new ideas to improve our polling and survey infrastructure. You'll think creatively about the right ways to evaluate model performance in contexts where standard metrics don't apply cleanly.
    • Models include Identity Resolution, Record Linkage, and Forecasting models.
  • Translate statistical outputs into actionable guidance for internal stakeholders, connecting model outputs to the strategic questions campaigns and organizations care about.
  • Scope technical needs and ship solutions alongside engineers, statisticians, and political analysts.
  • Build subject matter context, developing deep knowledge of the political landscape to inform modeling decisions and catch anomalies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional experience in machine learning engineering or research science with applied statistics and predictive modeling OR equivalent depth from a PhD program. We're open to both paths. What matters is strong instincts for evaluating model performance, diagnosing bugs, and making principled judgment calls under uncertainty.
  • Technical: Confident Python programmer who can navigate a codebase and implement extensions. Strong data-wrangling experience, ideally including SQL and relational databases. We are particularly interested in ML expertise in Identity Resolution, Matching / Record Linkage, Survey and Voterfile Modeling, and/or scaled Bayesian Modeling (numpyro/JAX), but all talented ML researchers should apply.
  • Collaborative: You thrive in multi-disciplinary teams working alongside engineers, statisticians, and political experts, and you're excited to partner with less technical stakeholders and see your work impact real-world decisions.
  • A strong communicator: You can translate between statistical and substantive thinking, explaining what a model is saying (and not saying) to people who think in terms of strategy, not standard errors.
  • Curious: You're eager to engage with the wider progressive political ecosystem and develop domain knowledge alongside your technical skills.
  • A good teammate: You're a kind person who contributes to a warm working environment.

Location

  • This is a remote or in-person optional position. We have an office in New York City and a number of team members who work in-person regularly.
  • Our teams work on mostly East Coast hours.

What We Offer

  • Salary range: $140,000 – $190,000 annually, commensurate with experience
  • We offer medical, dental, vision, 401k match, 20 weeks paid parental leave, fertility and family-building support through Maven Clinic, and unlimited PTO.

Candidates must be authorized to work lawfully in the United States.

*Full coverage applies to specific health plans. Different plans may require some level of employee contribution.

title: SVP, Head of Communications -Tribeca Enterprises
description:
SVP Head of Communications, Tribeca Enterprises

Position Summary

Tribeca is seeking an accomplished communications leader to serve as SVP, Head of Communications, leading the organization's corporate and executive communications, media relations, reputation, internal communications and external positioning.
Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, this leader will serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO and senior leadership, helping define and communicate a clear and compelling Tribeca narrative across media, industry, cultural and business audiences.
The SVP, Head of Communications will lead Tribeca's communications and publicity strategy across the Tribeca Festival and year-round initiatives, strengthening the organization's visibility and reputation while ensuring a consistent and relevant voice with both external and internal audiences.

Key Responsibilities

Communications Strategy and Enterprise Narrative

  • Develop and lead Tribeca's year-round communications strategy, aligned with the organization's mission, business priorities and cultural impact.
  • Develop and lead communications and publicity strategies for Tribeca's year-round programs and initiatives, ensuring they are aligned with the organization's broader narrative, priorities and communications calendar.
  • Shape a clear enterprise narrative that communicates Tribeca's work, relevance and impact to external and internal audiences.
  • Translate organizational priorities and developments into clear, compelling communications strategies and messaging.
  • Ensure consistency of corporate messaging across businesses, programs and external stakeholders.
  • Own Tribeca's corporate brand story and positioning, including corporate brand marketing initiatives, in close coordination with Marketing.
  • Develop compelling corporate narratives, impact stories and case studies that demonstrate Tribeca's relevance and value across its businesses, programs and initiatives.
  • Work across the organization to ensure key business and program priorities are appropriately represented within Tribeca's broader narrative and communications strategy.

Tribeca Festival Communications and Publicity

  • Own and lead the communications, publicity and earned media strategy for the Tribeca Festival, from major announcements and advance positioning through on-site execution and post-Festival coverage.
  • Develop and oversee an integrated Festival publicity plan that elevates Tribeca's programming, creators, talent, cultural impact and key organizational moments.
  • Recruit, lead and manage the seasonal press and publicity team, establishing clear roles, priorities, workflows and standards for execution.
  • Oversee Festival press operations and high-profile media events, including red carpets, press lines, premieres, screenings, press conferences, media interviews, credentialing and on-site press activities.
  • Coordinate closely with Programming, Marketing, Live Events, Artist Relations, Production and other teams to identify strong stories, prepare talent and executives and deliver cohesive communications across Festival touchpoints.
  • Manage external publicity agencies and partners supporting the Festival, as appropriate.

Thought Leadership

  • Develop executive messaging and thought leadership strategies for senior leadership.
  • Identify and manage strategic opportunities across media, speaking engagements, industry events, awards, podcasts and other editorial platforms.
  • Prepare executives for high-profile external engagements through messaging, briefing materials, speech support, media preparation and strategic counsel.
  • Identify opportunities for Tribeca leadership to contribute meaningfully to relevant conversations across entertainment, storytelling, culture, creativity, business and innovation.

Media Relations and Reputation

  • Lead proactive and reactive media relations across business, entertainment, cultural and industry media.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors and relevant industry contacts.
  • Strengthen and protect Tribeca's reputation through thoughtful positioning, sound judgment and consistent messaging.
  • Lead communications strategy for organizational announcements, leadership news, business developments and other significant external matters.
  • Develop messaging, talking points, briefing materials, statements and other communications for priority initiatives.
  • Lead communications planning and preparedness for sensitive or rapidly developing issues.

Internal Communications

  • Develop and lead an internal communications approach that keeps employees informed, connected and aligned with Tribeca's priorities and culture.
  • Plan and execute company Town Halls in partnership with the CEO, Human Resources and senior leaders, including agenda development, executive messaging, presentation materials and event coordination.
  • Lead communications for key organizational announcements, leadership updates, business developments and other matters affecting employees.
  • Establish effective internal communications channels, processes and calendars that support clear, timely and consistent information sharing across the organization.
  • Advise leaders on employee-facing communications and help translate complex or sensitive information into clear, thoughtful messaging.

Measurement and Effectiveness

  • Establish clear objectives and measures of success for Communications initiatives.
  • Evaluate media performance, executive visibility and other relevant communications indicators to assess effectiveness and inform priorities.
  • Provide senior leadership with meaningful reporting and insights on communications performance and opportunities.

Team and Organizational Leadership

  • Lead, develop and organize the year-round Communications team and seasonal Festival press and publicity resources, with clear priorities and accountability.
  • Manage communications agencies, consultants and other external partners as appropriate.
  • Establish effective planning processes, calendars and tools that improve coordination across the function and organization.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships and effective ways of working across Tribeca.
  • Foster a culture of strong judgment, creativity, responsiveness, collaboration and accountability.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Significant senior-level communications leadership experience, including corporate communications, executive communications, media relations, reputation management and major event or Festival publicity.
  • Demonstrated experience advising CEOs and senior executives on messaging, visibility, media strategy and reputation.
  • Strong track record developing communications strategies and organizational narratives for multiple audiences.
  • Experience leading publicity and press operations for complex, high-profile events, including oversight of seasonal teams, agencies, talent-facing media activity and on-site execution.
  • Deep understanding of the business, entertainment, media and cultural landscape, with relevant media and industry relationships.
  • Experience developing executive thought leadership and identifying high-value media, speaking and editorial opportunities.
  • Experience developing and executing internal communications, including Town Halls and significant organizational announcements.
  • Exceptional writing, editorial judgment, presentation and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate sensitive and high-profile communications matters with sound judgment and discretion.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop year-round and seasonal teams and manage agencies and external partners.
  • Strong strategic instincts combined with the ability and willingness to move from strategy to execution.
  • Experience within media, entertainment, culture, live experiences, festivals or a similarly dynamic organization strongly preferred.

Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will be a strategic, credible and highly collaborative communications leader with excellent judgment and an instinct for what makes a story relevant. They will be equally comfortable advising the CEO, shaping an enterprise narrative, leading Festival publicity, managing a high-profile media matter and working across teams to identify and tell compelling Tribeca stories.
Above all, this leader will understand how strong communications, disciplined execution, executive visibility and a clear organizational narrative can strengthen Tribeca's reputation, connect its employees and reinforce its place in culture.

The annual base salary range for this position is $225,000–$300,000. The final salary will reflect the selected candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications and expertise, as well as internal equity.

title: ACT Team Supervisor
description:
COMPASSIONATE ● RESOURCEFUL ● COLLABORATIVE ● ORGANIZED ● CLIENT-CENTRED

OVERVIEW

A growing, community-based organization that provides shelter and outreach support for homeless youth in Peel Region. They are a leading organization recognized in the community for its commitment to providing youth in need with a safe environment and access to services to help them achieve independence and foster growth.

Are you passionate about supporting youth homelessness and mental health?

The Pod Group is partnering with this organization to place a resourceful, compassionate, and hands-on individual to fulfill the role of a ACT Team Supervisor.

WHY YOUR ROLE MATTERS 🔍

The ACT Team Supervisor provides oversight and supervision for youth case management staff within an Assertive Community Treatment (ACT) model. This role will ensure high-quality, evidence-informed service delivery aligned with Housing First for Youth principles and the strategic priorities of the organization.

The ACT Team Supervisor supports assigned team members in delivering coordinated, youth-centered care to young people ages 16-24 who are experiencing complex mental health, substance use, and housing challenges, with a focus on addressing barriers to housing. The role combines staff supervision, clinical consultation, and a small, focused caseload of high-acuity clients to maintain direct practice and model best practices.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT 🎯

Leadership & Supervision

  • Provide day-to-day supervision, coaching, and performance management to case management staff.
  • Facilitates regular staff meetings to review program deliverables for quality and continuous improvement.
  • Participate and support the recruitment process for front-line roles such as Intensive Case Managers and specialized staff.
  • Support staff in delivering high-quality, youth-centered case management services.
  • Help coordinate team case consultations and maintain daily oversight of assigned care load for the team.
  • Ensure care loads are equitably distributed on the team.
  • Promote staff development through training, mentorship, and ongoing feedback.
  • Ensure adherence to organizational policies and strategic priorities, ACT model fidelity, and HF4Y principles.

Supervisory Oversight & Practice Excellence

  • In coordination with the Manager of Youth Services, provide consultation on complex cases (mental health, substance use, housing instability).
  • Review and support development of assessments and individualized care plans.
  • Ensure service delivery reflects Housing First for Youth trauma-informed, harm reduction, and recovery-oriented practices.
  • Support staff in crisis response, risk assessment, and de-escalation.
  • Monitor service quality through team case reviews, documentation audits, and outcome tracking.

Integrated Systems Coordination

  • Collaborate with the larger Youth Services Department, including Prevention and specialized services, to ensure integrated care planning and delivery.
  • Support care path planning and service coordination across health, housing, justice, and community sectors.
  • Participate in and help guide case conferences to ensure alignment and minimize service gaps.
  • Serve as a key liaison with internal and external partners, advocating for youth assigned to the care team.

Program Operations & Quality Assurance

  • Oversee team caseloads and support effective workload management and prioritization.
  • Ensure timely, accurate documentation and reporting in line with requirements.
  • Contribute to program evaluation, quality improvement, and reporting.
  • Support implementation of best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Promote a healthy and safe environment, while maintaining process, procedure and policies.
  • Provides on-call support, which includes problem solving, consultation, guidance and feedback to front-line employees through crisis management and challenging events.

Direct Service

Manage and support high-acuity or complex youth to:

  • Maintain practice expertise and credibility.
  • Model best practices and engagement strategies for staff.
  • Provide direct intervention in particularly complex or high-risk cases.
  • Deliver assessment, care planning, and case management support consistent with HF4Y and ACT principles.
  • Support staff and youth during crisis situations, housing instability, and transitions.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING 🎓

We value diverse professional and lived experiences, including backgrounds in mental health, addiction, and homelessness.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. Master’s and/or Certification in Mental Health and Addictions is strongly preferred.
  • Registration with a professional regulatory body (e.g., RSW, RCC, Canadian Certified Counsellor, OACYC, or equivalent) is considered an asset.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of progressive experience in mental health, substance use, and/or homelessness services.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of supervisory or leadership experience.
  • Knowledge of housing first for youth, trauma-informed care, and harm reduction practices.
  • A leader with excellent communication, presentation, organization and interpersonal skills with a passion for supporting the most vulnerable and marginalized youth in our community.
  • Knowledge of resources and supports for youth and exposure to Region of Peel resources.
  • Experience working with youth and/or HF4Y or ACT models strongly preferred.
  • Experience with program development, evaluation, and quality improvement.
  • Flexibility to work in a 24-hour, 7 days a week operation, while supporting an on-call rotation.
  • Valid CPI/UMAB and First Aid/CPR certifications.
  • Valid Ontario Driver’s License, clean driver’s abstract, access to a personal vehicle and $2,000,000 (minimum) liability car insurance coverage.
  • Satisfactory Vulnerable Sector Police Check that meets the standards of the organization.
  • Must be flexible to work at Brampton and/or Mississauga location.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Strong understanding of HF4Y principles, ACT model, and community-based systems of care.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of mental health, substance use, DSM diagnostics, and psychopharmacology.
  • Experience in supervision, coaching, and team leadership. Experience in a unionized environment preferred.
  • Expertise in trauma-informed, harm reduction, and recovery-oriented practice.
  • Strong crisis intervention and de-escalation competencies.
  • Ability to support staff working with high-acuity and complex cases.
  • Knowledge of oppression, marginalization, and anti-oppressive practice.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Strong organizational and decision-making abilities.
  • Ability to build and sustain collaborative partnerships.
  • Proficiency in documentation, reporting, and data-informed decision-making.

Core Values of Role:

  • Youth-centered and strengths-based approach.
  • Respect for self-determination and choice.
  • Commitment to equity, inclusion, and anti-oppressive practice.
  • Belief in growth, recovery, and meaningful change for young people.
  • Supportive, accountable, and practice-informed leadership.

OUR COMMITMENT TO EDIB

The success of an organization stems from a team that is aligned with its mission and vision, where decisions are made in the best interests of the clients they serve and the marginalized and vulnerable populations across our communities. Through this effort, all team members embrace their roles in the organization with respect and dignity for all stakeholders. Through these partnerships, everyone is focused on ensuring a commitment and responsibility toward anti-racism, anti-oppression, equity, diversity, inclusivity, and belonging.

OUR PARTNERSHIP - THE POD GROUP

The Pod Group (PG) connects candidates with amazing career opportunities in Ontario! We collaborate extensively with not-for-profit and community-based organizations, including health, social services, developmental, housing, mental health, and community health care.

We promote a unique candidate experience that integrates equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging in our engagement with candidates. Our recruitment strategy focuses on learning more about your career goals and aligning your passion with mission-driven work.

We thank you for your interest in applying!

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Automation
description:
About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

Coalition is building an AI Automation team to eliminate manual work and improve how teams across the company operate. As a Senior Software Engineer, AI Automation, you will lead the design and delivery of reliable, production-grade AI agents and workflows that solve meaningful business problems.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for an AI-native engineer who can move from ambiguous business problems to durable technical solutions. You will work closely with internal operators, product and data partners, and engineering teams to understand complex processes, develop reusable agent capabilities, and establish the technical patterns that allow AI automation to scale safely across Coalition.

You will balance rapid experimentation with strong engineering judgment. You will define system architecture, establish evaluation and reliability practices, and ensure that production agents operate with the appropriate controls for permissions, auditability, human review, and rollback.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design and delivery of AI agents, reusable skills, and automation workflows used by Coalition’s internal teams.
  • Translate complex, ambiguous business processes, judgment calls, and edge cases into reliable, maintainable software.
  • Design and evolve integrations between agents and systems of record using MCP and comparable tool-integration frameworks.
  • Define architecture, interfaces, data contracts, and operational standards for production AI systems.
  • Establish evaluation strategies, quality baselines, and release criteria; use results to make sound deployment and iteration decisions.
  • Build systems with robust controls for permissions, observability, auditability, human-in-the-loop review, failure containment, and rollback.
  • Partner with data engineering and business stakeholders to ensure automations use trustworthy data and have sustainable ownership.
  • Drive technical decisions across multiple workflows, identify reusable patterns, and raise the engineering bar for the team.
  • Mentor engineers and technical partners through design reviews, implementation guidance, and practical AI engineering standards.
  • Document systems, decisions, and operating practices so that teams can safely maintain and extend what you build.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including substantial recent experience building and shipping LLM-backed applications used by real users.
  • Demonstrated experience taking AI agents or multi-step automation workflows from prototype through reliable production operation.
  • Strong Python engineering skills and practical SQL expertise, including the ability to work directly with production data models.
  • Deep experience with prompting, tool use, agentic loops, structured outputs, multi-step workflows, error handling, and production deployment.
  • Experience designing and operating systems that integrate with business-critical systems of record.
  • Strong judgment around evaluation methodology, reliability, safety controls, and the tradeoffs required to deploy AI systems responsibly.
  • Solid production engineering fundamentals across Git, CI/CD, containers, deployment, monitoring, testing, permissions, and rollback.
  • Ability to lead technical work in ambiguous environments, influence stakeholders, and turn incomplete requirements into practical, high-quality solutions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with both technical and non-technical partners.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building or maintaining MCP servers, agent platforms, or reusable tool/skill frameworks.
  • Experience designing evaluation harnesses, test datasets, and monitoring for LLM-backed systems.
  • Background in internal tools, solutions engineering, professional services, startup environments, or founding teams.
  • Familiarity with systems such as Linear, Jira, Zendesk, Salesforce, or Snowflake.
  • Experience in insurance, fintech, cybersecurity, or another regulated environment where correctness, traceability, and controls have meaningful business impact.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or acting as a technical lead for complex cross-functional initiatives.

Compensation

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $130,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $195,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

Perks

  • 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with competitive employer match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Up to 14 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
  • Annual home office stipend and WeWork access
  • Mental & physical health wellness programs like One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more!
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Why Coalition?

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

Visit our Newsroom >

Privacy Notice

Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled.

title: IT Manager
description:
Company Overview

Since 1988, Rubenstein Law has been a trusted advocate for personal injury victims, growing into a nationally recognized firm with more than 60 attorneys and 400 professionals. Known for securing billions of dollars for clients, the firm handles a wide range of cases, including auto accidents, catastrophic injuries, medical malpractice, and mass tort litigation. Rubenstein Law is committed to delivering exceptional client care while continuing to expand nationwide.

Job Summary

The Manager, Help Desk & End User Services is responsible for leading day-to-day IT support and improving the employee technology experience across Rubenstein Law. This role manages the Help Desk team, owns ticket operations and escalations, coordinates employee onboarding and offboarding, and ensures users receive timely, consistent, and professional support.
This is a hands-on management position. The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with broad technical experience supporting Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Citrix/VDI, printers and peripherals, mobile devices, remote access, office connectivity, and business applications. The Manager will personally assist with complex issues when needed and will work closely with internal technical teams and third-party support providers.
This position reports to the Director, Infrastructure & Enterprise Applications. It is an in-office position at Rubenstein Law’s Miami/Dadeland office.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead, coach, schedule, and develop Help Desk and support personnel.
  • Own daily ticket queues, workload distribution, staffing coverage, escalations, and service-level performance.
  • Establish standards for ticket documentation, prioritization, user communication, escalation, resolution, and closure.
  • Monitor ticket volume, first-response time, resolution time, first-contact resolution, backlog, aging, reopened tickets, recurring incidents, and customer satisfaction.
  • Personally handle or coordinate complex technical escalations and high-impact user issues.
  • Coordinate employee onboarding, transfers, and offboarding with Human Resources and department leaders.
  • Ensure new employees receive configured accounts, devices, applications, permissions, and equipment on time.
  • Manage device assignment, recovery, replacement, inventory, warranty, refresh, and secure retirement activities.
  • Provide technical leadership for Windows desktops and laptops, docking stations, monitors, printers, scanners, mobile devices, conference-room technology, and related peripherals.
  • Support Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Office applications.
  • Troubleshoot Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory access, MFA, password, authentication, and user-profile issues.
  • Support Citrix/VDI sessions, published applications, profiles, printing, peripherals, and performance issues.
  • Troubleshoot Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, network connectivity, and remote-access issues from the end-user perspective.
  • Coordinate advanced Microsoft 365, endpoint, identity, Citrix, infrastructure, and network issues with internal technical resources and approved vendors, including Xtium.
  • Recognize and escalate potential P1 and P2 incidents and support the firm’s Major Incident Management process.
  • Maintain clear user communications, accurate ticket records, and effective handoffs during outages and escalations.
  • Create and maintain Help Desk procedures, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, user instructions, and third-party escalation paths.
  • Identify recurring issues and work with Infrastructure & Enterprise Applications on permanent solutions.
  • Promote self-service and automation for routine support requests.
  • Follow and reinforce the firm’s cybersecurity, privacy, identity-verification, and access-management requirements.
  • Escalate suspected phishing, malware, account compromise, data exposure, or other security incidents immediately.
  • Manage operational escalations with desktop, hardware, printer, telecom, cloud, and support vendors.
  • Assist with endpoint forecasting, lifecycle planning, licensing, support contracts, and budget requirements.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Five or more years of progressive experience in IT support, desktop engineering, systems administration, endpoint administration, or end-user technology.
  • Two or more years leading a Help Desk, Service Desk, or technical support team.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Windows desktop environments, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and MFA.
  • Strong working knowledge of Citrix or a comparable virtual desktop environment.
  • Practical experience supporting endpoint hardware, peripherals, printers, mobile devices, remote users, and multiple office locations.
  • Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPN, and common network troubleshooting methods.
  • Experience with an IT service-management platform such as Freshdesk, Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or a comparable system.
  • Experience managing third-party support escalations and working with managed service providers is strongly preferred.
  • Strong troubleshooting, prioritization, documentation, communication, and customer-service skills.
  • Ability to lead calmly during outages, competing escalations, and high-pressure support situations.
  • Ability to work onsite a minimum of three days per week at the Miami/Dadeland office.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Intune, endpoint-management, device-compliance, or application-deployment experience.
  • Citrix administration or advanced Citrix support experience.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or equivalent practical experience.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation certification or demonstrated IT service-management experience.
  • Experience supporting Salesforce or Litify, Genesys Cloud, contact-center users, or legal-industry applications.
  • Experience in a law firm, healthcare, financial services, or another professional-services environment handling sensitive information.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 8 paid holidays a year
  • Additional birthday holiday
  • Comprehensive benefits package including multiple medical plan options, dental, vision, disability, supplemental coverage, and company-paid life insurance
  • Bereavement leave to support employees and their families during difficult times
  • Hospital leave benefits for qualifying medical situations
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Bonus opportunities
  • Commitment to employee wellness and long-term success
