title: Freelance -  Senior Data Engineer (LATAM based)
description:
Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact, guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

We’re hiring a Freelance Data Engineer to build the structured core of a governed data foundation on Databricks, used by AI agents, applications, and business teams. You own everything that has to be exact: business entities reconciled across systems that use different identifiers, facts with their source and validity period, business definitions turned into certified tables, access control, and the APIs and MCP tools that serve this data with the caller’s permissions.

Conflicting definitions and identifiers are business problems as much as joins. The right person has spent years on Databricks making data correct and consistent, has enforced access control in production, and knows where platform controls stop and application-level enforcement has to start. You work autonomously with business stakeholders and ask the uncomfortable questions about definitions and permissions early.

You’ll work in a small team (solution architect, AI engineer, full-stack engineer, data quality lead, product and project managers) alongside the client’s data platform team. You follow their conventions and hand over what you build. The AI engineer owns the parts that need a model: knowledge from documents, retrieval, agent behavior, and evals. You give them the trusted data those parts depend on. AI tools speed up your modeling, SQL, testing, and documentation every day, and you know exactly when to trust the output and when not to.

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of professional data engineering, building production-grade pipelines and data models
  • 3+ years hands-on with Databricks in production, including Unity Catalog
  • Expert SQL and Python: writes, debugs, optimizes, and refactors pipelines unaided. Spark/PySpark a plus
  • Strong data modeling, including history-aware techniques (SCD Type 2, effective dating, temporal validity), with provenance and lineage designed in from the start
  • Data quality and testing discipline: tests and expectations in pipelines (dbt tests, Great Expectations, or similar) and CI/CD for data
  • Reconciling data across systems: entity resolution or master data
  • Incremental and change-driven processing (CDC, streaming, or incremental frameworks) against freshness targets
  • Practical data governance: has implemented access control in production (row-level security, column masking, or role/attribute-based access) and knows where platform-level controls stop and application-level enforcement has to start
  • Has built APIs or services that serve data
  • Senior judgment: works autonomously, challenges unclear definitions, prioritizes by risk, owns outcomes without micromanagement
  • Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or similar), with the judgment to know when to trust the output
  • C1 English; comfortable working fully remote and directly with a client team

Preferrable:

  • Exposing data to applications through APIs or MCPs
  • Multi-tenant data isolation for customer-facing products, with security and negative testing
  • Finance or CRM data (NetSuite, Salesforce)
  • Consolidating data across acquired companies or business units
  • Ingesting and governing unstructured content (documents, wikis, contracts) alongside structured data
  • Turning business definitions into a shared semantic or metrics layer with business or finance stakeholders
  • FinOps / cost attribution on data platforms

Perks

💵 Monthly USD Service Fee
🌴 20 business days of paid Agreed Time Off—Annual + 6 Local Holidays
🐣Caregiver Time Off
💻A dynamic remote work culture. You can work from anywhere!
🚀An entrepreneurial environment.

About us
In 2010, our founders dreamed up a company that could positively impact the world. Since then, we've been in permanent evolution: from business consulting to innovation and design, and now to building amazing digital products powered by AI. We scaled globally, launched AI Labs and Reshape Studios, and claimed our space as an AI consulting firm — helping organizations move from pilots to production through accountable AI. Today, we're expanding our impact across industries, driving real AI adoption through accountability, governance, and value at scale. Dreamers first, builders always.

title: Recovery Liaison
description:
Onsite position in Indianapolis, IN

THIS IS A TEMPORARY POSITION

Position Summary:
Tidal Basin is the nation’s premier provider of integrated preparedness, emergency response management, and disaster recovery consulting services. We are growing our team and have an opportunity for a Recovery Liaison. The Recovery Liaison provides onsite disaster recovery expertise to government clients impacted by disaster events. This position works directly with state agencies, local jurisdictions, community stakeholders, and other recovery partners to support the coordination, implementation, and documentation of disaster recovery activities.
The Recovery Liaison serves as a key point of coordination between the client, stakeholders, and project team and assists with identifying recovery needs, tracking projects and issues, gathering and validating documentation, and supporting compliance with applicable federal and state disaster recovery requirements. The position requires strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic post-disaster environment. Additionally, this position requires an emphasis on client engagement and relationship building, especially the ability to work independently with senior State and Federal partners.
Job Duties and Responsibilities include:
  • Provide onsite disaster recovery support to Tidal Basin staff, the client and designated stakeholders following the disaster event.
  • Serve as a liaison between the client, local jurisdictions, state agencies, federal partners, contractors, consultants, and other stakeholders involved in recovery activities and may work in the Joint Field Office (JFO).
  • Support the development and implementation of recovery strategies, priorities, and action plans for the Project Management Office (PMO).
  • Participate in meetings with state agencies, local governments, stakeholders, and recovery partners.
  • Gather, organize review and maintain documentation necessary to support disaster recovery programs and projects.
  • Track commitments, deliverables, deadlines, and follow-up actions resulting from client and stakeholder meetings.
  • Author summaries, status reports, and briefing materials, meeting documentation, and other project-related communications.
  • Provide responsive, professional customer service to the client and stakeholders throughout the recovery process.
  • Perform other disaster recovery and project support duties as assigned.
  • Ensure compliance with all health and safety protocols.
  • Complete all required training courses.

Skills and Competencies:
  • Knowledge of disaster recovery, emergency management, grants management, infrastructure recovery, or related government programs, preferred.
  • Understanding of federal disaster assistance programs, particularly FEMA disaster recovery programs, preferred.
  • Strong client service and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Strong computer skills, including using Microsoft Office Suite applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Must possess a high level of attention to detail and be organized with the ability to prioritize multiple projects and meet deadlines.
  • Maintain a personal and professional high state of readiness and professional training.
  • Ability to recognize emerging needs and offer informed guidance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to remain calm in stressful situations.
  • Current certifications in Incident Command System (ICS) and completion of applicable FEMA Independent Study courses, preferred.
  • Possess a valid state-issued driver’s license and a satisfactory driving record.
  • The ability to quickly deploy to assigned client location.
Work Environment and Physical Requirements:
  • This is an onsite, project-specific position supporting governmental entities and disaster-impacted stakeholders.
  • Regular travel within the disaster-impacted area may be required to attend meetings, conduct site visits, or support stakeholder activities.
  • Must be able to work in an environment where priorities and assignments may change based on evolving recovery needs.
  • May occasionally be required to work extended hours, evenings, or weekends based on project requirements.
  • Field activities may involve exposure to disaster-impacted areas, construction environments, uneven terrain, and varying weather conditions.
  • Must comply with all client and company health, safety, security, and site-access requirements.
  • Sitting or standing for hours at a time.
  • Capability to work in adverse weather conditions and challenging environments.
Additional Requirements:
  • Ability to successfully complete any client-required background screening or credentialing requirements.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to client and stakeholder locations, as required.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive client and disaster recovery information.
  • Must demonstrate professionalism and sound judgement when representing the project team in interactions with government officials, stakeholders, and members of disaster-impacted communities.
Education and Experience:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Emergency Management, Public Administration, Business Administration, Planning, Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, or a related field; relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of degree requirements.
  • Ten (10) or more years of relevant experience in disaster recovery, emergency management, grants management, government programs, infrastructure, project management, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting recovery following floods, hurricanes, severe storms, or other federally declared disasters.
  • Experience working directly with clients, government agencies, community stakeholders, or other external partners.

title: Application Security Engineer  II (Contract - 5 months )
description:
Founded in 2012, Bugcrowd is the preemptive security platform that unifies exposure discovery and assessment, offensive testing, and intelligence shaped by AI and human insight to help organizations avoid, discover, and validate real-world risk. Bugcrowd helps security teams move faster by identifying the exposures that matter most so they can act first and stay ahead of attackers. By combining the power of humans and AI, teams can preempt attack paths and prevent breaches. Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others. Visit .

Job Summary

At Bugcrowd, we handle application security assessment at an epic scale. As an Application Security Engineer (ASE) you will curate and manage the incoming security vulnerability submissions to some of the world’s biggest companies’ bug bounty programs. Here are just a few of the reasons why we are the best:

  • A tenure at Bugcrowd often means you have worked on not only one company’s security program but potentially on hundreds.
  • As an ASE at Bugcrowd you will be exposed to the Internet’s best security researchers and their cutting-edge security testing methodologies. Our ASEs quickly become technically fluent in obscure/complex XSS, SQLi, XXE, IDOR, SSTI, SSRF, and many other vulnerability types. There is no other organization that offers the learning opportunity that Bugcrowd does.
  • You will be exposed to things outside of your comfort zone. We routinely run security programs for cars, IoT devices, embedded systems, mobile applications, and more!
  • We have an awesome team and tons of perks. We’ve even been selected as one of “The 10 Coolest Security Startups Of 2016” by crn.com.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

An ASE is responsible for the ongoing triage and validation services of Bugcrowd managed programs. Under the direction of the Director of Technical Operations, you will take incoming submission data and curate it for validity, accuracy, and severity as well as communicate directly with Bugcrowd’s clients or researchers when additional information is required. ASEs also handle Incident Response – escalating and communicating about the highest severity bugs to clients. ASEs need to have strong knowledge of OWASP Top Ten type vulnerabilities. They also usually require a strong skill set in one scripting/development language, often to assist with the design or development of tooling for improving the triage/validation process. The ASE position is perfect for security professionals looking to take their skills to the next level.

Education, Experience, Skills, & Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree or previous security consulting experience
  • Published and demonstrated passion for security assessment research
  • High proficiency with Burp Suite (or any other interception proxy) and a working level of experience with other industry standard tools (nmap, sqlmap, anything included in Kali Linux)
  • Ability to execute on individual projects but still contribute to the team
  • Ability to complete tasks on time
  • Strong organization, influencing, and communication skills

Working Conditions

The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

title: Junior Software Developer
description:
Junior Software Developer (Android & TypeScript)

Reports To: Director of Engineering

Location: Montreal, QC (Hybrid: work remotely or from the office, your choice!)

About us

Broadsign is a growing software company with a mission to make buying, selling, and delivering out-of-home media easier than ever. Our software is operated by some of the most successful out-of-home businesses and powers impactful, compelling campaigns seen across the world.

Come join us as a Cross-Platform Software Developer (Android & TypeScript) in Montreal.

About the role

As a Software Developer in Android and TypeScript applications, you will play a key role in building scalable applications that power our global OOH network. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and high-performance technical solutions, ensuring our codebase remains maintainable and robust as we continue to innovate.

What to expect

  • Feature Development & Enhancement: In this role, you will develop and maintain a Media Player Application (Android and TypeScript). This is not your typical application, as it is not one for human users but is designed to run with minimal human interaction and is built for robustness and high availability.
  • You will work on a fairly new project with an evolving infrastructure stack using Kotlin, TypeScript, and WebView/Chromium. You will be part of our DevOps culture, focusing on writing clean, reusable, and secure code that supports a diverse range of devices. Furthermore, we dedicate quarterly time to Innovation Days, allowing you to explore and develop new ideas.
  • Collaboration & Agile Practices: You will join an Agile team including a Product Manager, a QA analyst, and a group of driven developers. Success is built on collaboration, which is why you will actively participate in code reviews, offering constructive feedback to uphold high standards of code quality. You will contribute to technical design discussions and help shape the future architecture of our applications.
  • Quality & Performance Optimization: Quality is at the core of what we do. You will therefore identify, debug, and fix defects reported internally or by customers and implement unit and integration tests using JUnit and Jest to ensure complete feature coverage. Because our software runs in diverse environments, you will optimize applications for best performance and stability on low-spec hardware.

What you need to perform in this job

  • Experience: 1-3 years of professional software development experience.
  • Technical Proficiency: Knowledge of Android development or TypeScript
  • Tools: Experience with Git version control and CI/CD practices.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

What we bring to the table

  • Flexible work environment—work from home or the office
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Complete company insurance plan (health, dental, vision, travel) effective from day one (100% employer-paid).
  • Health Spending: $500 annual Health Care Savings Account (HCSA) for additional health-related expenses.

  • Paid Time Off: Minimum 3 weeks vacation, 5 floater days, 5 sick/personal days, and 2 volunteer days.
  • Family Support: Parental leave salary supplement (including up to 23 weeks top-up for maternity leave).
  • Financial Perks: Transportation reimbursement for travel to a Broadsign office.
  • Growth: Training & development opportunities with a yearly budget to support professional growth, 3 paid training days/year

At Broadsign, we value the varied social identities that make up our community. We recognize talent comes in different forms and encourage applications that reflect different backgrounds and experiences. Our promise is to be an inclusive employer and partner, open to learning, with thoughtful strategies and practices that amplify the different voices of our industry.

title: VP, Product
description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Position Overview

The Vice President, Product helps raise the quality, speed, and ambition of product development across the Cordance portfolio. This is not a traditional single-company VP of Product role. The VP partners with BU Presidents, Product leaders, and Engineering teams to strengthen product strategy, improve the quality of major product bets, and help our businesses build products that drive growth, retention, and long-term value. The mandate spans executive advisory work on major product decisions, raising product capability and craft across the portfolio, and helping teams use AI to rethink both what they build and how they build it.

Success in this role means our businesses make better product choices, validate ideas earlier, build faster, and put more of their product and engineering capacity behind the opportunities most likely to improve customer value and business performance. It also means our Presidents and Product leaders become stronger product thinkers, and our best product practices spread more quickly across the portfolio.

title: Lead Data Scientist, Demand
description:
Farmer’s Fridge makes fruits and vegetables accessible and approachable for everyone. We offer a variety of fresh, healthy, ready-to-eat meals and snacks through our fresh food vending machines, wholesale partners, and our office pantry solution — providing chef-curated meals to customers within seconds. Today, we operate a network of Fridges and partner with clients nationwide in high-foot-traffic areas, such as airports, hospitals, universities, and large office buildings — where there is limited accessibility to fresh, healthy, grab-n-go options.

We serve healthy, handcrafted meals and snacks from our growing network of 2,000+ Smart Fridges. These software-enabled vending machines are changing the way people think about grab-and-go food. We're building something that's never been done before, and our data tells a story most data scientists never get to work with.

We care deeply about what we’re creating and aspire to make sure our customers feel that through every touchpoint. This shows up in many ways across the business. We are committed to prioritizing food safety, we are passionate about product quality, we value our employees, we champion the best idea no matter where it comes from, and we’re committed to making an overall positive impact as we scale.

About this Role: Every day we decide how much fresh food to send to each fridge and retail store. Send too little and we lose sales and customers. Send too much and food expires. Our demand planning models sit at the center of that call.

The Lead Data Scientist, Demand owns those models. You'll be our first full-time data scientist dedicated to demand planning. We have fridge and retail forecasting models in production today. Your job is to maintain them, make them better, and rebuild them where a better approach pays off. As the core models mature, you'll expand into company-level volume and revenue forecasting.

You'll work closely with our Lead Decision Scientist. You own the predictive layer: what will sell, where, and when. They own the prescriptive layer that turns your forecasts into stocking, allocation, and routing decisions. You'll also partner with Data Engineering to run your models in production, and with the demand planning team who use your forecasts every day.

Your day-to-day partner is our Manager, Demand Planning. Channel Strategy and Demand Planning set the business rules and objectives your models run on: availability targets, the trade-off between lost sales and waste, and the operating constraints planners live with. Your job is to turn that logic into models that follow it, and to tell us when the data says a rule is wrong. You set the technical bar. The Channel team sets the commercial one.

What You’ll Do…

  • Own our fridge and retail demand forecasts end to end: data, features, model, validation, and production.
  • Build forecasts that maximize contribution margin dollars, not forecast accuracy for its own sake. Track the impact through sell-through, unsolds and stockouts against Channel's targets. Watch for forecasts that run consistently high or low by item and fridge, and give the optimization models a realistic range to achieve business goals.
  • Maintain and improve the models in production today. Rebuild them where a better approach clearly pays off.
  • Forecast at the item, location, and day level across 2,000+ fridges and retail partner stores, where demand is often low-volume and intermittent.
  • Model the hard parts of fresh food: stockouts that hide true demand, short shelf life, new fridges ramping up, new menu items, holidays, and promotions.
  • Produce probabilistic forecasts, not just point in time estimates, so our optimization models can weigh the cost of a lost sale against the cost of waste.
  • Partner with the Lead Decision Scientist on the forecast outputs the solver needs. Measure how forecast changes move stocking decisions and results.
  • Build backtesting and monitoring. Judge accuracy on business outcomes like sell-through, waste, and lost sales, not just statistical error.
  • Run a standing model scorecard, reviewed with Channel Strategy and Demand Planning on a set cadence. Every material model change ships with a measured before and after on sell-through, unsolds and stockouts, translated into contribution margin per fridge per week.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to run models in our production pipelines (Snowflake, dbt, Dagster) without manual babysitting.
  • Work with demand planning, supply chain, and operations. Explain what the model expects, why, and how much to trust it.
  • Measure the value of planner overrides. Fold the ones that consistently help into the model as explicit rules, and retire the ones that don't.
  • Expand into company-level volume and revenue forecasting as the core models mature.
  • Keep a living record of every business rule in the models: what it does, where it came from, who owns it, and when it last changed. When Channel changes a requirement, we should be able to find it, change it and see the effect in days.
  • Set the bar for how forecasting models get built, tested, documented, and shipped at FF.

Who You Are…

  • 4-8 years building and maintaining forecasting or predictive models in production.
  • Deep demand forecasting experience: time series, hierarchical, or ML-based methods (gradient boosting, state space, Bayesian, or similar).
  • Comfort with count data and intermittent demand (Poisson, negative binomial, or similar).
  • Experience correcting for censored demand from stockouts, or a strong grasp of why it matters.
  • Strong Python and SQL. Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud warehouse.
  • Rigor in backtesting and experiment design. You know how to prove a model change actually helped.
  • Track record of owning model work end to end, from problem framing through production and monitoring.
  • You can point to a model change you shipped and the business result it moved, in dollars.
  • Clear communicator. Able to explain forecast uncertainty and tradeoffs to planners and operators, and defend modeling choices to technical peers.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where you set direction, not just follow it.
  • Familiarity with using AI tools in your day-to-day workflow.
  • Based in Chicago or willing to relocate. This is an in-office role.

Nice to Have…

  • Forecasting experience with perishable goods, grocery, CPG, food service, or multi-location retail.
  • Exposure to how forecasts feed optimization models for inventory, allocation, or routing.
  • Causal inference experience (difference-in-differences, matched controls) for measuring pricing, promotion, or operational changes.

The base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $170,000. The base pay offered will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, training, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for company performance-based bonuses and equity.

We provide a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance (multiple plans available)
  • 401(k) with immediate employer match vesting
  • Paid time off (including vacation, sick leave, and holidays)
  • Paid sabbatical after 5 years of service
  • Employee discounts
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Benefits at Farmer's Fridge:

In This Together - We stay connected, whether in person or virtually. We encourage business transparency through monthly town hall meetings and weekly financial updates. We set out to make the best product on the market, and we believe we’ve done it. We value your input in the new menu creation process. From regular tasting panels, where employees provide new menu feedback.

Happier Workdays - Each day at work should fill you with joy. We're a fun and passionate group, and we don't take ourselves too seriously. Bring your unique self to work, dress comfortably, and always feel free to share your thoughts and opinions. We encourage curiosity; there's no hierarchy here when we're all swapping ideas.

Never run on empty - Daily Farmer's Fridge meal and office snacks are just some of the offerings to make sure you aren't distracted by a growling stomach. Recharge with our paid sabbatical program after five years of service.

Innovate & Elevate - We're all teachers and learners. You'll grow and help grow the company through cross-functional collaboration, open access to leadership, and regular business updates. You have a direct impact on the company’s bottom line. You can also impact your bottom line by participating in our 401(k) plan that includes a company match with immediate vesting.

title: Student Loan Counselor

description:
POSITION PURPOSE

The Student Loan Counselor provides free, individualized student loan counseling to Philadelphia residents, with a focus on low- and moderate-income borrowers. The counselor helps clients understand federal, private, and institutional education debt; evaluate repayment and relief options; resolve loan-related issues; and create practical action plans for managing their education debt. This full-time position is dedicated to student loan counseling.

Essential Functions:


Essential duties are outlined below. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Student Loan Counseling and Case Management
  • Conduct client intake and review federal, private, and institutional student loan information and supporting documents, including information from StudentAid.gov.
  • Assess loan balances, servicers and lenders, monthly payments, repayment status, delinquency or default, and potential eligibility for loan forgiveness or discharge.
  • Provide one-on-one counseling, prioritizing in-person or video appointments and using telephone appointments when neither option is available. Conduct in-person sessions in a sufficiently private setting.
  • Explain available repayment plans and develop individualized strategies and clear action steps to address immediate student loan concerns and ongoing education debt needs.
  • Assist borrowers with enrollment in appropriate repayment plans and applications for forgiveness, cancellation, discharge, or other applicable loan relief options.
  • Help borrowers address delinquency or default by reviewing available resolution options, including consolidation or loan rehabilitation when appropriate.
  • Assist borrowers in resolving issues with student loan servicers and lenders, including supporting complaint submissions and coordinating referrals to legal partners when appropriate.
  • Cover and document program-required topics for clients with federal student loans, including disability screening, annual income recertification, keeping contact information current, and changes in income or family size.
  • Follow up with clients to review progress on action plans, respond to challenges, and support student loan management outcomes.
  • Identify additional client needs and make appropriate referrals, including to Clarifi financial counseling, legal assistance, BenePhilly, and other community resources.
Document Impact
  • Maintain accurate, confidential client records, including intake and eligibility documents, loan information, counseling sessions, referrals, action steps, and case closure information in Clarifi-designated systems.
  • Document appointment formats, loan balances, monthly payments, borrower issues, actions taken, resolutions, and changes to loan obligations.
  • Track client outcomes for program reporting, including changes in repayment plans, resolution of delinquency or default, forgiveness or discharge activity, and client cost savings, as applicable.
  • Collaborate with the Service Delivery Manager to develop client narratives and success stories for program reporting, following applicable privacy and client consent requirements.
Outreach, Training, and Collaboration
  • Participate in outreach and awareness activities as needed to support the organization’s student loan counseling program and community referrals.
  • Complete required National Student Debt Counselors Network (NSDCN) and CLS training within 30 days of hire, unless otherwise specified; participate in continuing training, case discussions, and technical support.
  • Participate in required meetings of the NSDCN and Education Loan Awareness Alliance PHL (ELAA PHL), and collaborate with Clarifi staff and community partners to support coordinated borrower assistance.
General and Administrative
  • Work collaboratively across Clarifi to advance the student loan counseling program and support coordinated services.
  • Maintain regular attendance and prepare accurate, professional client communications, correspondence, and case documentation.
  • Protect confidential client information and follow Clarifi’s information security and case management protocols.
PROFESSIONAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

Education & Experience: College degree or a minimum of three years of relevant work experience required. Required NSDCN and CLS training is completed on the job, as described above.
  • Strong interpersonal and one-on-one counseling skills, with an empathetic, nonjudgmental, and culturally proficient approach.
  • Ability to explain complex financial information clearly and help borrowers consider options that align with their individual situations.
  • Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail in case management and reporting.
  • Comfort working with financial information, web-based systems, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Commitment to Clarifi’s mission, client confidentiality, ethical conduct, and responsive service to low-income and financially distressed clients.
  • Proficiency or fluency in additional languages, especially Spanish, is a plus.
QUALITIES & CHARACTERISTICS
  • Commitment to Mission: Passion for serving low-income populations and strong and demonstrated commitment to social justice, various forms of equity, and anti-poverty initiatives. Understanding of the root causes of poverty and systems and structures that perpetuate inequality. This role requires an individual with a passion for and commitment to social service, especially to low income and financially distressed individuals.
  • Personal qualities: Clarifi requires the highest ethical standards and integrity in service to our clients and partners. The ideal candidate will possess maturity, self-awareness, empathy, flexibility, cultural humility, and an exceptional capacity for team and community building.
  • Strong interpersonal and one-on-one coaching skills: Ability to form strong, trusting partnerships with clients and to provide financial coaching that is non-judgmental, empathetic, and culturally proficient.
  • Interest in personal finance and comfort with quantitative calculations: Strong personal finance competencies are preferred, but not required. , Intensive training and certification in personal finance will be provided. Interest in learning about, and building proficiency in, personal and consumer finance.
  • Commitment to innovation, excellence, and entrepreneurship: Energized to work in an entrepreneurial, growth-oriented nonprofit organization. Demonstrated commitment to testing and evaluating new ideas and to building a model organization. The ideal candidate will be a proactive team player with a willingness to pitch in to support larger goals. Detail-focused and strong commitment to client services and consumer protection.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills: Detail-oriented with the ability to complete work accurately and efficiently. Exceptional presentation, organizational, written and verbal communication skills. Ability to understand and develop processes to make workflows manageable and replicable. Excellent computer literacy, including web-based applications and proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

WORKING CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Travel Requirement: Position is based in Philadelphia. Travel will be required throughout Philadelphia to various program sites, partner meetings, workshops, events, and conferences. Candidate must be a licensed driver with full-time access to reliable, properly registered, and insured car and be able and willing to travel to locations within organization’s service area.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of position.

Work Environment: The environment for this position is standard office environment. In addition to the office responsibilities, there are off-site workshops, presentations, and community outreach events. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: Hygiene Assistant
description:
Company Overview
Action Against Hunger is an international humanitarian organization committed to ending world hunger. For almost 45 years, across countries, we have been working to fight undernutrition and support communities affected by crisis across the globe.

We carry out innovative, lifesaving programs in Health, Nutrition, Water, Sanitation and Hygiene, Mental Health and Psychosocial Support, Food Security and Livelihoods, and Social Protection.

Action Against Hunger began operations in Nigeria in 2010 in response to the high rate of chronic malnutrition in Northern Nigeria, focusing on integrated programming. Action Against Hunger currently implements multi-sectoral humanitarian and development interventions in Northeast and Northwest Nigeria, funded by AFD, EU/ECHO, French Government, GAC, SIDA, US Government, and GIZ.

Action Against Hunger Nigeria (ACF Nigeria) Ltd/Gte is currently recruiting a Hygiene Assistant based in Katsina. The successful candidate will support the implementation of hygiene promotion activities and the distribution of non-food items (NFIs) to affected populations.


Position Details

Reporting to: WASH Programme Manager

Proposed start date: November 2026

Work location: Katsina, Katsina State



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Mission 1: Assist in context assessment and developing materials for hygiene promotion.

  • Conduct initial rapid needs assessment for affected communities and Health facilities
  • Assist in conducting home visits and visits to the community (schools, Health facilities, etc.) to identify gaps in terms of hygiene, sanitation and use of water.
  • Assist in preparing training modules for the promotion of hygiene practices at the household and community levels.
  • Assist in developing training tools adapted to different audiences using different approaches; songs, role games, meetings, training courses.
  • Assist in identifying targeted partners within the communities: schools, hospitals, clinics, etc.
  • Conduct household census to determine beneficiary population.

Mission 2: Carry out emergency safe hygiene promotion and mobilize members of the beneficiary communities and health facilities
  • Organize emergency hygiene promotion awareness raising sessions.
  • Mobilize communities and health facilities to adopt safe hygiene practices as promoted by the project (latrine construction, hand washing facilities, environmental cleanliness)
  • Assist in conducting training sessions for the community workers and/or targeted populations.
  • Conduct focus group discussion for Women and Girls to identify a location for the construction of WASH facilities
  • Write a weekly activity report.
  • Propose possible improvements.

Mission 3: Assist in carrying out shelter, hygiene and NFI kits distribution.
  • Assist in the process of beneficiary’s selection to receive NFI assistance.
  • Assist in beneficiary registration.
  • Assist in distributing shelter, Hygiene and NFI kits to registered beneficiaries.

Additional Responsibilities
  • This job description is not intended to be all inclusive and the employee will also perform other related tasks as required and responsible for reporting and communication of progress and achievement of the specific assigned task
  • Maintenance of high technical standards
  • Conduct all duties in a professional manner following ACF Nigeria mission staff regulations, ACF mandate and charter including promotion of gender equality

Position Requirements:
  • Minimum of National Diploma in Public Health or Health related field.
  • Experience in hygiene promotion or community mobilization an advantage.
  • Motivated, open, creative, mature, responsible, flexible, and culturally sensitive
  • Willing and able to be based and travel regularly within remote areas, where services are limited.
  • Fluency in Hausa and English.
  • Commitment to Action Against Hunger Nigeria’s mission, values, and policy
  • Good knowledge of the intervention area/s and local economy

At Action Against Hunger, we foster a work culture that champions diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to creating an environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive

Application Deadline:
Tuesday, 27th October 2026 at 05:00 pm (Nigerian Time)

Important Notice:
Action Against Hunger does not charge any fee at any stage of the recruitment process – this includes application, interview, or processing fees.

Our Commitment:
We are dedicated to preventing all forms of unwanted behaviour in the workplace, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity, and financial misconduct. We are equally committed to safeguarding the welfare of children, young people and adults. We prioritize hiring individuals who embody and uphold our core values.

Equal Opportunity Employer:
Action Against Hunger is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability or genetic information.
Qualified women are strongly encouraged to apply.

Recruitment Process:
All shortlisted candidates will undergo thorough reference and background checks and are expected to adhere to organizational standards and principles.

  • 100% health care coverage
  • Free and direct access to Talent Soft e-learning platform

  • Creche facilities for babies

title: Video Content Specialist
description:
Base to kompleksowy system operacyjny dla e-commerce, który pozwala firmom zarządzać wszystkimi procesami sprzedaży online w jednym miejscu. Od wystawiania produktów i obsługi zamówień, przez zarządzanie magazynem i wysyłką, po repricing i ekspansję na rynki zagraniczne.
Oferuje własne moduły OMS, WMS, PIM, analityki i obsługi klienta oraz ponad 1 700 integracji z marketplace'ami, sklepami internetowymi, przewoźnikami, operatorami fulfillment oraz systemami księgowymi i ERP. Wbudowany silnik automatyzacji bez kodowania pozwala firmom odciążyć zespoły z tysięcy powtarzalnych zadań, redukując błędy i uwalniając zasoby na rozwój.
Base obsługuje ponad 35 000 klientów na całym świecie, przetwarzając rocznie ponad 320 milionów zamówień oraz ponad 17 miliardów dolarów GMV. Firma działa już w 15 krajach, w tym w USA, Niemczech, Wielkiej Brytanii, Francji, Indiach i Brazylii, w każdym budując lokalne zespoły.

Jesteśmy jedną z najszybciej rozwijających się firm w branży. Stawiamy na kulturę, współpracę, innowacyjność, która przełoży się na realny wpływ na prowadzenie biznesu.

Obecnie poszukujemy osobę na stanowisko Video Content Specialist, która odpowiedzialna będzie za kompleksową produkcję treści wideo, od pomysłu i scenariusza, przez nagranie, po montaż i przygotowanie materiałów do publikacji w kanałach marki.

Jako Video Content Specialist będziesz odpowiedzialny/a za:

Scenariusze i koncepcja:

  • tworzenie pomysłów i koncepcji materiałów wideo zgodnych ze strategią marki i celami marketingowymi,
  • pisanie scenariuszy, konspektów i storyboardów: od krótkich form (Reels,TikTok, YouTube Shorts) po dłuższe materiały (tutoriale, webinary, wywiady, filmy produktowe),
  • przygotowywanie hooków, narracji i CTA dopasowanych do platformy i grupy docelowej,
  • współpraca z zespołami marketingu, produktu i sprzedaży przy przekładaniu złożonych tematów na prosty, angażujący przekaz,
  • śledzenie trendów w social media i proponowanie nowych formatów.

Nagrywanie i produkcja

  • samodzielna realizacja nagrań w studiu, biurze i w terenie (kamera, światło, dźwięk),
  • przygotowanie planu zdjęciowego: scenografii, oświetlenia, rekwizytów i harmonogramu,
  • prowadzenie osób na planie (pracownicy, eksperci, klienci), tak żeby czuły się swobodnie przed kamerą,
  • nagrywanie screencastów i materiałów prezentujących oprogramowanie lub produkt,
  • dbanie o sprzęt i porządek w archiwum materiałów.

Montaż i postprodukcja

  • montaż materiałów w formatach poziomych i pionowych, dopasowanych do poszczególnych kanałów (YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, strona www),
  • korekcja kolorów, obróbka dźwięku, dobór muzyki i efektów,
  • tworzenie napisów, grafik, plansz i prostych animacji (motion graphics),
  • przygotowywanie kilku wersji jednego materiału (np. długi film plus seria krótkich klipów,
  • pilnowanie spójności wizualnej z identyfikacją marki.

Publikacja i analiza

  • przygotowanie miniatur, opisów i metadanych pod publikację,
  • analiza wyników (zasięgi, retencja, zaangażowanie) i wyciąganie z nich wniosków do kolejnych materiałów.

Wymagania

  • minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w tworzeniu treści wideo, np. jako videomaker, content creator, operator lub montażysta,
  • udokumentowane portfolio zrealizowanych projektów: od scenariusza, przez nagranie, po montaż,
  • bardzo dobra znajomość programów do montażu, np. Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve lub Final Cut Pro,
  • znajomość After Effects, Claude Design lub innego narzędzia do motion graphics,
  • umiejętność generowaniem video i audo w przy użyciu AI,
  • praca na kamerach sony mile widziana (Sony a7sIII),
  • praktyczna znajomość obsługi kamer Sony A7SLLL, aparatu, oświetlenia i sprzętu audio,
  • umiejętność pisania scenariuszy i “lekkie pióro”,
  • wyczucie estetyki, kadru i rytmu montażu,
  • znajomość specyfiki platform social media i formatów krótkich wideo,
  • samodzielność, dobra organizacja pracy i umiejętność prowadzenia kilku projektów równolegle,
  • otwartość na feedback i umiejętność współpracy z różnymi zespołami,
  • język angielski na poziomie min. B2,
  • prawo jazdy kat. B.

Mile widziane:

  • doświadczenie w branży e-commerce, SaaS lub tech,
  • znajomość narzędzi AI wspierających produkcję wideo,
  • umiejętność tworzenia animacji 2D/3D,
  • doświadczenie w prowadzeniu nagrań live i webinarów,
  • swoboda występowania przed kamerą.

Dlaczego Base.com?

  • Będziesz częścią zespołu, który aktywnie pisze scenariusz dla globalnego e-commerce.
  • Masz na czym budować – dostajesz działający, produkt i zbudowany zespół z kompetencjami potrzebnymi do realizacji celów.
  • Masz bezpośredni wpływ na wynik firmy - Growth nie jest u nas funkcją wspierającą, będziesz odpowiadać za jeden z kluczowych silników wzrostu Base.com.
  • Decyzyjność i autonomię: brak sztywnych, korporacyjnych procedur – jeśli masz dobry pomysł, po prostu go wdrażasz.
  • Współpraca przy innowacyjnym produkcie w szybko rosnącym środowisku, to idealne miejsce, jeśli lubisz, gdy rzeczy dzieją się dynamicznie.
  • Atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie i pakiet benefitów.
  • Atrakcyjny wachlarz dodatków wspierających Twoje zdrowie, pasje i rozwój.
  • Innych pracowników i liderów, którzy są pasjonatami tego co robią.

title: QC Lead
description:
QC Lead Job Description

The QC Lead is responsible for overseeing the activities of the QC department and the training and direction of inspection personnel. Under the direction of the Plant Manager, the QC Lead works with the other Manufacturing Department Leads to promote safety and to ensure that the company’s established product quality standards are regularly met.

Responsibilities

  • Quality Control team leadership including training, development and monitoring all inspectors, and assignment & prioritization of QC tasks.
  • Perform or assign incoming inspection of raw materials, and outside processed parts and fabrications using controlled tools to meet purchase order and design drawing requirements
  • Perform or assign First Article Inspections of internally or externally processed parts and fabrications
  • Perform or assign random QC audits of shop personnel in=process inspections of internally processed parts and fabrications and perform in=process inspections as needed
  • Perform final inspection of various pump assemblies, and in-house fabricated and machined parts using controlled tools to meet design drawing and traveler requirements
  • Perform inspection and analysis of customer returned and submitted products
  • Make recommendations for practical and Cascade capable shop methods of rework and/or problem resolution for bringing nonconforming parts into conformance
  • Communicate with authorizing personnel to document appropriate steps for moving forward to address nonconforming parts and material issues
  • Follow-up on all dispositions and verify reworked part conformance to complete and close NCRs in the unipoint NC system
  • Monitor and maintain the controlled and calibrated tools and equipment program in unipoint
  • Assign or perform calibration of internally calibrated inspection tools
  • Monitor and report monthly production quality data to the Plan Manager and identify and recommend improvements for inspection and production quality controls and methods
  • Drive safety and housekeeping practices within the QC department and throughout the plant
  • Monitor and evaluate the performance of QC inspectors, and aid in the hiring of new inspection personnel
  • Promote and practice Quality Awareness and Quality Culture within the Quality Control department.

Skills

  • Read precision measuring instruments including calipers, micrometers, dial indicators, etc.
  • Read and understand blueprints, specifications, procedures, and work instructions.
  • Shop math including; addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and geometry
  • Operation of Roamer CMM Inspection Arm
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Good organizational skills and time management
  • PC navigation and use of MS Office and Uni-point programs

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years QC inspection experience in a manufacturing or machine shop environment
  • Minimum 3 years of leadership experience
  • Familiarity with tool calibration practices
  • Must be able to lift 25 pounds
  • Willing to be forklift trained

Benefits and Perks

  • Medical (Company Contribution)
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Profit Sharing (3% company match)
  • Company paid Life Insurance
  • 10 Paid Holidays
  • PTO/Sick time

title: Dog Walker / Pet Sitter - Peninsula
description:
DOG WALKERS & PET SITTERS NEEDED – Peninsula


Bay Area Pet Pals is hiring dependable Dog Walkers & Pet Sitters!

We are currently building new routes between Burlingame and Palo Alto and can usually tailor routes to keep you working close to your preferred area.

We are receiving more requests from new clients than our current team can accommodate, so we’re looking for a few great people to join us!

PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

We want to be completely upfront about how this position starts.

When you first join us, you may begin with only a few visits per week — and there may even be very little work during the first few weeks while we begin building your route.

As new clients come in within your service area, we add them to your schedule and work toward building you a regular, consistent route. It can take several weeks or sometimes a few months to build a fuller route to tailor to your comfort level.

Because pet care depends on client needs, the amount of work and income can fluctuate in general.

If you need a guaranteed number of hours immediately, this probably isn't the right position. If you're looking for long-term, part-time work and are comfortable allowing us time to build your route, we'd love to hear from you.

PAY

This is a paid-per-visit employee position.

Our employees typically earn approximately $500–$2,500 per month working part-time, depending on their availability, established route, and client demand.

Individual jobs generally pay approximately $20–$38+ per visit, depending on the type and length of the visit.

We also offer:

  • Higher pay for major holiday visits
  • Two generous bonuses per year
  • Paid training
  • Pet CPR & First Aid certification
  • Workers' compensation
  • Liability insurance and bonding
  • Optional CalSavers Roth IRA

ABOUT THE JOB

You'll provide dog walks and in-home pet care for our clients throughout the Peninsula.

We serve:

Burlingame • San Mateo • Foster City • Belmont • San Carlos • Redwood City • Atherton • Menlo Park • Palo Alto

We try to create routes that keep employees working within a convenient geographic area to minimize unnecessary driving.

Routes may include dogs of all breeds and sizes (can tailor to your comfort level), as well as cats and other pets.

Most weekday dog walks and pet visits take place some time between approximately 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

Additional morning, evening, weekend, and holiday work may also be available for those who want it.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Reliability is #1. Our clients and their pets depend on us, so we need people who take their commitments seriously.

You should:

  • Be extremely reliable and responsible
  • Truly love animals
  • Enjoy being outdoors and staying active
  • Be comfortable walking and handling dogs of different sizes
  • Live in or near one of our service areas
  • Be legally authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Have your own reliable vehicle
  • Have a valid driver's license and auto insurance
  • Have a smartphone with data for scheduling, navigation, photos, and client updates
  • Be consistently available Monday–Friday during at least the 10:00 AM–3:00 PM timeframe
  • Be willing to work partial days on some major holidays when needed — you will not be required to work every holiday
  • Be comfortable working outdoors in different weather conditions (we do adjust visits for major rain, and high heat)
  • Stay focused on the dogs during walks — safety always comes first
  • Have reliable, consistent weekly availability
  • Be looking for a long-term position
  • Be able to commit to at least one year

THIS POSITION IS NOT A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

  • Are looking for temporary, seasonal, or short-term work
  • Need a guaranteed full schedule immediately
  • Cannot provide consistent weekday availability
  • Are unable to commit for at least one year

WHY WORK WITH BAY AREA PET PALS?

Besides getting paid to spend your days with some pretty amazing dogs and cats, you'll have the opportunity to build real relationships with the same pets and clients each week.

You are our employee — not an independent contractor.

We provide paid training, workers' compensation, liability insurance and bonding, and Pet CPR & First Aid certification.

Most importantly, we appreciate our team.

Our walkers and sitters are the front line of our business, and we believe they deserve to be treated with gratitude, appreciation, and respect. Most of our team members have stayed with us for many years.

ABOUT BAY AREA PET PALS

Bay Area Pet Pals is a local, family-owned pet care company that has proudly served Peninsula pets and their families for more than 17 years.

We have 200+ Yelp reviews — more than any other pet care company in our area.

Our awards include:

Best Pet Care Company – San Francisco Magazine (2 years in a row)
Bay Woof's Beast of the Bay Award

Learn more about us:

You can also find Bay Area Pet Pals – San Mateo on Yelp.

INTERESTED?

Please reply directly to this Craigslist ad and tell us a little about yourself, including:

  • City you live in
  • Your general Monday–Friday availability, as well as any weekend availability for occasional cat sit visits
  • Your experience with dogs and other pets — brief is fine!
  • Whether you have a reliable vehicle and auto insurance
  • Resume would be helpful as well

Please, no phone calls.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Education Training Specialist
description:
About the role

Comply is looking for a Training Specialist to help thousands of Comply customers turn product knowledge into confident, daily use. Comply is the champion for compliance professionals, serving more than 7,000 clients globally by merging technology, consulting, and education. This role sits on our Customer Success team, at the front line of customer adoption. You’ll spend most of your time in 1:1 training sessions tailored to each customer’s role, goals, and experience, and you’ll also lead webinars, workshops, and office hours that reach many customers at once. You’ll own the training experience end to end, from scheduling to follow-up, and use customer feedback and data to keep making it better. It’s a role built for someone early in their career who loves teaching and wants hands-on experience with customers at scale, with real potential for advancement as you grow.

You’ll love this role if you love teaching and can explain complex topics clearly to whoever is in front of you- and you’re patient, curious, organized, and energized by learning new software and new subject matter.

What you’ll do

  • Deliver 1:1 training sessions tailored to each customer’s role, goals, and level of experience.
  • Lead webinars, workshops, and office hours that help customers adopt Comply products and get value from them.
  • Build deep knowledge of Comply products and how they map to client workflows and regulatory needs.
  • Customize Customer Education content (decks, demos, guides) for specific audiences, and recommend improvements based on what you see in sessions.
  • Partner with the Customer Education leader to keep training resources accurate, current, and professional.
  • Own your training calendar end to end: scheduling, preparation, reminders, and follow-up so customers leave with clear next steps.
  • Track attendance, completion, and customer feedback, and use the results to refine session formats and topics.
  • Flag risks and opportunities you hear in sessions (low adoption, frustration, expansion interest) to CSMs and account partners, and relay recurring questions and product gaps to Support and Product.
  • Log training activity and outcomes accurately in Gainsight and other internal systems, and contribute to team projects that improve how we train our largest customer base.

What success looks like in your first 90 days

  • You’ve ramped on Comply’s products and the compliance challenges our clients face, and you’re running 1:1 sessions on your own.
  • You’ve led your first webinars, workshops, or office hours and built a reliable scheduling-to-follow-up rhythm.
  • You’re tracking attendance, completion, and feedback, and using it to improve session formats and topics.

What you’ll bring

Must-have

  • 0–2 years of experience in training, customer support, customer success, teaching, or a similar customer-facing role.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication, and comfort presenting to both small and large groups.
  • The ability to explain complex topics simply to audiences with different levels of knowledge.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail across many scheduled sessions.
  • Proficiency with Teams, the Microsoft Suite, and webinar platforms, plus comfort learning new software (spreadsheets, CRM, email marketing, support, automation, and presentation tools).

Nice-to-have

  • Interest in or familiarity with financial services or compliance.
  • Familiarity with Gainsight or a similar customer success platform.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary range would be $45,000 - $52,000 plus applicable bonus/benefit offerings, etc., as those similarly situated within the Company. It takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including, but not limited to, skill sets, training, licensure and certification, and experience.

title: Field Inspector

Providing detailed scopes of work and recommendations to investors—to maximize property profitability and preserve the long-term functionality of real estate assets and match the appropriate contractor/trade partner to perform the project in a cost effective, timely and qualitative manner. Working within Auben’s unique pod structure, and alongside an experienced team of third-party vendors, the primary goal will always be to provide rental homes that meet safety and functionally cosmetic standards and promote an enjoyable living experience for our future residents.

We seek a self-motivated individual with a strong background in property inspection and project management. This executive will be responsible for overseeing home inspections at the time of move-out and managing properties through the entire project management life cycle, ensuring the highest standards of quality and efficiency.

We possess an insatiable desire for growth, accomplishment and making the impossible happen and you should too.

Our organization sparks the entrepreneurial spirit to help people live up to their true potential. Are you up to the challenge?

  • High stress tolerance -- thrives in a high-pressure environment.
  • Ultimate subject matter knowledge---Constantly seeking the ideal balance of price, quality, and timeliness for Auben turnover and renovation projects.
  • Logistic proficiency---Focused on quick response times to minimize vacancy loss and maximize profitability for owners.
  • Analytical---Determining the proper renovation for the rental rate, area, and investor profile.

  • TEAM ORIENTED
  • SOLUTION ORIENTED
  • SENSE OF URGENCY
  • DIRECT/COMMUNICATIVE
  • ACCOUNTABLE
  • UNDERDOG DNA

title: Data Engineer
description:
CitySwift is looking for a Data Engineer to join our rapidly growing team.

CitySwift is the world’s leading performance optimisation platform for public transport, enabling data-driven decision-making for some of the largest transport networks globally. Backed by over €15 million in venture capital funding, we partner with major public transport operators and government authorities, including Go-Ahead Group, Transport for London, and many more. CitySwift is experiencing accelerated growth, with 117% year-over-year revenue growth in 2025.

Our mission is to increase the adoption of sustainable public transport worldwide. Today, our platform optimises more than 3 billion passenger journeys annually, and our target is to reach 10 billion journeys by the end of 2026.

At CitySwift, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, make a measurable impact, and grow professionally as part of a collaborative, mission-driven team. Join us in shaping the future of public transport by driving the next phase of CitySwift’s growth.

About the Role

As a Data Engineer on the Engine team, you will play a pivotal role in building and evolving CitySwift’s core data processing engine. You will work within a team responsible for ingesting, cleaning, and joining high-velocity transport data, processing over 20 million vehicle pings daily and matching demand to telemetry every 22 seconds. Your work will directly power our automated pipelines, data validation algorithms, and geospatial mapping tools, ensuring high data integrity across billions of passenger journeys.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that ingest and process multi-source transport datasets (vehicle telemetry, schedule data, passenger ticketing/APC demand, and geospatial topology).
  • Develop and refine automated data cleaning, validation, and deduplication logic to maintain high data integrity across raw, noisy datasets.
  • Optimise core data processing pipelines for geospatial mapping, corridor-level analysis, and real-time/batch data enrichment.
  • Support pipeline management, job monitoring, automated testing, and error handling to guarantee reliable daily processing for downstream products (Explore, Evolve, Discover).
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to translate domain algorithms and complex transportation logic into efficient engine code.
  • Troubleshoot complex data processing issues, assist in root-cause analysis, and streamline data ingestion pipelines.
  • Continuously learn and adopt new technologies, distributed tools, and data engineering best practices as our platform scales.

Desired Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related field.
  • Experience designing, developing, or maintaining data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, or data-driven systems.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, data warehousing concepts, and data quality principles.
  • Experience working with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
  • Advanced SQL capabilities with deep experience in data modeling, query performance tuning, and schema design across relational, NoSQL, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, MySQL, MongoDB).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or Java.
  • Familiarity with modern data technologies (e.g., Spark, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, or similar) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team.
  • Good communication skills and a willingness to learn, ask questions, and grow within the role.

We value, recognise and reward our people

  • A role with real scope, where your impact is visible, your salary is reviewed as we grow, and there are career progression opportunities as the company scales and internationalises.
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance through Laya Healthcare in Ireland and Aviva in the UK.
  • Flexible working with hybrid working as the default in Ireland, core hours of 10am to 4pm, remote options depending on role and a work abroad programme of up to 6 weeks.
  • 25 days annual leave from day one, increasing by half a day per year of service, plus company days off, a half day before public holidays and an end of year shutdown.
  • Enhanced family leave, including 6 months fully paid maternity leave and 3 weeks paid paternity leave after 18 months’ service (and wedding leave!)
  • And on top of all of this, the usuals done well. A matching pension scheme that increases with service, paid sick leave, bike to work scheme, wellbeing supports, and an employee referral programme with rewards of up to €4,000 (or equivalent) per referral.

title: Logistics Technician/Fulfillment Specialist
description:
Role Summary:
The Order Fulfillment Specialist executes end-to-end pick/pack/ship for finished goods with a focus on vault accuracy, FEFO/lot control, manifest compliance, and on-time, in-full (OTIF) delivery readiness. This role stages orders, verifies SKUs/lots/quantities with scan validation, prepares shipping documents (invoice, COA, manifest copy), and supports drivers/dispatch to meet customer ETAs—while maintaining audit-ready records in internal systems and the state-mandated tracking system.

Key Outcomes (KPIs)
  • Pick/Pack Accuracy: ≥ 99.7% line accuracy by SKU/lot.
  • OTIF Readiness: ≥ 98% of orders staged by cutoff and route departure times.
  • Inventory Accuracy (vault bins): ≥ 99.5% for assigned locations; variances resolved ≤ 48 hours.
  • Document Accuracy: 100% correct manifests, COAs, labels, and shipping paperwork.
  • Cycle Count Compliance: 100% of assigned counts completed on schedule.
  • Safety & 5S: 100% PPE/ergonomics compliance; area passes weekly 5S audits.
Responsibilities:

Order Picking & Staging
  • Pull orders using scan-based picking; verify SKU, lot, expiry (if applicable), case pack, and quantity against work orders.
  • Apply FEFO and lot control; segregate quarantine/hold product; stage orders in secure, labeled bays.
  • Communicate shorts/substitutions per rules set by Logistics Manager; update picks in WMS/ERP and state tracking.
Packing & Documentation
  • Pack to standard (tamper-evident, dunnage, case labeling); verify unit, case, and pallet labels.
  • Prepare document sets for each order: invoice/packing list, COA, and manifest copy; ensure documents match lots and quantities.
  • Capture pack weights/dimensions; apply shipping labels and route IDs per dispatch plan.
Vault & Inventory Control
  • Perform daily bin checks and assigned cycle counts; reconcile and document variances promptly.
  • Maintain clean, organized vault and pack areas; follow dual-control and access rules.
Manifesting & Compliance Support
  • Enter/verify order details in the state-mandated tracking system and internal tools; ensure chain-of-custody is intact.
  • Assist with manifest generation and driver packets; verify vehicles, drivers, and destinations match paperwork.
Returns & Reverse Logistics
  • Receive authorized returns (RMAs); verify product and quantities against paperwork; update systems and stage for QA disposition.
  • Document reasons for return (damage, discrepancy, expiration, customer error) and escalate trends.
Cross-Functional Communication
  • Coordinate with Sales for order notes and buyer requests; with QA for COAs/holds; with Drivers/Dispatch on route timing and dock appointments.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups; flag blockers early (inventory gaps, COA timing, packaging shortages).
Safety, Security & Housekeeping
  • Use required PPE; follow lifting/ergonomics, dock safety, and vault security protocols.
  • Maintain 5S standards; clean-as-you-go; support monthly wall-to-wall counts.

Qualifications
  • 1–3 years in warehouse, fulfillment, or distribution (regulated/high-value goods preferred).
  • Proficient with scan-based picking, lot/FEFO control, and basic WMS/ERP tasks; comfortable with labelers/scanners/tablets.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation habits; familiar with packing standards and shipping paperwork.
  • Clear, courteous communicator with a customer-service mindset; calm under time pressure.

Physical & Schedule Requirements
  • Stand/walk for extended periods; repetitive lifting up to 50 lbs; frequent bending/stooping and pallet/cart handling.
  • Work in secured vault/warehouse, coolers (if applicable), and loading docks; exposure to packaging dust and cleaning agents (PPE provided/required).

Diversity and Inclusion
We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate based on race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, pregnancy, sex, gender identity or expression, disability, or because of the liability for service in the armed forces of the United States or the nationality of any individual, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. ​

description:

We are CARIAD, an automotive software development team with the Volkswagen Group. ​Role Summary:

​The Sr Software Engineer, Integration integrates production C++ software, embedded middleware, and AI inference components into CARIAD’s autonomous-driving software stack. The role connects application software, inference runtimes, and embedded hardware to deliver reliable, real-time system behavior. Operating as a senior individual contributor, this engineer independently owns assigned complex integration deliverables on platforms such as Qualcomm 8797 and NVIDIA DRIVE Thor. The role develops C++ adapters and glue code, diagnoses issues across system interfaces, and validates integrated software through embedded testing, recompute with bit-identical replay, and HIL testing. The engineer will work closely with machine learning, embedded software, hardware, simulation, and vehicle engineering teams to resolve integration issues and prepare software for deployment.

Role Responsibilities:

C++ and Middleware Integration

  • Design, implement, and maintain production-quality C++ software that integrates application components with embedded middleware such as Apex.AI, AOS, or ROS.
  • Develop C++ adapters and glue code for data exchange, interface compatibility, component lifecycle, and runtime coordination.
  • Integrate and debug software on Qualcomm 8797 and/or NVIDIA DRIVE Thor development kits, resolving issues across software and hardware boundaries.
  • Independently own assigned integration issues from reproduction and root-cause analysis through corrective implementation and verified resolution, escalating cross-system architectural decisions as appropriate.

Embedded AI Inference Integration

  • Integrate AI models and inference runtimes into embedded applications, including input and output handling and execution interfaces.
  • Implement and maintain C++ adapters connecting inference libraries with middleware and application software.
  • Profile and resolve integration issues affecting inference correctness, latency, memory use, and runtime stability on target hardware.
  • Collaborate with ML engineers to validate model behavior and runtime compatibility, using QNN or TensorRT where applicable.

Embedded Testing and Validation

  • Develop and execute embedded integration on development kits, benches, and HIL systems.
  • Implement and maintain recompute workflows for bit-identical replay under controlled inputs and execution conditions.
  • Investigate replay mismatches and integration regressions using logs, traces, recorded data, and target-hardware evidence.
  • Automate regression testing and document functional, timing, and resource-use results to support release

Technical Collaboration and Documentation

  • Coordinate interface changes and integration dependencies with ML, embedded software, hardware, simulation, and vehicle engineering teams.
  • Participate in design and code reviews, provide practical technical guidance to engineering peers, and document interfaces, configurations, integration procedures, and validation evidence.
  • Improve integration tooling and share lessons learned to increase reliability, reproducibility, and development efficiency.

​General Skills:

  • Strong analytical and debugging skills across software, middleware, runtime, and hardware interfaces.
  • Ability to independently own complex integration work and resolve issues using measurable evidence.
  • Clear communication and effective collaboration with ML, embedded software, hardware, and vehicle engineering teams.
  • Strong software engineering practices, including code review, testing, documentation, and reproducible validation.​

​Required Specialized Skills:

  • Strong hands-on C++ programming skills are required, including production-quality embedded software development and debugging.
  • Experience integrating software with embedded middleware solutions such as Apex.AI, AOS, or ROS
  • Hands-on experience integrating and debugging software on embedded AI compute platforms or development kits (e.g., Qualcomm 8797 or NVIDIA DRIVE Thor).
  • Experience integrating AI inference on embedded targets, including C++ adapters and glue code connecting models, inference runtimes, and application interfaces.
  • Experience with embedded testing, including recompute (bit-identical replay) and hardware-in-the- loop (HIL) validation.

​Desired Skills:

  • Knowledge of QNN and TensorRT libraries for embedded AI inference integration.
  • Experience integrating or debugging camera, radar, and lidar drivers.
  • Experience with agentic workflows for implementation, debugging, testing, or documentation, with review and validation of generated output.

​Workplace Flexibility:

  • Hands-on work with embedded development kits, lab systems, HIL environments, and development vehicles may require on-site presence when integration or validation activities cannot be performed remotely.
  • Collaboration across U.S. and international time zones and occasional travel for integration activities or vehicle testing may be required.

​Years of Relevant Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience in C++ software development, embedded systems, or software integration.
  • Hands-on experience integrating, debugging, and validating software on embedded target hardware.
  • Experience independently delivering complex technical work from integration planning through implementation and validation.

​Required Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

​Desired Education:

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

Compensation

description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.
